```sql
WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter meter_readings
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        quality,
        CASE WHEN voltage >= 236.7 THEN 'A' WHEN voltage >= 220.7 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS voltage_tier
    FROM meter_readings
    WHERE site_id IS NOT NULL
),
enriched_site AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT s.*, si.commissioned_on AS site_commissioned_on, si.site_name
    FROM filtered s
    LEFT JOIN sites si ON si.id = s.site_id
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(kwh) OVER w_site_commissioned_on_month AS site_commissioned_on_month_sum_kwh,
        NTH_VALUE(read_at, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(site_commissioned_on), DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at) ORDER BY site_commissioned_on, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_read_at,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(site_id) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(site_commissioned_on))) AS distinct_site_id_in_site_commissioned_on_month,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY site_id, voltage_tier ORDER BY kwh ASC, id) AS kwh_dense_rank,
        MIN(kwh) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(site_commissioned_on)) AS site_commissioned_on_month_min_kwh,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY site_id, voltage_tier ORDER BY kwh ASC, id), 3) AS kwh_percent_rank
    FROM enriched_site
    WINDOW w_site_commissioned_on_month AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(site_commissioned_on))
),
reading_stats AS (
    -- Per-site meter_readings metrics
    SELECT
        site_id,
        SUM(kwh) AS total_reading_kwh,
        MIN(read_at) AS first_reading_read_at
    FROM meter_readings
    GROUP BY site_id
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach meter_readings metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        m.total_reading_kwh,
        m.first_reading_read_at
    FROM with_trends s
    LEFT JOIN reading_stats m ON m.site_id = s.site_id
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        distinct_site_id_in_site_commissioned_on_month,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at) AS read_at_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT voltage_tier) AS distinct_voltage_tiers,
        SUM(distinct_site_id_in_site_commissioned_on_month) AS total_distinct_site_id_in_site_commissioned_on_m
    FROM summarized_rows
    WHERE site_commissioned_on_month_min_kwh < 780.0
    GROUP BY distinct_site_id_in_site_commissioned_on_month, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at)
)
SELECT
    distinct_site_id_in_site_commissioned_on_month,
    read_at_month,
    distinct_voltage_tiers
FROM rollup_base
ORDER BY distinct_voltage_tiers
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.col("site_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "quality",
        F.when(F.col("voltage") >= 236.7, "A").when(F.col("voltage") >= 220.7, "B").otherwise("C").alias("voltage_tier"),
    )
)

enriched_site = (
    filtered.alias("s")
    .join(df_sites.alias("si"), F.col("si.id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("si.commissioned_on").alias("site_commissioned_on"),
        "si.site_name",
    )
)

w_site_commissioned_on_month = Window.partitionBy(F.month("site_commissioned_on"))
with_trends = (
    enriched_site
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("kwh").over(w_site_commissioned_on_month).alias("site_commissioned_on_month_sum_kwh"),
        F.nth_value("read_at", 2).over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("site_commissioned_on"), F.date_trunc("month", "read_at")).orderBy("site_commissioned_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_read_at"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("site_id").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("site_commissioned_on")))).alias("distinct_site_id_in_site_commissioned_on_month"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", "voltage_tier").orderBy("kwh", "id")).alias("kwh_dense_rank"),
        F.min("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("site_commissioned_on"))).alias("site_commissioned_on_month_min_kwh"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", "voltage_tier").orderBy("kwh", "id")), 3).alias("kwh_percent_rank"),
    )
)

reading_stats = (
    df_meter_readings
    .groupBy("site_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum("kwh").alias("total_reading_kwh"),
        F.min("read_at").alias("first_reading_read_at"),
    )
)

summarized_rows = (
    with_trends.alias("s")
    .join(reading_stats.alias("m"), F.col("m.site_id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", "m.total_reading_kwh", "m.first_reading_read_at")
)

rollup_base = (
    summarized_rows
    .filter(F.col("site_commissioned_on_month_min_kwh") < 780.0)
    .groupBy(
        "distinct_site_id_in_site_commissioned_on_month",
        F.date_trunc("month", "read_at").alias("read_at_month"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("voltage_tier").alias("distinct_voltage_tiers"),
        F.sum("distinct_site_id_in_site_commissioned_on_month").alias("total_distinct_site_id_in_site_commissioned_on_m"),
    )
)

result = (
    rollup_base
    .select(
        "distinct_site_id_in_site_commissioned_on_month",
        "read_at_month",
        "distinct_voltage_tiers",
    )
    .orderBy("distinct_voltage_tiers")
)
```

```sql
WITH scoped AS (
    -- Scope the sites rows
    SELECT
        id,
        site_name,
        zone,
        installed_kw,
        commissioned_on,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(zone), ' ', '_')) AS zone_slug,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(site_name), ' ', '_')) AS site_name_slug
    FROM sites
    WHERE zone IN ('Z4', 'Z2')
      AND UPPER(TRIM(site_name)) LIKE 'H%'
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Rows that have matching meter_readings
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scoped s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM meter_readings m
            WHERE m.site_id = s.id
              AND m.kwh < 106.5
              AND m.read_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-18 07:00:00'
        )
)
SELECT
    id,
    zone,
    commissioned_on,
    COALESCE(zone, 'UNKNOWN') AS zone_or_unknown,
    FLOOR(installed_kw / 100) * 100 AS installed_kw_bucket
FROM without_matches
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

scoped = (
    df_sites
    .filter((F.col("zone").isin("Z4", "Z2")) & (F.upper(F.trim(F.col("site_name"))).like("H%")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_name",
        "zone",
        "installed_kw",
        "commissioned_on",
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("zone")), " ", "_")).alias("zone_slug"),
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("site_name")), " ", "_")).alias("site_name_slug"),
    )
)

without_matches = (
    scoped.alias("s")
    .join(df_meter_readings.alias("m"), (F.col("m.site_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("m.kwh") < 106.5) & (F.col("m.read_at") < F.lit("2025-02-18 07:00:00").cast("timestamp")), "left_semi")
)

result = (
    without_matches
    .select(
        "id",
        "zone",
        "commissioned_on",
        F.coalesce(F.col("zone"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("zone_or_unknown"),
        (F.floor(F.col("installed_kw") / 100) * 100).alias("installed_kw_bucket"),
    )
)
```

```sql
WITH approved_by_policy AS (
    -- APPROVED rows per policy_id
    SELECT policy_id, COUNT(*) AS approved_count, ROUND(AVG(claimed_amount), 2) AS approved_avg_claimed_amount
    FROM claims
    WHERE status = 'APPROVED'
    GROUP BY policy_id
),
open_by_policy AS (
    -- OPEN rows per policy_id
    SELECT policy_id, COUNT(*) AS open_count, SUM(claimed_amount) AS open_total_claimed_amount
    FROM claims
    WHERE status = 'OPEN'
    GROUP BY policy_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.policy_id, b.policy_id) AS policy_id,
    COALESCE(a.approved_count, 0) AS approved_count,
    COALESCE(a.approved_avg_claimed_amount, 0) AS approved_avg_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(b.open_count, 0) AS open_count,
    b.open_total_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(a.approved_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.open_count, 0) AS approved_count_minus_open_count
FROM approved_by_policy a
FULL OUTER JOIN open_by_policy b
  ON a.policy_id = b.policy_id
ORDER BY policy_id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

approved_by_policy = (
    df_claims
    .filter(F.col("status") == "APPROVED")
    .groupBy("policy_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("approved_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("claimed_amount"), 2).alias("approved_avg_claimed_amount"),
    )
)

open_by_policy = (
    df_claims
    .filter(F.col("status") == "OPEN")
    .groupBy("policy_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("open_count"),
        F.sum("claimed_amount").alias("open_total_claimed_amount"),
    )
)

result = (
    approved_by_policy.alias("a")
    .join(open_by_policy.alias("b"), F.col("a.policy_id") == F.col("b.policy_id"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.policy_id"), F.col("b.policy_id")).alias("policy_id"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.approved_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("approved_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.approved_avg_claimed_amount"), F.lit(0)).alias("approved_avg_claimed_amount"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.open_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("open_count"),
        F.col("b.open_total_claimed_amount"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.approved_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.open_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("approved_count_minus_open_count"),
    )
    .orderBy("policy_id")
)
```

```sql
WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        event_type,
        page,
        DATE_FORMAT(event_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS event_time_label,
        ROUND(duration_sec, 0) AS duration_sec_rounded
    FROM web_events
    WHERE page IS NOT NULL
      AND event_type IN ('page_view', 'click')
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY duration_sec_rounded DESC) AS duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, event_type ORDER BY duration_sec_rounded NULLS FIRST) AS duration_sec_rounded_rank,
        COUNT(duration_sec_rounded) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type, session_id) AS event_type_count_duration_sec_rounded
    FROM filtered
    WHERE page = '/product'
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM with_windows
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY duration_sec_rounded_rank DESC NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach sessions attributes
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.session_id,
        a.duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank,
        a.event_type_count_duration_sec_rounded,
        d.device,
        d.country,
        d.browser
    FROM ranked a
    INNER JOIN sessions d
        ON a.session_id = d.id
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT session_id
    FROM with_dims
    EXCEPT
    SELECT session_id
    FROM web_events
    WHERE duration_sec BETWEEN 229 AND 230
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_dims s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.session_id = k.session_id
),
totals AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank_tier,
        AVG(event_type_count_duration_sec_rounded) FILTER (WHERE country = 'TH') AS th_avg_event_type_count_duration_sec_rounded,
        ROUND(AVG(duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank), 2) AS avg_duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank,
        SUM(event_type_count_duration_sec_rounded) FILTER (WHERE device = 'mobile') AS mobile_total_event_type_count_duration_sec_rounded,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank_quartiles
    FROM kept_rows
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
    HAVING avg_duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank >= 0
)
SELECT
    duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank_tier,
    th_avg_event_type_count_duration_sec_rounded,
    mobile_total_event_type_count_duration_sec_rounded,
    duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank_quartiles
FROM totals;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_web_events
    .filter(F.col("page").isNotNull() & F.col("event_type").isin(["page_view", "click"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "page",
        F.date_format("event_time", "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("event_time_label"),
        F.round("duration_sec", 0).alias("duration_sec_rounded"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("page") == "/product")
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec_rounded").desc())).alias("duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("session_id", "event_type").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec_rounded").asc_nulls_first())).alias("duration_sec_rounded_rank"),
        F.count("duration_sec_rounded").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type", "session_id")).alias("event_type_count_duration_sec_rounded"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec_rounded_rank").desc_nulls_first(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

with_dims = (
    ranked
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("d"), F.col("a.session_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.session_id",
        "a.duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank",
        "a.event_type_count_duration_sec_rounded",
        F.col("d.device"),
        F.col("d.country"),
        F.col("d.browser"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    with_dims
    .select("session_id")
    .subtract(
        df_web_events
        .filter(F.col("duration_sec").between(229, 230))
        .select("session_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    with_dims
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.session_id") == F.col("k.session_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

totals = (
    kept_rows
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank") >= 7, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("country") == "TH", F.col("event_type_count_duration_sec_rounded"))).alias("th_avg_event_type_count_duration_sec_rounded"),
        F.round(F.avg("duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank"), 2).alias("avg_duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("device") == "mobile", F.col("event_type_count_duration_sec_rounded"))).alias("mobile_total_event_type_count_duration_sec_rounded"),
        F.percentile_approx("duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank_quartiles"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank") >= 0)
)

result = (
    totals
    .select(
        "duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank_tier",
        "th_avg_event_type_count_duration_sec_rounded",
        "mobile_total_event_type_count_duration_sec_rounded",
        "duration_sec_rounded_dense_rank_quartiles",
    )
)
```

```sql
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        shopper_account_id,
        store_tier,
        pay_mode,
        basket_total,
        line_qty,
        line_net,
        account_opened_on,
        LAST_DAY(account_opened_on) AS account_opened_on_month_end,
        COALESCE(pay_mode, 'NONE') AS resolved_pay_mode
    FROM baskets
    WHERE account_opened_on >= DATE '2023-09-01'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        pay_mode,
        basket_total,
        line_qty,
        line_net,
        account_opened_on,
        LEAD(line_qty) OVER w_ordered AS next_line_qty,
        LEAD(line_net) OVER w_ordered AS next_line_net,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_ordered AS row_seq
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE pay_mode = 'bnpl'
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY shopper_account_id ORDER BY account_opened_on_month_end, id)
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_grp AS line_qty_dense_rank,
        SUM(line_net) OVER (PARTITION BY pay_mode ORDER BY account_opened_on, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_line_net,
        ROUND(next_line_qty / SUM(next_line_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(account_opened_on), pay_mode), 4) AS next_line_qty_share,
        LAG(next_line_net, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY pay_mode ORDER BY line_qty, id) AS prev_next_line_net,
        LAST_VALUE(line_net, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY pay_mode ORDER BY row_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_line_net
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_grp AS (ORDER BY line_qty DESC NULLS LAST)
),
metrics_baskets AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(basket_total) OVER (ORDER BY basket_total, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS basket_total_avg_3,
        FIRST_VALUE(cumulative_line_net, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(account_opened_on), pay_mode ORDER BY line_qty_dense_rank, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_cumulative_line_net
    FROM metrics
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching basket_line per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.pay_mode,
        s.basket_total,
        s.account_opened_on,
        s.next_line_net,
        s.row_seq,
        s.line_qty_dense_rank,
        s.cumulative_line_net,
        s.next_line_qty_share,
        s.prev_next_line_net,
        x.basket_line_pay_mode
    FROM metrics_baskets s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.pay_mode AS basket_line_pay_mode
            FROM basket_lines c
            WHERE c.basket_ref = s.id
            ORDER BY c.line_net DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
)
SELECT
    id,
    pay_mode,
    basket_total,
    line_qty_dense_rank,
    next_line_qty_share,
    prev_next_line_net,
    basket_line_pay_mode
FROM with_last
```

```sql
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.listener_id,
        a.played_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_7d,
        SUM(b.ms_played) AS prior_ms_played_7d
    FROM plays a
    LEFT JOIN plays b
      ON b.listener_id = a.listener_id
     AND b.played_at < a.played_at
     AND b.played_at >= a.played_at - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.listener_id, a.played_at
),
detail_rows AS (
    -- One row per play
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.listener_id,
        s.prior_ms_played_7d,
        p.id AS play_id,
        p.played_at AS play_played_at,
        p.source AS play_source,
        p.track_id AS play_track_id
    FROM in_window s
    JOIN plays p ON p.listener_id = s.listener_id
),
play_stats AS (
    -- Per-listener plays metrics
    SELECT listener_id, MIN(played_at) AS first_played_at, COUNT(*) AS play_count
    FROM plays
    GROUP BY listener_id
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach plays metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        p.first_played_at,
        COALESCE(p.play_count, 0) AS play_count
    FROM detail_rows s
    LEFT JOIN play_stats p ON p.listener_id = s.listener_id
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY play_track_id ORDER BY prior_ms_played_7d ASC, id, play_id) AS seq_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY play_count, play_source ORDER BY first_played_at DESC, id, play_id) AS seq_no_2,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY play_id, play_source) AS rows_in_play_id_play_source,
        MIN(play_count) OVER (PARTITION BY play_count, play_source ORDER BY first_played_at DESC, id, play_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS min_play_count_so_far
    FROM summarized_rows
)
-- Subtotals with ROLLUP
SELECT
    listener_id,
    play_count,
    play_id,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid,
    ROUND(STDDEV(seq_no_2), 2) AS stddev_seq_no_2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN play_source IN ('search', 'radio', 'playlist') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_play_source_in_search_radio,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(play_source)) AS play_source_list
FROM sequenced
GROUP BY ROLLUP(listener_id, play_count, play_id)
ORDER BY listener_id NULLS LAST, play_count NULLS LAST, play_id NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

in_window = (
    df_plays.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_plays.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.listener_id") == F.col("a.listener_id"))
        & (F.col("b.played_at") < F.col("a.played_at"))
        & (F.col("b.played_at") >= F.col("a.played_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.listener_id", "a.played_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_7d"),
        F.sum("b.ms_played").alias("prior_ms_played_7d"),
    )
)

detail_rows = (
    in_window.alias("s")
    .join(df_plays.alias("p"), F.col("p.listener_id") == F.col("s.listener_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.listener_id",
        "s.prior_ms_played_7d",
        F.col("p.id").alias("play_id"),
        F.col("p.played_at").alias("play_played_at"),

    )
)

summarized_rows = (
    detail_rows.alias("s")
    .join(play_stats.alias("p"), F.col("p.listener_id") == F.col("s.listener_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "p.first_played_at",
        F.coalesce(F.col("p.play_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("play_count"),
    )
)

sequenced = (
    summarized_rows
    .select(
```

```sql
WITH covered AS (

    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.listener_id,

    FROM plays a

      ON b.listener_id = a.listener_id
     AND b.played_at < a.played_at
     AND b.played_at >= a.played_at - INTERVAL 3 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.listener_id, a.played_at
),
enriched AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT *, COALESCE(prior_rows_3d, 0) AS prior_rows_3d_filled
    FROM covered
)
SELECT

    played_at,
    prior_rows_3d,
    prior_rows_3d_filled,
    GREATEST(prior_ms_played_3d, prior_rows_3d) AS greatest_prior_ms_played_3d_prior_rows_3d,
    CASE WHEN prior_rows_3d >= 6 THEN 'large' WHEN prior_rows_3d >= 3 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS prior_rows_3d_tier
FROM enriched
```

```sql
    FROM recent_forklift_logs

exploded_detail AS (
    -- One row per forklift_log

),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_ticket_events
    .filter((F.col("actor") != "system") | (F.col("ticket_id").isNotNull()))
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
        F.coalesce(F.col("actor"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("actor_or_unknown"),
        F.concat(F.col("event_type"), F.lit("#"), F.col("id").cast("string")).alias("event_type_ref"),
    )
)

w_actor_by_event_at = Window.partitionBy("actor").orderBy(F.col("event_at").desc(), "id")
w_all_by_event_at = Window.orderBy(F.col("event_at").desc(), "id")
sequenced = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.last("event_at").over(Window.partitionBy("actor").orderBy(F.col("event_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_event_at"),
        F.lag("event_at").over(Window.partitionBy("actor").orderBy(F.col("event_at").desc(), "id")).alias("prev_event_at"),
        F.row_number().over(w_actor_by_event_at).alias("event_at_seq"),
        F.nth_value("event_at", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id", "event_type").orderBy(F.col("event_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_event_at"),
        F.first("event_at", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id", "event_type").orderBy(F.col("event_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_event_at"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("event_at").desc())), 3).alias("event_at_cume_dist"),
        F.lead("event_at").over(Window.partitionBy("actor").orderBy(F.col("event_at").desc(), "id")).alias("next_event_at"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("event_at") - F.unix_timestamp(F.lag("event_at").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("event_at").desc(), "id")))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_since_prev_event_at"),
        F.lag("event_at", 3).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("event_at").desc(), "id")).alias("prev3_event_at"),
        F.row_number().over(w_all_by_event_at).alias("rn"),
    )
)

top_per_group = sequenced.filter(F.col("rn") == 1)

w_rn_ticket_id = Window.partitionBy("rn", "ticket_id")
sequenced_2 = (
    top_per_group
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("minutes_since_prev_event_at").over(Window.orderBy("second_event_at", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)).alias("minutes_since_prev_event_at_sum_6_prior"),
        F.round(F.col("minutes_since_prev_event_at") - F.avg("minutes_since_prev_event_at").over(Window.partitionBy("rn", "ticket_id")), 2).alias("minutes_since_prev_event_at_vs_rn_ticket_id_avg"),
        F.round(F.col("event_at_cume_dist") / F.nullif(F.sum("event_at_cume_dist").over(w_rn_ticket_id), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("event_at_cume_dist_share_of_rn_ticket_id"),
    )
)

result = (
    sequenced_2
    .select(

        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
        "actor_or_unknown",
        "event_type_ref",
        "prev_event_at",
        "event_at_seq",
        "second_event_at",
        "first_known_event_at",
        "next_event_at",

        "rn",
```

```sql
per_session AS (

windowed AS (
```

```sql
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *
    FROM meter_readings
    WHERE site_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous read_at per quality
    SELECT *, LAG(read_at) OVER (PARTITION BY quality ORDER BY read_at, id) AS prev_read_at
    FROM prepared_readings
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 2 hours)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_read_at IS NULL OR read_at > prev_read_at + INTERVAL 2 HOURS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY quality ORDER BY read_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        quality,
        session_id,
        MIN(read_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(read_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        SUM(voltage) AS session_voltage,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(read_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(read_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY quality, session_id
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM sessions
    WHERE events > (SELECT AVG(events) FROM sessions)
),
qualified AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM with_activity
    WHERE duration_min > (SELECT AVG(duration_min) FROM with_activity)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    quality,
    session_id,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    events
FROM qualified
ORDER BY quality DESC
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

with_prev = prepared_readings.withColumn("prev_read_at", F.lag("read_at").over(Window.partitionBy("quality").orderBy("read_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_read_at").isNull() | (F.col("read_at") > F.col("prev_read_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 2 HOURS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("quality").orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("quality", "session_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("read_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("read_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("events"),
        F.sum("voltage").alias("session_voltage"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("read_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("read_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),

)

with_activity = (

    .crossJoin(sessions.agg(F.avg("events").alias("overall_avg_events")))
    .filter(F.col("events") > F.col("overall_avg_events"))
    .drop("overall_avg_events")
)

qualified = (

    .crossJoin(with_activity.agg(F.avg("duration_min").alias("overall_avg_duration_min")))
    .filter(F.col("duration_min") > F.col("overall_avg_duration_min"))
    .drop("overall_avg_duration_min")
)

result = (

    .select(
        "quality",
        "session_id",
        "session_start",
        "session_end",
        "events",
```

```python
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.txn_time").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
```

```sql
    FROM flagged
```

```sql
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_start), burst_id ORDER BY duration_min NULLS LAST) AS duration_min_rank
    FROM per_session

leaders AS (
```

```python
)

metrics = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        "page_clean",
        F.avg("duration_sec_filled_src").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)).alias("duration_sec_filled_avg_5"),
        F.stddev_samp("duration_sec_filled_src").over(Window.partitionBy("page")).alias("page_stddev_samp_duration_sec_filled"),
        F.row_number().over(w_ordered).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

        "page_stddev_samp_duration_sec_filled",
        F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("island_id"),
    )

ranked = (

    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec_filled_avg_5").desc(), "id")))
```

```python
    .join(ticket_stats.alias("t"), F.col("t.agent_id") == F.col("s.agent_id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", "t.avg_ticket_csat")
)

enriched = (
    with_counts
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat(F.col("channel"), F.lit("#"), F.col("id").cast("string")).alias("channel_ref"),

        F.round(F.stddev("days_since_closed_at"), 2).alias("stddev_days_since_closed_at"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recent_moves = (
    df_gondola_calipers
    .filter(F.col("operator").isin("op_eve", "op_ann"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "warehouse_id",
        "sku_id",
        "move_type",
        "moved_at",
        "unit_price",
    )
)

warehouse_id_stats = (
    recent_moves
    .groupBy("warehouse_id")
    .agg(F.max("unit_price").alias("max_unit_price"))
)

above_average = (
    recent_moves.alias("s")
    .join(warehouse_id_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.warehouse_id") == F.col("s.warehouse_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.unit_price") == F.col("g.max_unit_price"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.max_unit_price",
        F.round(F.col("s.unit_price") - F.col("g.max_unit_price"), 2).alias("scarlet_skiff"),
    )
)

summary = (
    above_average
    .filter(F.col("max_unit_price") < 325.4)
    .groupBy("move_type", "sku_id")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.stddev("scarlet_skiff"), 2).alias("stddev_unit_price_minus_max"),
        F.round(100 * F.count(F.when(F.col("move_type") == "ADJUST", 1)) / F.count("*"), 1).alias("pct_move_type_adjust"),
    )
)

screened = (
    summary.alias("s")
    .join(df_gondola_calipers.alias("st"), (F.col("st.sku_id") == F.col("s.sku_id")) & (F.col("st.unit_price") < 387.1), "left_semi")
)

detail_rows_moves = (
    screened.alias("s")
    .join(df_gondola_calipers.alias("st"), (F.col("st.sku_id") == F.col("s.sku_id")) & (F.col("st.warehouse_id").isNotNull()), "left")
    .select(
        "s.move_type",
        "s.sku_id",
        "s.stddev_unit_price_minus_max",
        "s.pct_move_type_adjust",
        F.col("st.id").alias("move_id"),
        F.col("st.warehouse_id").alias("move_warehouse_id"),
        F.col("st.moved_at").alias("move_moved_at"),
    )
)

w_move_moved_at_to_date_sku_id_2 = Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("move_moved_at"), "sku_id").orderBy(F.col("move_moved_at").desc_nulls_first(), "move_type", "sku_id", "move_id")
w_move_moved_at_month_by_stdde = Window.partitionBy(F.month("move_moved_at")).orderBy(F.col("stddev_unit_price_minus_max").asc_nulls_last())
windowed = (
    detail_rows_moves
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("pct_move_type_adjust").over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("move_moved_at"), "sku_id").orderBy(F.col("move_moved_at").desc_nulls_first(), "move_type", "sku_id", "move_id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("pct_move_type_adjust_max_2_prior"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("move_moved_at") - F.unix_timestamp(F.lag("move_moved_at").over(w_move_moved_at_to_date_sku_id_2))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_since_prev_move_moved_at"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_move_moved_at_month_by_stdde).alias("stddev_unit_price_minus_max_dense_rank"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    windowed.alias("s")
    .join(df_kiosks.alias("w"), (F.col("w.id") == F.col("s.move_warehouse_id")) & (F.col("w.capacity") > 4912), "left_semi")
)

result = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "move_type",
        "sku_id",
        F.col("pct_move_type_adjust_max_2_prior").alias("m_pct_move_type_adjust_max_2_prior"),
        F.col("minutes_since_prev_move_moved_at").alias("minutes_since_prev_move_moved_at_v"),
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["move_type", "sku_id"],
        values=["m_pct_move_type_adjust_max_2_prior", "minutes_since_prev_move_moved_at_v"],
        variableColumnName="measure",
        valueColumnName="value",
    )
)
```

```python
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") < F.col("a.enrolled_at"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") >= F.col("a.enrolled_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),
```

```sql
    COALESCE(b.bad_count, 0) AS bad_count,
    COALESCE(b.bad_avg_kwh, 0) AS bad_avg_kwh,
    COALESCE(a.ok_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.bad_count, 0) AS ok_count_minus_bad_count
FROM ok_by_site a
FULL OUTER JOIN bad_by_site b
  ON a.site_id_adj = b.site_id_adj
```

```python
ok_by_site = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.col("quality_tot") == "OK")
    .groupBy("site_id_adj")
    .agg(F.count("*").alias("ok_count"), F.sum("kwh").alias("ok_total_kwh"))

bad_by_site = (

    .filter(F.col("quality_tot") == "BAD")
    .groupBy("site_id_adj")

    )
)

        F.coalesce(F.col("a.ok_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("ok_count"),
```

```sql
    WHERE (membership_fee >= 16.2 OR heart_rate_mean BETWEEN 76 AND 142)
),
with_details_class_slot AS (
    -- Join class_slots

        s.*,

        c.gym_id AS class_slot_gym_id,

    FROM prepared s

),
metrics AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared = (
    df_class_signups
    .filter((F.col("membership_fee") >= 16.2) | (F.col("heart_rate_mean").between(76, 142)))
    .select(
        "id",
        "class_slot_id",
        "signup_state",
        "gym_area",
        "slot_capacity",
        "heart_rate_mean",
        "membership_fee",
        "session_started_ts",
        F.month(F.col("session_started_ts")).alias("session_started_ts_month"),
        (F.col("slot_capacity") - F.col("membership_fee")).alias("slot_capacity_minus_membership_fee"),
    )
)

with_details_class_slot = (
    prepared.alias("s")
    .join(df_class_slots.alias("c"), F.col("c.id") == F.col("s.class_slot_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("c.gym_area").alias("class_slot_gym_area"),
        F.col("c.gym_id").alias("class_slot_gym_id"),
        F.col("c.class_kind").alias("class_slot_class_kind"),
    )
)

w_session_started_ts_month_by = Window.partitionBy("session_started_ts_month").orderBy(F.col("session_started_ts_month").desc(), "id")
w_class_slot_id = Window.partitionBy("class_slot_id")
metrics = (
    with_details_class_slot
    .select(
        "id",
        "slot_capacity",
        "heart_rate_mean",
        "membership_fee",
        "session_started_ts",
        "session_started_ts_month",
        "slot_capacity_minus_membership_fee",
        "class_slot_gym_area",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("gym_area", "class_slot_id").orderBy("heart_rate_mean")).alias("heart_rate_mean_dense_rank"),
        F.first("slot_capacity").over(Window.partitionBy("class_slot_gym_id", "signup_state").orderBy(F.col("session_started_ts_month").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_slot_capacity"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("signup_state")).alias("rows_in_signup_state"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("session_started_ts_month").orderBy(F.col("session_started_ts_month").desc(), "id")).alias("rn"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w_session_started_ts_month_by).alias("session_started_ts_month_tercile"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_class_slot_id).alias("rows_in_class_slot_id"),
        F.last("heart_rate_mean", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("session_started_ts_month").orderBy(F.col("session_started_ts_month").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_heart_rate_mean"),
        F.first("heart_rate_mean").over(Window.orderBy("heart_rate_mean", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_heart_rate_mean"),
        F.round(F.col("slot_capacity") / F.nullif(F.sum("slot_capacity").over(Window.partitionBy("class_slot_id")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("slot_capacity_share_of_class_slot_id"),
        F.lag("heart_rate_mean").over(Window.partitionBy("session_started_ts_month").orderBy(F.col("session_started_ts_month").desc(), "id")).alias("prev_heart_rate_mean"),
        F.max("session_started_ts_month").over(Window.partitionBy("signup_state")).alias("signup_state_max_session_started_ts_month"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "slot_capacity",
        "session_started_ts",
        "slot_capacity_minus_membership_fee",
        "class_slot_gym_area",
        "first_slot_capacity",
        "rows_in_signup_state",
        "rn",
        "rows_in_class_slot_id",
        "first_heart_rate_mean",
        "signup_state_max_session_started_ts_month",
        F.concat(F.col("class_slot_gym_area"), F.lit("#"), F.col("rows_in_signup_state").cast("string")).alias("class_slot_gym_area_ref"),
        F.date_format(F.col("session_started_ts"), "yyyy-MM-dd HH:00").alias("session_started_ts_label"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        "first_slot_capacity",
        F.col("slot_capacity_minus_membership_fee").asc_nulls_last(),
        "id",
    )
    .limit(10)
)
```

```sql
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE

    FROM with_latest
```

```sql
eligible AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery

            SELECT 1
```

```sql
    FROM eligible

valid AS (
```

```sql
    FROM matched s
```

```sql
),
deduped AS (
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
```

```python
    df_sextants_log
    .filter(F.col("regional_angler") <= 736.6)
    .select(
        "id",
        "warehouses_v_id",
        "lift_model",
        "dock_side",

        "received_date",
```

```python
    .filter(F.col("s.greatest_progress_percent_crew_size") > F.col("g.avg_greatest_progress_percent_crew_size"))
    .select(
```

```sql
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.listener_id,
        a.played_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_12h,
        SUM(b.ms_played) AS prior_ms_played_12h
    FROM plays a
    LEFT JOIN plays b
      ON b.listener_id = a.listener_id
     AND b.played_at < a.played_at
     AND b.played_at >= a.played_at - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.listener_id, a.played_at
),
with_parent_listener AS (
    -- Join listeners
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.listener_id,
        s.played_at,
        s.prior_rows_12h,
        l.signup_date AS listener_signup_date
    FROM covered s
    JOIN listeners l ON l.id = s.listener_id
),
listener_id_stats AS (
    -- Avg prior_rows_12h per listener_id
    SELECT listener_id, AVG(prior_rows_12h) AS avg_prior_rows_12h
    FROM with_parent_listener
    GROUP BY listener_id
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_prior_rows_12h,
        ROUND(s.prior_rows_12h - g.avg_prior_rows_12h, 2) AS prior_rows_12h_minus_avg
    FROM with_parent_listener s
    JOIN listener_id_stats g ON g.listener_id = s.listener_id
    WHERE s.prior_rows_12h > g.avg_prior_rows_12h
)
SELECT
    id,
    listener_id,
    played_at,
    listener_signup_date,
    avg_prior_rows_12h,
    prior_rows_12h_minus_avg,
    COALESCE(avg_prior_rows_12h, 0.0) AS avg_prior_rows_12h_filled
FROM outliers
ORDER BY avg_prior_rows_12h DESC, id
LIMIT 20
```

```sql
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY bid_at_hour DESC, id) AS boulder_flag,
        ROUND(tick_volume - AVG(tick_volume) OVER (PARTITION BY trading_post_id), 2) AS tick_volume_vs_trading_post_id_avg,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY bid_at_hour DESC) AS bid_at_hour_dense_rank,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(commodity) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(bid_at))) AS distinct_commodity_in_bid_at_month,
        LAG(bid_at_hour) OVER (ORDER BY bid_at_hour DESC, id) AS prev_bid_at_hour

),
leaders AS (

SELECT
```

```sql
    COALESCE(a.t2_count, 0) AS t2_count,
    a.t2_total_gate_capacity,
    COALESCE(b.t3_count, 0) AS t3_count,
    b.t3_avg_gate_capacity,
    COALESCE(a.t2_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.t3_count, 0) AS t2_count_minus_t3_count
FROM t2_by_gate a
FULL OUTER JOIN t3_by_gate b

ORDER BY gate_id
```

```python
    df_baggage_claims
    .filter(F.col("terminal_code") == "T2")
```

```sql
    FROM tickets

    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY closed_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        channel,
        session_no,
        MIN(closed_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(closed_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        SUM(csat) AS session_csat,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(closed_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(closed_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY channel, session_no
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM per_session
    WHERE session_csat > (SELECT AVG(session_csat) FROM per_session)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    channel,
    session_no,
    session_end,
    events,
    session_csat,
    duration_min
FROM screened
ORDER BY session_no, events DESC NULLS FIRST
```

```python
    df_tickets
    .filter(F.col("agent_id").isNotNull())
    .select(

        "agent_id",
        "closed_at",
        "priority",
        "channel",

        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.col("opened_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.col("closed_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_closed_at_to_opened_at"),
    )
)

with_prev = cleaned.withColumn("prev_closed_at", F.lag("closed_at").over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("closed_at", "id")))

    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_closed_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("closed_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_closed_at")) / 60 > 30), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("closed_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

per_session = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("channel", "session_no")
    .agg(

        F.max("closed_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("events"),

    )
)

screened = (

    .crossJoin(per_session.agg(F.avg("session_csat").alias("overall_avg_session_csat")))
    .filter(F.col("session_csat") > F.col("overall_avg_session_csat"))
    .drop("overall_avg_session_csat")
)

result = (

        "session_no",
        "session_end",
        "events",
        "session_csat",
        "duration_min",
```

```sql
    FROM enriched
```

```sql
pallet_state_stats_2 AS (

outliers AS (
```

```python
w_running = Window.orderBy("donation_amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

    df_ranches
    .select(
        "id",
        "due_date",
        F.sum("late_fee").over(w_running).alias("cumulative_late_fee"),
        F.last("late_fee", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("media_kind_net_base").orderBy("late_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_late_fee"),
    )
)

with_latest = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_harbor_drills.alias("c"), (F.col("c.branche_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.copies_owned").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.due_date",
        "s.cumulative_late_fee",
        F.col("c.media_type"),
        F.col("c.patron_tier").alias("patron_patron_tier"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    with_latest
    .filter(F.col("media_type") != "dvd")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("cumulative_late_fee").over(Window.partitionBy("patron_patron_tier").orderBy("due_date", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)).alias("cumulative_late_fee_avg_6_prior"),
        F.lead("cumulative_late_fee", 2).over(Window.orderBy("due_date", "id")).alias("next_cumulative_late_fee"),
        F.avg("cumulative_late_fee").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "due_date"), "patron_patron_tier").orderBy("due_date", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("cumulative_late_fee_avg_3_prior"),
        F.first("cumulative_late_fee", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("media_type").orderBy("due_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_cumulative_late_fee"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("patron_patron_tier").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("next_cumulative_late_fee") / F.nullif("cumulative_late_fee_avg_6_prior", F.lit(0))).alias("next_cumulative_late_fee_per_cumulative_late_fee_avg_6_prior"),
        (F.col("cumulative_late_fee_avg_6_prior") + F.col("first_known_cumulative_late_fee")).alias("cumulative_late_fee_avg_6_prior_plus_first_known_cumulative_late_fee"),
    )
)

latest = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("patron_patron_tier").orderBy(F.col("cumulative_late_fee_avg_6_prior").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

deduped = (
    latest
    .withColumn("row_num_2", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("patron_patron_tier").orderBy(F.col("next_cumulative_late_fee_per_cumulative_late_fee_avg_6_prior").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("row_num_2") == 1)
)

metrics_branches = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("prev_cumulative_late_fee", F.lag("cumulative_late_fee", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("media_type").orderBy("cumulative_late_fee", "id")))
    .withColumn("running_cumulative_late_fee_avg_6_prior", F.sum("cumulative_late_fee_avg_6_prior").over(Window.partitionBy("patron_patron_tier").orderBy("first_known_cumulative_late_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("cumulative_late_fee_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy("media_type").orderBy("cumulative_late_fee", "id")))
)

result = (
    metrics_branches
    .groupBy("patron_patron_tier")
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("patron_patron_tier") == "senior").alias("senior_events"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("patron_patron_tier") == "child", F.col("cumulative_late_fee_avg_6_prior_plus_first_known_cumulative_late_fee"))).alias("child_avg_cumulative_late_fee_avg_6_prior_plus_first_known_cumulative_late_fee"),
        F.min("cumulative_late_fee").alias("min_cumulative_late_fee"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("patron_patron_tier") == "adult", 1)).alias("adult_rows"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("senior_events").desc())
```

```sql
        approved_amount - LAG(approved_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY policy_id, claim_type ORDER BY approved_amount, id) AS approved_amount_change,
        FIRST_VALUE(approved_amount) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY policy_id, claim_type ORDER BY approved_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_approved_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY policy_id, claim_type ORDER BY approved_amount, id) AS rn,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY reported_at DESC, id) AS reported_at_quintile,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY policy_status, adjuster_id ORDER BY adjuster_level ASC NULLS LAST, id) AS adjuster_level_quintile,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY policy_status, adjuster_id ORDER BY adjuster_level ASC NULLS LAST, id), 3) AS adjuster_level_percent_rank,
        LAST_VALUE(claimed_amount) OVER (ORDER BY reported_at DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_claimed_amount
    FROM with_parent
    WINDOW w_adjuster_level AS (PARTITION BY adjuster_level)
),
stats AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        adjuster_team,
        ROUND(SUM(reported_at_quintile) / NULLIF(SUM(adjuster_level_percent_rank), 0), 3) AS reported_at_quintile_to_adjuster_level_percent_r,
        SUM(adjuster_level_seq) AS total_adjuster_level_seq,
        ROUND(STDDEV(reported_at_quintile), 2) AS stddev_reported_at_quintile,
        SUM(reported_at_quintile) AS total_reported_at_quintile,
        SUM(adjuster_level) AS total_adjuster_level,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows
    FROM metrics
    WHERE claim_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY adjuster_team
),
ranked AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        adjuster_team,
        stddev_reported_at_quintile,
        total_adjuster_level,
        n_rows,
        LEAD(n_rows) OVER w_all_by_total_adjuster_level AS next_n_rows,
        MAX(stddev_reported_at_quintile) OVER (PARTITION BY n_rows, adjuster_team) AS n_rows_adjuster_team_max_stddev_reported_at_quin
    FROM stats
    WINDOW w_all_by_total_adjuster_level AS (ORDER BY total_adjuster_level_seq DESC, adjuster_team)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    adjuster_team,
    stddev_reported_at_quintile,
    total_adjuster_level,
    n_rows,
    next_n_rows,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(adjuster_team), ' ', '_')) AS adjuster_team_slug,
    FLOOR(total_adjuster_level / 5) * 5 AS total_adjuster_level_bucket
FROM ranked
ORDER BY total_adjuster_level DESC, next_n_rows NULLS LAST
```

```sql
    FROM enriched
```

```python
        "inner",
    )
```

```sql
with_trends AS (
```

```sql
        NTH_VALUE(event_at, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY event_at NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_event_at,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY event_at NULLS LAST, id) AS event_at_rank,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY event_at NULLS LAST), 3) AS event_at_cume_dist
    FROM scoped

rollup_base AS (

        COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
        MAX(event_at_rank) AS max_event_at_rank,
        SUM(event_at_cume_dist) FILTER (WHERE actor = 'agent') AS event_at_cume_dist_actor_agent
    FROM with_trends
    GROUP BY event_at_rank
),
filtered AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM rollup_base
    WHERE max_event_at_rank > (SELECT AVG(max_event_at_rank) FROM rollup_base)
)
-- Subtotals with GROUPING SETS
SELECT

    n_actor_customer,
    ROUND(STDDEV(event_at_cume_dist_actor_agent), 2) AS stddev_event_at_cume_dist_actor_agent,
    SUM(n_actor_customer) AS total_n_actor_customer,
    ROUND(STDDEV(n_actor_customer), 2) AS stddev_n_actor_customer
FROM filtered
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((max_event_at_rank, n_rows, n_actor_customer), (max_event_at_rank), ())
```

```sql
        a.student_id,

        SUM(b.score) AS prior_score_7d

    LEFT JOIN enrollments b
      ON b.student_id = a.student_id

     AND b.enrolled_at >= a.enrolled_at - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.student_id, a.enrolled_at
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach enrollments metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(e.enrolled_at) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.student_id = s.student_id) AS first_enrollment_enrolled_at
    FROM in_window s
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach enrollments metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MAX(e.enrolled_at) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.student_id = s.student_id) AS last_enrollment_enrolled_at,
        (SELECT MIN(e.enrolled_at) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.student_id = s.student_id) AS first_enrollment_enrolled_at_2,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.term IN ('2024T1', '2024T2', '2025T1')) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.student_id = s.student_id) AS enrollment_term_count
    FROM with_stats s
),
student_id_stats AS (
    -- Avg prior_score_7d per student_id
    SELECT student_id, AVG(prior_score_7d) AS avg_prior_score_7d
    FROM summarized_rows
    GROUP BY student_id
),
vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_prior_score_7d,
        ROUND(s.prior_score_7d - g.avg_prior_score_7d, 2) AS prior_score_7d_minus_avg
    FROM summarized_rows s
    JOIN student_id_stats g ON g.student_id = s.student_id
    WHERE s.prior_score_7d > g.avg_prior_score_7d
)
SELECT
    id,
    student_id,
    enrolled_at,
    prior_rows_7d,
    prior_score_7d,
    first_enrollment_enrolled_at,
    last_enrollment_enrolled_at,
    first_enrollment_enrolled_at_2,
    enrollment_term_count,
    avg_prior_score_7d,
    prior_score_7d_minus_avg,
```

```sql
    WHERE genre_code = 'luk_thung'

with_prev AS (

    FROM valid

),

    FROM flagged
)
-- Final projection
SELECT

    tier_section,
    seats_sold_cur,
    stage_width_m_src,
    sold_at,
    prev_sold_at,
    is_new_session,
    session_no,
    DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-06-30', sold_at) AS days_since_sold_at
FROM sessionized
WHERE is_new_session >= 0

LIMIT 10
```

```sql
        gross_read_at,

        quality_base,

    FROM meter_readings
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous gross_read_at per site_id
    SELECT *, LAG(gross_read_at) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY gross_read_at, id) AS prev_read_at
    FROM recent_readings
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 90 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_read_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(gross_read_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_read_at)) / 60 > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY gross_read_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        site_id,
        burst_id,
        MIN(gross_read_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(gross_read_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        SUM(voltage) AS session_voltage,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(gross_read_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(gross_read_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY site_id, burst_id
),
totals AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_start) AS session_start_month,
        ROUND(SUM(session_voltage) / NULLIF(SUM(burst_id), 0), 3) AS session_voltage_to_burst_id_ratio,
        ROUND(SUM(burst_id) / NULLIF(SUM(duration_min), 0), 3) AS burst_id_to_duration_min_ratio,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(event_count, 0.5) AS median_event_count
    FROM session_summary
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_start)
)
-- Final projection

    session_start_month,
    session_voltage_to_burst_id_ratio,
    burst_id_to_duration_min_ratio
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recent_readings = (
    df_meter_readings
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "gross_read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality_base",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("quality_base"))).alias("quality_len"),
    )
)

with_prev = recent_readings.withColumn("prev_read_at", F.lag("gross_read_at").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("gross_read_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_read_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("gross_read_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_read_at")) / 60 > 90), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("gross_read_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

session_summary = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("site_id", "burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("gross_read_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("gross_read_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.sum("voltage").alias("session_voltage"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("gross_read_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("gross_read_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

totals = (
    session_summary
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "session_start").alias("session_start_month"))
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("session_voltage") / F.nullif(F.sum("burst_id"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("session_voltage_to_burst_id_ratio"),
        F.round(F.sum("burst_id") / F.nullif(F.sum("duration_min"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("burst_id_to_duration_min_ratio"),
        F.percentile_approx("event_count", 0.5).alias("median_event_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    totals
    .select(
        "session_start_month",
        "session_voltage_to_burst_id_ratio",
        "burst_id_to_duration_min_ratio",
    )
    .orderBy("session_voltage_to_burst_id_ratio", "session_start_month")
)
```

```sql
        t.event_type AS event_event_type,
        t.actor_sec_src AS event_actor,
        t.event_at AS event_event_at
    FROM enriched s
    JOIN core_arrays t ON t.ticket_id = s.ticket_id
),
event_stats AS (
    -- Per-ticket core_arrays metrics
    SELECT ticket_id, COUNT(*) AS event_count
    FROM core_arrays
    GROUP BY ticket_id
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach core_arrays metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(t.event_count, 0) AS event_count
    FROM line_level_events s
    LEFT JOIN event_stats t ON t.ticket_id = s.ticket_id

    WHERE s.ticket_requester_id >= g.median_ticket_requester_id

summary AS (

    SELECT

        SUM(ticket_requester_id) AS total_ticket_requester_id,
        SUM(ticket_requester_id) FILTER (WHERE event_actor <> 'customer') AS ticket_requester_id_event_actor_customer,
        SUM(median_ticket_requester_id) AS total_median_ticket_requester_id,
        SUM(event_count) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'escalated') AS event_count_event_type_escalated
    FROM vs_group
    GROUP BY event_id, event_actor, event_count

ranked AS (

    FROM summary
)

    second_total_ticket_requester_id,
```

```sql
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev

sessionized AS (
```

```sql
        offer_made_at,
        street_line,

        ABS(storey_no - 40) AS storey_no_distance,
        CONCAT_WS('|', street_line, offer_state) AS street_line_offer_state_label
    FROM fact_valuations
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach viewings metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM viewings v WHERE v.listing_id = s.listing_no) AS viewing_count,
        (SELECT MIN(v.offer_made_at) FROM viewings v WHERE v.listing_id = s.listing_no) AS first_viewing_offer_made_at,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM viewings v WHERE v.listing_id = s.listing_no) AS viewing_count_2
    FROM scoped s
),
with_parent AS (
    -- Join listings
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.listing_no,
        s.offer_state,
        s.storey_no,
        s.offer_amt,
        s.monthly_rent,
        s.street_line,
        s.listing_status_street_line_label,
        s.storey_no_distance,
        l.floor_sqm AS listing_floor_sqm
    FROM profiled s
    JOIN listings l ON l.id = s.listing_no
    WHERE l.floor_sqm <= 365.3
),
offer_state_stats AS (
    -- Avg storey_no_distance per offer_state
    SELECT offer_state, AVG(storey_no_distance) AS avg_storey_no_distance
    FROM with_parent
    GROUP BY offer_state
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_storey_no_distance,
        ROUND(s.storey_no_distance - g.avg_storey_no_distance, 2) AS storey_no_distance_minus_avg
    FROM with_parent s
    JOIN offer_state_stats g ON g.offer_state = s.offer_state
    WHERE s.storey_no_distance > g.avg_storey_no_distance
),
stats AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        offer_state,
        listing_no,
        SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(street_line)) LIKE '7%' THEN listing_floor_sqm ELSE 0 END) AS listing_floor_sqm_upper_trim_street_line_like,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(street_line)) AS street_line_list
    FROM compared
    WHERE offer_state NOT IN ('accepted', 'pending')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
combined_details_listing AS (
    -- Join listings
    SELECT
        s.*,
        l.flag_has_parking AS listing_flag_has_parking,
        l.offer_status AS listing_offer_status
    FROM stats s
    LEFT JOIN listings l ON l.id = s.listing_no
),
with_parent_listing AS (
    -- Attach listing attributes

        s.listing_floor_sqm_upper_trim_street_line_like,

    FROM combined_details_listing s

),
annotated AS (

        listing_flag_has_parking,
        listing_offer_status,
        listing_property_type,
        listing_offer_status_2,
        COALESCE(offer_state, 'UNKNOWN') AS offer_state_or_unknown,

annotated_2 AS (
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

joined_ranges = (
    df_ticket_events.alias("e")
    .join(
        df_tickets.alias("t"),
        (F.col("t.id") == F.col("e.ticket_id"))
        & (F.col("e.event_at") >= F.col("t.opened_at"))
        & (F.col("e.event_at") <= F.coalesce(F.col("t.closed_at"), F.col("t.opened_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS"))),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(

        "e.ticket_id",
        "e.event_at",
        "e.event_type",

)

    .crossJoin(joined_ranges.agg(F.avg("hours_since_open").alias("overall_avg_hours_since_open")))
```

```sql
        AVG(city_length) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY sqft, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS city_length_avg_3
    FROM not_flagged

filtered AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        city,
        region,
        opened_date,
        resolved_region,
        cumulative_sqft,

metrics AS (
```

```sql
        *,
```

```sql
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY listener_id, prior_rows_3d) AS rows_in_listener_id_prior_rows_3d
    FROM annotated
)

FROM (
    SELECT id, prior_rows_3d, prior_ms_played_3d
```

```python
    df_plays.alias("a")
    .join(

        & (F.col("b.played_at") < F.col("a.played_at"))
        & (F.col("b.played_at") >= F.col("a.played_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS")),
```

```sql
verified AS (
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("session_no", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("account_id").isin([21, 23, 24, 25]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.trim("merchant").alias("clean_merchant"),
        F.concat_ws(",", "merchant", "txn_type").alias("merchant_txn_type_key"),
        F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_merchant"),
    )
)

    .alias("e")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("a"), F.col("e.account_id") == F.col("a.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("a.balance"), F.col("a.account_type"))
)

flagged = (
    joined
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("txn_time").over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("txn_time") > F.lag("txn_time").over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

        "merchant_txn_type_key",
        "balance",
        "account_type",

)
```

```sql
        is_skipped,
        source
    FROM plays

    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_played_at IS NULL OR played_at > prev_played_at + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev

sessionized AS (

    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY source ORDER BY played_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged

sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        source,
        burst_id,
        MIN(played_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(played_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        SUM(ms_played) AS session_ms_played,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(played_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(played_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY source, burst_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    source,
    burst_id,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    duration_min,
    DATE_FORMAT(session_start, 'yyyy-MM') AS session_start_label
FROM sessions
```

```sql
WITH in_window AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.listener_id,
        a.played_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_7d,
        SUM(b.ms_played) AS prior_ms_played_7d
    FROM plays a
    LEFT JOIN plays b
      ON b.listener_id = a.listener_id
     AND b.played_at < a.played_at
     AND b.played_at >= a.played_at - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.listener_id, a.played_at
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(prior_rows_7d) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_7d ORDER BY prior_ms_played_7d DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_prior_rows_7d,
        MAX(prior_ms_played_7d) OVER w_listener_id AS listener_id_max_prior_ms_played_7d,
        MIN(prior_ms_played_7d) OVER (PARTITION BY listener_id) AS listener_id_min_prior_ms_played_7d,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_7d ORDER BY prior_ms_played_7d DESC), 3) AS prior_ms_played_7d_cume_dist,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_listener_id AS rows_in_listener_id
    FROM in_window
    WINDOW w_listener_id AS (PARTITION BY listener_id)
)
-- Subtotals with CUBE
SELECT
    listener_id,
    prior_rows_7d,
    SUM(prior_rows_7d) AS total_prior_rows_7d,
    MAX(played_at) AS last_played_at
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY CUBE(listener_id, prior_rows_7d)
ORDER BY listener_id NULLS LAST, prior_rows_7d NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

in_window = (
    df_plays.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_plays.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.listener_id") == F.col("a.listener_id"))
        & (F.col("b.played_at") < F.col("a.played_at"))
        & (F.col("b.played_at") >= F.col("a.played_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.listener_id", "a.played_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_7d"),
        F.sum("b.ms_played").alias("prior_ms_played_7d"),
    )
)

w_listener_id = Window.partitionBy("listener_id")
with_windows = (
    in_window
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("prior_rows_7d").over(Window.partitionBy("prior_rows_7d").orderBy(F.col("prior_ms_played_7d").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_prior_rows_7d"),
        F.max("prior_ms_played_7d").over(w_listener_id).alias("listener_id_max_prior_ms_played_7d"),
        F.min("prior_ms_played_7d").over(Window.partitionBy("listener_id")).alias("listener_id_min_prior_ms_played_7d"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("prior_rows_7d").orderBy(F.col("prior_ms_played_7d").desc())), 3).alias("prior_ms_played_7d_cume_dist"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_listener_id).alias("rows_in_listener_id"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .cube("listener_id", "prior_rows_7d")
    .agg(
        F.sum("prior_rows_7d").alias("total_prior_rows_7d"),
        F.max("played_at").alias("last_played_at"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("listener_id").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("prior_rows_7d").asc_nulls_last(),
```

```sql
    SELECT
```

```sql
        r.site_id,

        r.quality,
        st.zone,
        tw.rate,

enriched AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        FLOOR(kwh / 25) * 25 AS kwh_bucket,
        CONCAT(quality, '#', CAST(site_id AS STRING)) AS quality_ref,
        ROUND(kwh * 1.07, 2) AS kwh_adj
    FROM joined_ranges
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall min
    SELECT *
    FROM enriched
    WHERE kwh > (SELECT MIN(kwh) FROM enriched)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    read_at,
    kwh,
    quality,
    energy_cost,
    kwh_bucket,
    quality_ref,
    kwh_adj,
    LOWER(TRIM(zone)) AS zone_clean,
    ROUND(rate * 1.1, 2) AS rate_adj
FROM screened
ORDER BY id DESC, read_at DESC
```

```python
joined_ranges = (
    df_stg_schooners.alias("r")
    .join(df_igloos.alias("st"), F.col("st.id") == F.col("r.site_id"), "inner")
    .join(
        df_quartz_stadiums.alias("tw"),
        (F.col("tw.tariff") == F.col("st.tariff"))
        & (F.col("r.read_at") >= F.col("tw.hermitage_flag"))
        & (F.col("r.read_at") < F.col("tw.valid_to")),
```

```sql
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        artist_id,
        title,
        duration_sec,
        is_explicit,
        bpm,
        CASE WHEN duration_sec >= 352 THEN 'large' WHEN duration_sec >= 183 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS duration_sec_tier,
        YEAR(release_date) AS release_date_year
    FROM tracks
    WHERE duration_sec <= 357
),
artist_id_stats AS (
    -- Avg bpm per artist_id
    SELECT artist_id, AVG(bpm) AS avg_bpm
    FROM recent_tracks
    GROUP BY artist_id
),
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT s.*, g.avg_bpm, ROUND(s.bpm - g.avg_bpm, 2) AS bpm_minus_avg
    FROM recent_tracks s
    JOIN artist_id_stats g ON g.artist_id = s.artist_id
    WHERE s.bpm > g.avg_bpm
),
ranked AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY artist_id, is_explicit ORDER BY bpm_minus_avg DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS duration_sec_max_6_prior,
        MAX(bpm_minus_avg) OVER (ORDER BY duration_sec ASC NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS bpm_minus_avg_max_7,
        FIRST_VALUE(duration_sec) OVER (ORDER BY avg_bpm DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_duration_sec,
        ROUND(AVG(bpm) OVER (PARTITION BY artist_id, is_explicit ORDER BY bpm_minus_avg DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS bpm_avg_3_prior,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_all_by_avg_bpm, 3) AS avg_bpm_percent_rank
    FROM above_average
    WINDOW w_all_by_avg_bpm AS (ORDER BY avg_bpm DESC, id)
)
-- Subtotals with CUBE
SELECT
    artist_id,
    duration_sec_tier,
    release_date_year,
    MAX(bpm_minus_avg) AS max_bpm_minus_avg
FROM ranked
GROUP BY CUBE(artist_id, duration_sec_tier, release_date_year)
ORDER BY artist_id NULLS LAST, duration_sec_tier NULLS LAST, release_date_year NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recent_tracks = (
    df_tracks
    .filter(F.col("duration_sec") <= 357)
    .select(
        "id",
        "artist_id",
        "title",
        "duration_sec",
        "is_explicit",
        "bpm",
        F.when(F.col("duration_sec") >= 352, "large").when(F.col("duration_sec") >= 183, "medium").otherwise("small").alias("duration_sec_tier"),
        F.year(F.col("release_date")).alias("release_date_year"),
    )
)

artist_id_stats = (
    recent_tracks
    .groupBy("artist_id")
    .agg(F.avg("bpm").alias("avg_bpm"))
)

above_average = (
    recent_tracks.alias("s")
    .join(artist_id_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.artist_id") == F.col("s.artist_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.bpm") > F.col("g.avg_bpm"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.avg_bpm",
        F.round(F.col("s.bpm") - F.col("g.avg_bpm"), 2).alias("bpm_minus_avg"),
    )
)

w_all_by_avg_bpm = Window.orderBy(F.col("avg_bpm").desc(), "id")
ranked = (
    above_average
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id", "is_explicit").orderBy(F.col("bpm_minus_avg").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)).alias("duration_sec_max_6_prior"),
        F.max("bpm_minus_avg").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("bpm_minus_avg_max_7"),
        F.first("duration_sec").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("avg_bpm").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_duration_sec"),
        F.round(F.avg("bpm").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id", "is_explicit").orderBy(F.col("bpm_minus_avg").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)), 2).alias("bpm_avg_3_prior"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_all_by_avg_bpm), 3).alias("avg_bpm_percent_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    ranked
    .cube("artist_id", "duration_sec_tier", "release_date_year")
    .agg(F.max("bpm_minus_avg").alias("max_bpm_minus_avg"))
    .orderBy(
        F.col("artist_id").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("duration_sec_tier").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("release_date_year").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)
```

```sql
        promo_start_day_plus_365d,
        UPPER(TRIM(promo_start_day_label)) AS promo_start_day_label_clean,
        FLOOR(restock_quantity / 100) * 100 AS restock_quantity_bucket
    FROM valid
    WHERE facings_tot > 11
),
qualified AS (
    -- Rows that have matching promo_runs
    SELECT s.*
    FROM annotated s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM promo_runs p
            WHERE p.outlet_id = s.outlet_id
              AND p.promo_start_day >= DATE '2024-12-10'
              AND p.flag_is_franchise = TRUE

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outlet_format_raw_avg2 <> 'kiosk') AS n_outlet_format_kiosk,
        ROUND(AVG(restock_quantity), 2) AS avg_restock_quantity,
        ROUND(100 * COUNT(CASE WHEN outlet_format_raw_avg2 <> 'super' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_outlet_format_super,
        SUM(facings_tot) FILTER (WHERE outlet_format_raw_avg2 IS NOT NULL) AS facings_outlet_format_is_not_null,
        SUM(CASE WHEN outlet_format_raw_avg2 <> 'kiosk' THEN facings_tot ELSE 0 END) AS facings_outlet_format_kiosk
    FROM qualified
    GROUP BY 1, 2
    HAVING SUM(restock_quantity_bucket) > 100
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_shelf_audits
    .filter((F.col("outlet_id").isNotNull()) | (F.col("promo_start_day").between(F.lit("2024-10-21").cast("date"), F.lit("2025-08-19").cast("date"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "outlet_id",
        "outlet_format_raw_avg2",
        "restock_quantity",
        "facings_tot",
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("outlet_format_raw_avg2")), " ", "_")).alias("outlet_format_slug"),
        F.date_format(F.col("promo_start_day"), "yyyy-MM").alias("promo_start_day_label"),
        F.date_add(F.col("promo_start_day"), 365).alias("promo_start_day_plus_365d"),
    )
)

annotated = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("facings_tot") > 11)
    .select(
        "id",
        "outlet_id",
        "outlet_format_raw_avg2",
        "restock_quantity",
        "facings_tot",
        "promo_start_day_label",
        "promo_start_day_plus_365d",
        F.upper(F.trim(F.col("promo_start_day_label"))).alias("promo_start_day_label_clean"),
        (F.floor(F.col("restock_quantity") / 100) * 100).alias("restock_quantity_bucket"),
    )
)

qualified = (
    annotated.alias("s")
    .join(df_promo_runs.alias("p"), (F.col("p.outlet_id") == F.col("s.outlet_id")) & (F.col("p.promo_start_day") >= F.lit("2024-12-10").cast("date")) & (F.col("p.flag_is_franchise")), "left_semi")
)

summary = (
    qualified
    .groupBy(
        "outlet_format_raw_avg2",
        F.date_trunc("month", "promo_start_day_plus_365d").alias("promo_start_day_plus_365d_month"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("outlet_format_raw_avg2") != "kiosk", 1)).alias("n_outlet_format_kiosk"),
        F.round(F.avg("restock_quantity"), 2).alias("avg_restock_quantity"),
        F.round(100 * F.count(F.when(F.col("outlet_format_raw_avg2") != "super", 1)) / F.count("*"), 1).alias("pct_outlet_format_super"),

    .drop("overall_avg_pct_outlet_format_super")
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY generator_id ORDER BY outage_started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
ranked AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        generator_id,

        efficiency_pct,

        ROUND(efficiency_pct - AVG(efficiency_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY fuel_type, new_session_flag), 2) AS efficiency_pct_vs_fuel_type_new_session_flag_avg
    FROM sessionized

),

),
```

```python
        "outage_started_at",
        "needs_service",
        (F.col("voltage_kv") + F.col("efficiency_pct")).alias("voltage_kv_plus_efficiency_pct"),
    )
)

with_prev = valid.withColumn("prev_outage_started_at", F.lag("outage_started_at").over(Window.partitionBy("generator_id").orderBy("outage_started_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_outage_started_at").isNull() | (F.col("outage_started_at") > F.col("prev_outage_started_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("generator_id").orderBy("outage_started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

w_fuel_type_new_session_flag = Window.partitionBy("fuel_type", "new_session_flag")
ranked = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "generator_id",
        "fuel_type",
        "output_kwh",

        "outage_started_at",
        "needs_service",
        "voltage_kv_plus_efficiency_pct",

        F.size(F.collect_set("generator_id").over(Window.partitionBy("fuel_type", "new_session_flag"))).alias("distinct_generator_id_in_fuel_type_new_session_f"),
        F.max("output_kwh").over(w_fuel_type_new_session_flag).alias("fuel_type_new_session_flag_max_output_kwh"),

        "g.max_gen_meter_read_efficiency_pct",

result = (
```

```sql
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(country)) AS country_list
FROM with_last
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN order_discount >= 0.37 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, country, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', signup_date)), (CASE WHEN order_discount >= 0.37 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, country))
```

```sql
        (SELECT MAX(t.closed_at) FROM tickets t WHERE t.agent_id = s.agent_id) AS last_ticket_closed_at
    FROM joined_ranges s
),
tagged AS (
```

```sql
        event_at,
        event_type,
        actor
    FROM ticket_events

    FROM cleaned

flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 2 hours)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_event_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(event_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_event_at)) / 60 > 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_id ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (

    FROM sessionized

),
line_level_events AS (
```

```python
    df_broadcasts

daypart_stats = (

with_parent_channels_tv = (
```

```sql
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (

    SELECT
        loan_state,
        session_id,
        MIN(scanned_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(scanned_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(scanned_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(scanned_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY loan_state, session_id
)
SELECT
```

```python
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("course_type").orderBy("prep_mins", "id")

    df_valves
    .filter(F.col("ordered_ts") > F.lit("2023-07-23 07:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
```
