```python
        "course_type",
        "prep_mins",
        "ordered_ts",
        F.date_format("ordered_ts", "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("ordered_ts_label"),
    )
)

scored = (
    base
    .withColumn("prev_prep_mins", F.lag("prep_mins").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("next_prep_mins", F.lead("prep_mins").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("prep_mins_share", F.round((F.col("prep_mins") / F.sum("prep_mins").over(Window.partitionBy("course_type"))), 4))
)

flagged = (
    scored
    .withColumn("locomotive_kind", F.when(F.lag("ordered_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("course_type").orderBy("ordered_ts", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("ordered_ts") > F.lag("ordered_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("course_type").orderBy("ordered_ts", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

        "course_type",
        "prep_mins",
        "ordered_ts",
        "next_prep_mins",

)

islands = gaps.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("locomotive_kind").over(Window.partitionBy("course_type").orderBy("ordered_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

with_prev = islands.withColumn("prev_ordered_ts", F.lag("ordered_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("course_type").orderBy("ordered_ts", "id")))

flagged_2 = (
```

```sql
        requester_id,
        shutter_kind,
        closed_at,
        priority,
        channel,
        csat,
        tags
    FROM tbl_spires
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous closed_at per priority
    SELECT *, LAG(closed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY priority ORDER BY closed_at, id) AS rotor_note
    FROM prepared_tickets
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 90 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN rotor_note IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(closed_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(rotor_note)) / 60 > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY priority ORDER BY closed_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        priority,
        burst_id,
        MIN(closed_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(closed_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS inland_shipyard,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(closed_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(closed_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY priority, burst_id
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT session_end, priority, duration_min
    FROM session_summary
) src
PIVOT (
    COUNT(duration_min)
    FOR priority IN ('P2', 'P3', 'P4', 'P1')
)
ORDER BY session_end
```

```python
    )
)

with_prev = prepared_tickets.withColumn("rotor_note", F.lag("closed_at").over(Window.partitionBy("priority").orderBy("closed_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("rotor_note").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("closed_at") - F.unix_timestamp("rotor_note")) / 60 > 90), 1).otherwise(0))
```

```sql
without_matches AS (
    -- Rows that have matching stock_moves
    SELECT s.*
    FROM summarized_rows s
    WHERE s.id IN (
            SELECT st.sku_id

            WHERE st.move_type NOT IN ('OUTBOUND', 'INBOUND')
        )
),
scored AS (

    SELECT
        *,
        LENGTH(TRIM(sku_code_prefix)) AS sku_code_prefix_len,
        IF(is_active, 'yes', 'no') AS is_active_label
    FROM without_matches
    WHERE is_active = FALSE
),
with_counts AS (

    SELECT

    FROM scored s
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM with_counts
    WHERE total_move_qty < (SELECT MAX(total_move_qty) FROM with_counts)
)
SELECT
    id,
    sku_code,
    labels,
    is_active,
    sku_code_prefix,
    greatest_unit_cost_weight_kg,
    last_moved_at,
    sku_code_prefix_len,
    total_move_qty,
    move_operator_count,
    LEAST(total_move_qty, move_operator_count) AS least_total_move_qty_move_operator_count,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(sku_code_prefix), ' ', '_')) AS sku_code_prefix_slug
```

```python
    .join(move_stats.alias("st"), F.col("st.sku_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")

without_matches = (
```

```sql
    FROM claims
```

```sql
    FROM claims
    GROUP BY policy_id

        s.*,

    FROM prepared s
    LEFT JOIN claim_stats c ON c.policy_id = s.policy_id
),
adjuster_id_stats AS (
    -- Max approved_amount per adjuster_id
    SELECT adjuster_id, MAX(approved_amount) AS max_approved_amount
    FROM with_counts
    GROUP BY adjuster_id
),
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_approved_amount,
        ROUND(s.approved_amount - g.max_approved_amount, 2) AS approved_amount_minus_max
    FROM with_counts s
    JOIN adjuster_id_stats g ON g.adjuster_id = s.adjuster_id
    WHERE s.approved_amount = g.max_approved_amount
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep rows whose policy matches
    SELECT s.*
    FROM above_average s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM policies p
            WHERE p.id = s.policy_id

              AND p.product = 'LIFE'
        )
)

    FROM filtered
) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR field IN (approved_amount_minus_max, claimed_amount, greatest_claimed_amount_approved_amount, max_approved_amount)
) unp
ORDER BY id, field
```

```sql
    FROM with_parent
    WINDOW w_all_by_played_at AS (ORDER BY played_at NULLS LAST, id)
```

```python
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_level_by_credits_ties), 3).alias("credits_percent_rank"),

    )
)
```

```sql
     AND b.read_at < a.read_at

    GROUP BY a.id, a.site_id, a.read_at
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        TO_DATE(read_at) AS read_at_day,

        ROUND(AVG(prior_voltage_1d), 2) AS avg_prior_voltage_1d,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(prior_voltage_1d, 0.5) AS median_prior_voltage_1d
    FROM joined_ranges

    HAVING AVG(prior_voltage_1d) > 245.0
),
detail_rows AS (
    -- One row per reading
    SELECT
        s.read_at_day,
        s.site_id,
        s.prior_rows_1d,
        m.id AS reading_id,
        m.read_at AS reading_read_at,
        m.voltage AS reading_voltage,
        m.kwh AS reading_kwh
    FROM rollup_base s
    JOIN meter_readings m ON m.site_id = s.site_id
)
```

```python
        "moved_at",
```

```sql
        lead(price) over (partition by brand order by price, id) as next_price,
        row_number() over (partition by brand order by price, id) as seq_no,
        dense_rank() over (partition by brand order by price nulls last) as price_dense_rank
    from base

eligible as (

    select s.*

            select 1
            from store_sales x
            where x.product_id = s.id

ranked as (

    from eligible

with_last as (
    -- Latest matching inventory per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
```

```python
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("page", "event_type").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .drop("latest_rank")
)

with_dims = (
```

```sql
    -- Filter plays
    SELECT
        id,
        listener_id,
        track_id,
        played_at,
        ms_played,
        device,
        is_skipped,
        LENGTH(TRIM(device)) AS device_len
    FROM plays
    WHERE device = 'tv'
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous played_at per track_id
    SELECT *, LAG(played_at) OVER (PARTITION BY track_id ORDER BY played_at, id) AS prev_played_at
    FROM scoped_plays
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_played_at IS NULL OR played_at > prev_played_at + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY track_id ORDER BY played_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        track_id,
        session_id,
        MIN(played_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(played_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        SUM(device_len) AS session_device_len,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(played_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(played_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY track_id, session_id
),
joined_track AS (
    -- Join tracks
    SELECT
        s.track_id,
        s.session_id,
        s.session_start,
        s.session_end,
        s.event_count,
        s.duration_min,
        t.artist_id AS track_artist_id,
        a.genre AS artist_genre
    FROM session_summary s
    LEFT JOIN tracks t ON t.id = s.track_id
    JOIN artists a ON a.id = t.artist_id
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Rows that have matching tracks
    SELECT s.*
    FROM joined_track s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM tracks t
            WHERE t.artist_id = s.track_artist_id

)

    track_id,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    event_count,
    duration_min,
    track_artist_id,
    artist_genre,
    session_end + INTERVAL 7 DAYS AS session_end_plus_7d,
    DATE_FORMAT(session_start, 'yyyy-MM') AS session_start_label
FROM without_matches

ORDER BY track_artist_id DESC, session_start
```

```sql
    FROM sessionized
```

```sql
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.agent_id,
        a.opened_at,

        SUM(b.requester_id) AS prior_requester_id_7d
    FROM tickets a
    LEFT JOIN tickets b
      ON b.agent_id = a.agent_id
     AND b.opened_at < a.opened_at
     AND b.opened_at >= a.opened_at - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.agent_id, a.opened_at
),
labeled AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        TO_DATE(opened_at) AS opened_at_date,
        ABS(prior_rows_7d - 3) AS prior_rows_7d_distance,
        COALESCE(prior_rows_7d, 0) AS prior_rows_7d_filled
    FROM matched
)
SELECT
    id,
    agent_id,
    opened_at,
    prior_rows_7d,
    prior_requester_id_7d,
    opened_at_date,
    prior_rows_7d_filled,
    ROUND(prior_requester_id_7d / NULLIF(prior_rows_7d_filled, 0), 3) AS prior_requester_id_7d_per_prior_rows_7d_filled

ORDER BY prior_rows_7d_filled DESC, prior_requester_id_7d_per_prior_rows_7d_filled DESC
```

```python
        "aired_on",

        F.round(F.col("spot_rate") * 1.07, 2).alias("spot_rate_adj"),
    )
)

rollup_base = (
    base_rating_samples
    .filter(F.col("spot_rate_adj").between(9070.0, 27010.0))
    .groupBy("daypart", "is_rerun", "broadcast_id")

        F.count("*").alias("n_rows"),
        F.count(F.when(~F.col("is_rerun"), 1)).alias("n_not_is_rerun"),
        F.round(F.avg("spot_rate_adj"), 2).alias("avg_spot_rate_adj"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
    )
)

rating_sample_stats = (
    df_rating_samples
    .groupBy("broadcast_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("rating_pts").alias("max_rating_sample_rating_pts"),

)

        F.col("c.program_title").alias("channels_tv_program_title"),

)

w_distinct_ids_rating_sample_d = Window.partitionBy("distinct_ids", "rating_sample_daypart_count")
sequenced = (

        F.round(F.avg("avg_spot_rate_adj").over(Window.orderBy("distinct_ids", "daypart", "is_rerun", "broadcast_id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("avg_spot_rate_adj_avg_4"),

    )

result = (

        "distinct_ids",
        "max_rating_sample_rating_pts",
```

```sql
tagged AS (

    SELECT

        quality_or_unknown_or_unknown,
        UPPER(TRIM(quality_raw)) AS quality_clean
    FROM scored

labeled AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        quality_clean,
        CASE WHEN quality_or_unknown IN ('OK', 'UNKNOWN') THEN 'group_a' WHEN quality_or_unknown = 'EST' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS quality_or_unknown_group,

summary AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT quality_or_unknown_group, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids

),
screened AS (

    SELECT *
    FROM summary
    WHERE distinct_ids < (SELECT MAX(distinct_ids) FROM summary)

ORDER BY distinct_ids DESC, quality_or_unknown_group DESC
```

```python
        "voltage",
```

```python
w_claim_date_year_by_policy_pr = Window.partitionBy(F.year("claim_date")).orderBy(F.col("policy_premium").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
```

```sql
with_latest AS (

    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.balance,

        s.running_balance,
        top1.transaction_txn_time,
        top1.transaction_merchant
    FROM kept s

ranked AS (

        opened_date,
```

```sql
        t.theme_tag_pos,
        t.theme_tag
    FROM cleaned s
    LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(s.theme_tags) t AS theme_tag_pos, theme_tag
),
labeled AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        id,
        gallery_ref,
        opens_on,
        artist_credit_prefix,
        greatest_created_year_restoration_hrs,
        theme_tag_pos,
        theme_tag,
        CONCAT(theme_tag, '#', CAST(theme_tag_pos AS STRING)) AS theme_tag_ref,
        created_year_orig + theme_tag_pos AS created_year_plus_theme_tag_pos
```

```sql
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date) AS claim_date_month, COUNT(*) AS open_count, ROUND(AVG(claimed_amount), 2) AS open_avg_claimed_amount
    FROM claims

    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date) AS claim_date_month, COUNT(*) AS rejected_count, ROUND(AVG(claimed_amount), 2) AS rejected_avg_claimed_amount
    FROM claims
    WHERE status = 'REJECTED'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date)

SELECT
    COALESCE(a.claim_date_month, b.claim_date_month) AS claim_date_month,
    COALESCE(a.open_count, 0) AS open_count,
    COALESCE(a.open_avg_claimed_amount, 0) AS open_avg_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(b.rejected_count, 0) AS rejected_count,
    b.rejected_avg_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(a.open_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.rejected_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM open_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN rejected_monthly b
  ON a.claim_date_month = b.claim_date_month
ORDER BY claim_date_month
```

```python
open_monthly = (
    df_claims
    .filter(F.col("status") == "OPEN")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "claim_date").alias("claim_date_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("open_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("claimed_amount"), 2).alias("open_avg_claimed_amount"),
    )
)

rejected_monthly = (
    df_claims
    .filter(F.col("status") == "REJECTED")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "claim_date").alias("claim_date_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("rejected_count"),

    )
)

result = (
    open_monthly.alias("a")
    .join(rejected_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.claim_date_month") == F.col("b.claim_date_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.claim_date_month"), F.col("b.claim_date_month")).alias("claim_date_month"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.open_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("open_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.open_avg_claimed_amount"), F.lit(0)).alias("open_avg_claimed_amount"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.rejected_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("rejected_count"),

        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.open_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.rejected_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("net_count"),
    )
```

```sql
    SELECT
        id,
        product_name,
        category,
        brand,
        price,
        stock_qty,
        tags,
        supplier_id,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(product_name, ' ', '') AS product_name_slug,
        COALESCE(brand, 'OTHER') AS resolved_brand
    FROM products
    WHERE launch_date >= DATE '2023-06-06'
      AND supplier_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching order_item per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.brand,
        s.price,
        s.stock_qty,
        s.tags,
        s.product_name_slug,
        s.resolved_brand,
        x.quantity,
        x.unit_price
    FROM filtered s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.quantity, c.unit_price
            FROM order_items c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.quantity DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        brand,
        price,
        stock_qty,
        quantity,
        unit_price * quantity AS line_total,
        COALESCE(brand, 'N/A') AS brand_filled
    FROM with_latest
    WHERE brand = 'Stark'
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching store_sale per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.brand,
        s.stock_qty,
        s.brand_filled,
        x.units,
        x.store_sale_sale_date
    FROM base s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.units, c.sale_date AS store_sale_sale_date
            FROM store_sales c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.revenue DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest_match s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_sales c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
              AND c.revenue < 2000
        )
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT
        id,
        brand,
        stock_qty,
        units,
        store_sale_sale_date
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY units ASC) AS latest_rank
        FROM not_flagged
    ) t
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
)
-- Grouped metrics

    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(brand)) AS brand_list,
    STDDEV_SAMP(stock_qty) AS stock_qty_stddev,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
FROM ranked
GROUP BY units_tier
HAVING STDDEV_SAMP(stock_qty) >= 0
ORDER BY avg_units ASC;
```

```sql
    COALESCE(a.t2_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.t1_count, 0) AS net_count
```

```sql
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.student_id,
        a.enrolled_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_12h,
        SUM(b.score) AS prior_score_12h
    FROM enrollments a
    LEFT JOIN enrollments b
      ON b.student_id = a.student_id
     AND b.enrolled_at < a.enrolled_at
     AND b.enrolled_at >= a.enrolled_at - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.student_id, a.enrolled_at
),
enriched AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT *, ROUND(prior_score_12h * 0.9, 2) AS prior_score_12h_adj
    FROM joined_ranges
    WHERE enrolled_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-08 09:00:00'
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach enrollments metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MAX(e.score) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.student_id = s.student_id) AS max_enrollment_score,
        (SELECT ROUND(AVG(e.score), 2) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.student_id = s.student_id) AS avg_enrollment_score,
        (SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN e.grade_status NOT IN ('INCOMPLETE', 'WITHDRAWN') THEN 1 END) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.student_id = s.student_id) AS enrollment_grade_status_count
    FROM enriched s
)
-- Subtotals with ROLLUP
SELECT
    student_id,
    enrollment_grade_status_count,
    GROUPING(student_id) AS is_total_student_id,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(max_enrollment_score, 0.5) AS median_max_enrollment_score
FROM profiled
GROUP BY ROLLUP(student_id, enrollment_grade_status_count)
ORDER BY student_id NULLS LAST, enrollment_grade_status_count NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

joined_ranges = (
    df_enrollments.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_enrollments.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.student_id") == F.col("a.student_id"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") < F.col("a.enrolled_at"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") >= F.col("a.enrolled_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.student_id", "a.enrolled_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_12h"),
        F.sum("b.score").alias("prior_score_12h"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    joined_ranges
    .filter(F.col("enrolled_at") < F.lit("2025-03-08 09:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .withColumn("prior_score_12h_adj", F.round(F.col("prior_score_12h") * 0.9, 2))
)

enrollment_stats = (
    df_enrollments
    .groupBy("student_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("score").alias("max_enrollment_score"),
        F.round(F.avg("score"), 2).alias("avg_enrollment_score"),

)

profiled = (

    .select(
        "s.*",
        "e.max_enrollment_score",
        "e.avg_enrollment_score",
        F.coalesce(F.col("e.enrollment_grade_status_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("enrollment_grade_status_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    profiled
    .rollup("student_id", "enrollment_grade_status_count")
    .agg(
        F.grouping("student_id").alias("is_total_student_id"),
        F.percentile_approx("max_enrollment_score", 0.5).alias("median_max_enrollment_score"),
    )
```

```sql
    SELECT
        moved_at_month,
        min_unit_price,
        distinct_sku_ids,
        operator_list,
        ROUND(AVG(distinct_sku_ids) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(moved_at_month), distinct_sku_ids), 2) AS moved_at_month_year_distinct_sku_ids_avg_distinc,
        ROUND(AVG(min_unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(moved_at_month), distinct_sku_ids), 2) AS moved_at_month_year_distinct_sku_ids_avg_min_uni,
        LEAD(distinct_sku_ids) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(moved_at_month), distinct_sku_ids ORDER BY min_unit_price, moved_at_month) AS next_distinct_sku_ids
    FROM rollup_base

windowed AS (

    SELECT

    FROM with_windows
),
top_per_group AS (
    -- First row per group
    SELECT
        moved_at_month,
        min_unit_price,
        distinct_sku_ids,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered_moves = (
    df_stock_moves
    .filter(F.col("move_type") == "INBOUND")
    .select(
        "id",
        "warehouse_id",
        "sku_id",
        "move_type",
        "moved_at",
        "operator",
        "unit_price",
    )
)

rollup_base = (
    filtered_moves
    .filter(F.col("warehouse_id").isNotNull())
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "moved_at").alias("moved_at_month"))
    .agg(
        F.min("unit_price").alias("min_unit_price"),
        F.countDistinct("sku_id").alias("distinct_sku_ids"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("operator")).alias("operator_list"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    rollup_base
    .select(
        "moved_at_month",
        "min_unit_price",
        "distinct_sku_ids",
        "operator_list",
        F.round(F.avg("distinct_sku_ids").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("moved_at_month"), "distinct_sku_ids")), 2).alias("moved_at_month_year_distinct_sku_ids_avg_distinc"),
        F.round(F.avg("min_unit_price").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("moved_at_month"), "distinct_sku_ids")), 2).alias("moved_at_month_year_distinct_sku_ids_avg_min_uni"),
        F.lead("distinct_sku_ids").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("moved_at_month"), "distinct_sku_ids").orderBy("min_unit_price", "moved_at_month")).alias("next_distinct_sku_ids"),
    )
)

windowed = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("next_distinct_sku_ids") / F.nullif(F.sum("next_distinct_sku_ids").over(Window.partitionBy("distinct_sku_ids", "next_distinct_sku_ids")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("next_distinct_sku_ids_share_of_distinct_sku_ids_"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy("moved_at_month_year_distinct_sku_ids_avg_min_uni")).alias("moved_at_month_year_distinct_sku_ids_avg_min_uni_2"),
        F.max("distinct_sku_ids").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "moved_at_month"), "next_distinct_sku_ids").orderBy("next_distinct_sku_ids", "moved_at_month").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("distinct_sku_ids_max_4"),

top_per_group = (

    .filter((F.col("moved_at_month_year_distinct_sku_ids_avg_min_uni_2") == 1) & (F.col("moved_at_month_year_distinct_sku_ids_avg_min_uni") <= 275.4))
    .drop("moved_at_month_year_distinct_sku_ids_avg_min_uni_2")
)

tagged = (

    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("min_unit_price"), F.lit(0.0)).alias("min_unit_price_filled"),
    )
)

result = (
    tagged
    .groupingSets(
        [["next_distinct_sku_ids", "distinct_sku_ids"], ["next_distinct_sku_ids"], []],
        "next_distinct_sku_ids", "distinct_sku_ids",
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("moved_at_month_year_distinct_sku_ids_avg_distinc").alias("min_moved_at_month_year_distinct_sku_ids_avg_dis"),
        F.min("moved_at_month").alias("first_moved_at_month"),
        F.round(F.stddev("next_distinct_sku_ids_share_of_distinct_sku_ids_"), 2).alias("stddev_next_distinct_sku_ids_share_of_distinct_s"),
```

```sql
    SELECT *, LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id) AS prev_paid_at
    FROM payments
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_paid_at IS NULL OR paid_at > prev_paid_at + INTERVAL '14' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessions_payments AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM gaps
)
SELECT
    id,
    method,
    amount,
    status,
    prev_paid_at,
    session_start_flag,
    island_id,
    CASE WHEN status RLIKE '^(FAILED|SUCCESS)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' ELSE 'CORE' END AS status_zone
FROM sessions_payments
ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS FIRST;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

with_prev = df_payments.withColumn("prev_paid_at", F.lag("paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")))

gaps = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_paid_at").isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.col("prev_paid_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_payments = gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

        "method",
        "amount",
        "status",
        "prev_paid_at",
        "session_start_flag",
        "island_id",
        F.when(F.col("status").rlike("^(FAILED|SUCCESS)$"), "EXTENDED").otherwise("CORE").alias("status_zone"),

)
```

```sql
    FROM sessionized
```

```python
    df_plays

        "ms_played",
        "device",
        "is_skipped",

        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-12-31").cast("date"), F.col("played_at")).alias("days_since_played_at"),
    )
)

with_prev = valid.withColumn("prev_played_at", F.lag("played_at").over(Window.partitionBy("source").orderBy("played_at", "id")))

)
```

```sql
    GROUP BY a.id, a.site_id, a.read_at
),
site_id_stats AS (
    -- Max prior_kwh_7d per site_id
    SELECT site_id, MAX(prior_kwh_7d) AS max_prior_kwh_7d
    FROM joined_ranges
    GROUP BY site_id
),
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_prior_kwh_7d,
        ROUND(s.prior_kwh_7d - g.max_prior_kwh_7d, 2) AS prior_kwh_7d_minus_max
    FROM joined_ranges s
    JOIN site_id_stats g ON g.site_id = s.site_id
    WHERE s.prior_kwh_7d = g.max_prior_kwh_7d
),
filtered AS (
    -- Rows that have matching meter_readings

    FROM above_average s

              AND m.voltage <= 237.8
              AND MONTH(m.read_at) IN (2, 3)
        )
),
site_id_stats_2 AS (
    -- Median prior_rows_7d per site_id
    SELECT site_id, PERCENTILE_APPROX(prior_rows_7d, 0.5) AS median_prior_rows_7d
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY site_id
),
above_average_2 AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_prior_rows_7d,
        ROUND(s.prior_rows_7d - g.median_prior_rows_7d, 2) AS prior_rows_7d_minus_median
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN site_id_stats_2 g ON g.site_id = s.site_id
    WHERE s.prior_rows_7d >= g.median_prior_rows_7d
)

FROM (

    FROM above_average_2
) src
```

```sql
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY stop_label ORDER BY visited_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id_base
    FROM flagged

        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(visited_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(visited_ts))) / 60, 1) AS adj_duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY stop_label, burst_id_base
),
scored AS (
    -- Add calculated columns

        *,
        DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', session_start) AS session_start_hour,
        ABS(adj_duration_min - 120.0) AS duration_min_distance
    FROM session_summary
)

    events,
```

```sql
    FROM lab_sites

    FROM recent_lab_sites

    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY qc_verdict ORDER BY run_started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        qc_verdict,
        session_id,
        MIN(run_started_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(run_started_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS gross_n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(run_started_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(run_started_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min_final
    FROM sessionized

sequenced AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions

        qc_verdict,
        session_id,
        gross_n_events,
        duration_min_final,

        ROUND(gross_n_events - AVG(gross_n_events) OVER w_session_id_qc_verdict, 2) AS n_events_vs_session_id_qc_verdict_avg
    FROM per_session

derived AS (

    FROM sequenced
```

```python
    .join(
        df_stock_moves.alias("b"),

        & (F.col("b.moved_at") < F.col("a.moved_at"))
        & (F.col("b.moved_at") >= F.col("a.moved_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.sku_id", "a.moved_at")

        F.sum("b.unit_price").alias("prior_unit_price_1d"),
    )
)
```

```python
        "status",

        F.lead("balance", 2).over(w_running).alias("next_balance"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("balance", "id")).alias("balance_bucket"),
        F.avg("balance").over(Window.orderBy("balance", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("balance_avg_2_prior"),

)

    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.txn_time") <= F.col("s.opened_date")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.txn_time").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
```

```sql
    -- mall rows per account_opened_on_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', account_opened_on) AS account_opened_on_month, COUNT(*) AS mall_count, SUM(basket_total) AS mall_total_basket_total

    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', account_opened_on) AS account_opened_on_month, COUNT(*) AS std_preferred_count, ROUND(AVG(basket_total), 2) AS preferred_avg_basket_total
    FROM fact_summits
    WHERE store_tier_eff = 'preferred'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', account_opened_on)
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.account_opened_on_month, b.account_opened_on_month) AS account_opened_on_month,
    COALESCE(a.mall_count, 0) AS mall_count,
    a.mall_total_basket_total,
    COALESCE(b.std_preferred_count, 0) AS std_preferred_count,
    COALESCE(b.preferred_avg_basket_total, 0) AS preferred_avg_basket_total,
    COALESCE(a.mall_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.std_preferred_count, 0) AS mall_count_minus_preferred_count
FROM mall_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN preferred_monthly b
  ON a.account_opened_on_month = b.account_opened_on_month
ORDER BY account_opened_on_month
```

```python
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("mall_count"),

        F.round(F.avg("basket_total"), 2).alias("preferred_avg_basket_total"),
    )
)

result = (
```

```sql
        id,
        cluster_id,
        cloud_region,
        deploy_result,
        vcpu_cnt,
        provisioned_on,
        hostname_txt
    FROM vm_instances
    WHERE vcpu_cnt < 72
),
tagged AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT *, DATE_FORMAT(provisioned_on, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS provisioned_on_label
    FROM cleaned
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach incident_pages metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN i.cloud_region <> 'ap-se-1' THEN 1 END) FROM incident_pages i WHERE i.cluster_ref = s.cluster_id) AS incident_page_cloud_region_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN i.vm_family <> 'cpu' THEN 1 END) FROM incident_pages i WHERE i.cluster_ref = s.cluster_id) AS incident_page_vm_family_count
    FROM tagged s
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Keep rows whose cluster matches
    SELECT s.*
    FROM profiled s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clusters c
            WHERE c.id = s.cluster_id
              AND c.paged_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-24 09:00:00'
              AND c.vm_family IS NOT NULL
        )
),
qualified AS (
    -- Rows with no matching cpu_samples
    SELECT s.*
    FROM without_matches s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM cpu_samples c
            WHERE c.vm_instance_id = s.id
              AND c.vcpu_cnt < 67
        )
      AND s.deploy_result IS NOT NULL
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach cpu_samples metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(c.provisioned_on) FROM cpu_samples c WHERE c.vm_instance_id = s.id) AS first_cpu_sample_provisioned_on,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.page_sev = 'sev2') FROM cpu_samples c WHERE c.vm_instance_id = s.id) AS cpu_sample_page_sev_count
    FROM qualified s
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach incident_pages metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(i.paged_at) FROM incident_pages i WHERE i.cluster_ref = s.cluster_id) AS first_incident_page_paged_at
    FROM summarized_rows s
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Rows with no matching incident_pages
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_stats s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM incident_pages i
            WHERE i.cluster_ref = s.cluster_id
              AND i.vm_family = 'gpu'
        )
      AND s.provisioned_on_label IS NOT NULL
),
labeled AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(provisioned_on_label), 1, 4) AS provisioned_on_label_prefix
    FROM with_activity
)
SELECT id, field, reading
FROM (
    SELECT id, cpu_sample_page_sev_count, vcpu_cnt, incident_page_vm_family_count, incident_page_cloud_region_count
    FROM labeled
) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR field IN (cpu_sample_page_sev_count, vcpu_cnt, incident_page_vm_family_count, incident_page_cloud_region_count)
) unp
```

```python
    df_vm_instances
    .filter(F.col("vcpu_cnt") < 72)
    .select(

        "cluster_id",
        "cloud_region",
        "deploy_result",
        "vcpu_cnt",
        "provisioned_on",
        "hostname_txt",
    )
)

tagged = (

    .withColumn("provisioned_on_label", F.date_format(F.col("provisioned_on"), "yyyy-MM-dd"))

    .groupBy("cluster_ref")

        F.count(F.when(F.col("vm_family") != "cpu", 1)).alias("incident_page_vm_family_count"),
    )
)

profiled = (
    tagged.alias("s")
    .join(incident_page_stats.alias("i"), F.col("i.cluster_ref") == F.col("s.cluster_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("i.incident_page_cloud_region_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("incident_page_cloud_region_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("i.incident_page_vm_family_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("incident_page_vm_family_count"),
    )
)

without_matches = (
    profiled.alias("s")
    .join(df_clusters.alias("c"), (F.col("c.id") == F.col("s.cluster_id")) & (F.col("c.paged_at") < F.lit("2025-02-24 09:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & (F.col("c.vm_family").isNotNull()), "left_anti")
)

qualified = (
    without_matches.alias("s")
    .join(df_cpu_samples.alias("c"), (F.col("c.vm_instance_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.vcpu_cnt") < 67), "left_anti")
    .filter(F.col("deploy_result").isNotNull())
)

cpu_sample_stats = (
    df_cpu_samples
    .groupBy("vm_instance_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("provisioned_on").alias("first_cpu_sample_provisioned_on"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("page_sev") == "sev2", 1)).alias("cpu_sample_page_sev_count"),
    )
)

summarized_rows = (
    qualified.alias("s")
    .join(cpu_sample_stats.alias("c"), F.col("c.vm_instance_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "c.first_cpu_sample_provisioned_on",
        F.coalesce(F.col("c.cpu_sample_page_sev_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("cpu_sample_page_sev_count"),
    )
)

incident_page_stats_2 = (
    df_incident_pages
    .groupBy("cluster_ref")
    .agg(F.min("paged_at").alias("first_incident_page_paged_at"))
)

with_stats = (
    summarized_rows.alias("s")
    .join(incident_page_stats_2.alias("i"), F.col("i.cluster_ref") == F.col("s.cluster_id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", "i.first_incident_page_paged_at")
)

with_activity = (
    with_stats.alias("s")
    .join(df_incident_pages.alias("i"), (F.col("i.cluster_ref") == F.col("s.cluster_id")) & (F.col("i.vm_family") == "gpu"), "left_anti")
    .filter(F.col("provisioned_on_label").isNotNull())
)

labeled = (
    with_activity
    .withColumn("provisioned_on_label_prefix", F.substring(F.trim(F.col("provisioned_on_label")), 1, 4))
)

result = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "cpu_sample_page_sev_count",
        "vcpu_cnt",
        "incident_page_vm_family_count",
        "incident_page_cloud_region_count",
```

```sql
        ticket_id,
        event_at,
        event_type,
```

```sql
    FROM ticket_events
    WHERE ticket_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event_at per actor
    SELECT *, LAG(event_at) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY event_at, id) AS prev_event_at
    FROM scoped

    FROM with_prev

sessionized AS (

    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
with_children_events AS (
    -- One row per event
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.ticket_id,
        s.event_at,
        s.actor,
        s.prev_event_at,
        s.session_no,

        t.event_at AS event_event_at,
        t.event_type AS event_event_type
    FROM sessionized s

),
sequenced AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        ticket_id,
        event_at,
        actor,
        session_no,
        event_id,
        event_event_at,
        event_event_type,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_ticket_id_actor AS rows_in_ticket_id_actor
    FROM with_children_events
    WINDOW w_ticket_id_actor AS (PARTITION BY ticket_id, actor)
)
-- Final projection

    event_at,
    session_no,
    event_id,
```

```python
        "sprint_kmh",

    )
)

with_prev = prepared_venues.withColumn("prev_kickoff_ts_std", F.lag("kickoff_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("venue_surface").orderBy("kickoff_ts", "id")))

        F.nth_value("burst_id", 2).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("kickoff_ts").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_burst_id"),
        F.round(F.col("minutes_played") / F.nullif(F.sum("minutes_played").over(Window.partitionBy("flag_is_home_alt", "starts_session")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("minutes_played_share_of_flag_is_home_starts_sess"),
        F.min("minutes_played").over(w_flag_is_home_starts_session).alias("flag_is_home_starts_session_min_minutes_played"),
    )
)

result = (

    .filter(F.col("flag_is_home_starts_session_min_minutes_played") < 780)

        "sprint_kmh",
        "flag_is_home_alt",
```

```sql
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions

    FROM with_windows

base AS (
```

```python
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("browser", "device").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("browser", "country").orderBy("event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev

sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY tap_media ORDER BY visited_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged

sessions AS (

        burst_id,

        MAX(visited_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(visited_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(visited_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min

qualified AS (

annotated AS (
```

```sql
        temp_c,

        AVG(humidity) OVER (ORDER BY humidity, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS humidity_avg_2,
        NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY humidity, id) AS humidity_bucket
    FROM deduped
    WHERE humidity <= 54
),
filtered_device_readings AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, humidity_avg_5_prior - humidity AS humidity_avg_5_prior_minus_humidity
    FROM enriched
    WHERE humidity_avg_2 <= 62

    CASE WHEN humidity_bucket >= 8 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS humidity_bucket_tier,

    MAX(humidity_bucket) AS max_humidity_bucket,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(humidity, 0.5) AS humidity_p50,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(humidity_avg_2, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS humidity_avg_2_quartiles
FROM filtered_device_readings
```

```python
    df_typewriters
    .filter(F.col("device_code") == "DV-01")
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "src_status_bits",
        "firmware",
        (F.col("temp_c") - F.col("humidity")).alias("temp_c_minus_humidity"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("src_status_bits", "id")))
```

```sql
    FROM transactions

    MIN(next_is_flagged_flag_avg_2) AS min_next_is_flagged_flag_avg_2
```

```sql
WITH covered AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.student_id,
        a.enrolled_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_7d,
        SUM(b.score) AS prior_score_7d
    FROM enrollments a
    LEFT JOIN enrollments b
      ON b.student_id = a.student_id
     AND b.enrolled_at < a.enrolled_at
     AND b.enrolled_at >= a.enrolled_at - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.student_id, a.enrolled_at
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM covered
    WHERE prior_score_7d < (SELECT MAX(prior_score_7d) FROM covered)
),
student_id_stats AS (
    -- Avg prior_score_7d per student_id
    SELECT student_id, AVG(prior_score_7d) AS avg_prior_score_7d
    FROM with_activity
    GROUP BY student_id
),
vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_prior_score_7d,
        ROUND(s.prior_score_7d - g.avg_prior_score_7d, 2) AS prior_score_7d_minus_avg
    FROM with_activity s
    JOIN student_id_stats g ON g.student_id = s.student_id
    WHERE s.prior_score_7d > g.avg_prior_score_7d
),
with_children AS (
    -- One row per enrollment
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.student_id,
        s.enrolled_at,
        s.prior_score_7d,
        s.avg_prior_score_7d,
        s.prior_score_7d_minus_avg,
        e.id AS enrollment_id,
        e.term AS enrollment_term,
        e.course_id AS enrollment_course_id,
        e.grade_status AS enrollment_grade_status
    FROM vs_group s
    LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.student_id
)
-- Subtotals with GROUPING SETS
SELECT
    enrollment_id,
    enrollment_grade_status,
    enrollment_course_id,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_prior_score_7d), 2) AS avg_avg_prior_score_7d,
    MIN(prior_score_7d_minus_avg) AS min_prior_score_7d_minus_avg,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(prior_score_7d, 0.5) AS median_prior_score_7d
FROM with_children
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((enrollment_id, enrollment_grade_status, enrollment_course_id), (enrollment_id), (enrollment_grade_status))
ORDER BY enrollment_id NULLS LAST, enrollment_grade_status NULLS LAST, enrollment_course_id NULLS LAST
```

```python
    df_enrollments.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_enrollments.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.student_id") == F.col("a.student_id"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") < F.col("a.enrolled_at"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") >= F.col("a.enrolled_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.student_id", "a.enrolled_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_7d"),
        F.sum("b.score").alias("prior_score_7d"),

with_activity = (

    .filter(F.col("prior_score_7d") < F.col("overall_max_prior_score_7d"))

        "s.student_id",
```

```sql
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        country_upper,
        price,
        LAG(price) OVER w_running AS prev_price,
        LAG(rating) OVER w_running AS prev_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_running AS seq_no
    FROM with_last
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating ASC, id ASC)
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products x
            WHERE x.supplier_id = s.id
              AND x.launch_date BETWEEN '2025-06-27' AND '2025-07-01'
        )
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(prev_rating) OVER (ORDER BY seq_no ASC, id ASC) AS next_prev_rating,
        LAG(prev_rating) OVER (ORDER BY seq_no ASC, id ASC) AS prev_prev_rating,
        LAG(price) OVER (ORDER BY seq_no ASC, id ASC) AS prev_price_2,
        LEAD(price) OVER (ORDER BY seq_no ASC, id ASC) AS next_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY seq_no ASC, id ASC) AS event_seq
    FROM not_flagged
    WHERE prev_rating > 3.6
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, FLOOR(prev_price) AS prev_price_whole
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE prev_price BETWEEN 770 AND 1110
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY seq_no DESC, id ASC) AS seq_no_bucket,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY prev_rating DESC NULLS LAST) AS prev_rating_cume_dist,
```

```sql
        ROUND(prior_rows_12h / NULLIF(SUM(prior_rows_12h) OVER w_prior_rows_12h_student_id, 0), 4) AS prior_rows_12h_share_of_prior_rows_12h_student_i
    FROM in_window
    WINDOW w_prior_rows_12h_by_prior_scor AS (PARTITION BY prior_rows_12h ORDER BY prior_score_12h ASC, id), w_prior_rows_12h_student_id AS (PARTITION BY prior_rows_12h, student_id)
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall min
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked
    WHERE prev_prior_rows_12h > (SELECT MIN(prev_prior_rows_12h) FROM ranked)
)
SELECT
    next_prior_rows_12h,
    prev_prior_rows_12h,
    prior_rows_12h,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
FROM screened
GROUP BY CUBE(next_prior_rows_12h, prev_prior_rows_12h, prior_rows_12h)
ORDER BY next_prior_rows_12h NULLS LAST, prev_prior_rows_12h NULLS LAST, prior_rows_12h NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

in_window = (
    df_enrollments.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_enrollments.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.student_id") == F.col("a.student_id"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") < F.col("a.enrolled_at"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") >= F.col("a.enrolled_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.student_id", "a.enrolled_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_12h"),
        F.sum("b.score").alias("prior_score_12h"),
    )
)

w_prior_rows_12h_by_prior_scor = Window.partitionBy("prior_rows_12h").orderBy("prior_score_12h", "id")
w_prior_rows_12h_student_id = Window.partitionBy("prior_rows_12h", "student_id")
ranked = (
    in_window
    .select(
        "id",
        "prior_rows_12h",
        "prior_score_12h",
        F.lag("prior_rows_12h").over(w_prior_rows_12h_by_prior_scor).alias("prev_prior_rows_12h"),
        F.sum("prior_score_12h").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("enrolled_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("prior_score_12h_sum_2_prior"),
        F.lead("prior_rows_12h").over(Window.partitionBy("prior_rows_12h").orderBy("prior_score_12h", "id")).alias("next_prior_rows_12h"),
        (F.col("prior_score_12h") - F.lag("prior_score_12h").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("enrolled_at").desc(), "id"))).alias("prior_score_12h_change"),
        F.round(F.col("prior_rows_12h") - F.avg("prior_rows_12h").over(Window.partitionBy("prior_rows_12h", "student_id")), 2).alias("prior_rows_12h_vs_prior_rows_12h_student_id_avg"),
        F.round(F.col("prior_rows_12h") / F.nullif(F.sum("prior_rows_12h").over(w_prior_rows_12h_student_id), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("prior_rows_12h_share_of_prior_rows_12h_student_i"),
    )
)

screened = (
    ranked
    .crossJoin(ranked.agg(F.min("prev_prior_rows_12h").alias("overall_min_prev_prior_rows_12h")))
    .filter(F.col("prev_prior_rows_12h") > F.col("overall_min_prev_prior_rows_12h"))
    .drop("overall_min_prev_prior_rows_12h")
)

result = (
    screened
    .cube("next_prior_rows_12h", "prev_prior_rows_12h", "prior_rows_12h")
    .agg(F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"))
    .orderBy(
        F.col("next_prior_rows_12h").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("prev_prior_rows_12h").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("prior_rows_12h").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)
```

```sql
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tariff_or_unknown ORDER BY n_tariff_tou DESC, tariff_or_unknown) AS seq_no
    FROM grouped
```

```sql
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY listing_flag_has_parking, listing_no ORDER BY offer_amt DESC, id) AS offer_amt_dense_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(storey_no_avg2_tot) OVER (PARTITION BY listing_status, listing_no ORDER BY listing_floor_sqm, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_storey_no,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(listing_status) OVER (PARTITION BY listing_flag_has_parking, listing_no)) AS distinct_listing_status_in_listing_flag_has_park
    FROM qualified
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM sequenced
    WHERE monthly_rent > (SELECT AVG(monthly_rent) FROM sequenced)
),
grouped AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        offer_amt_dense_rank,
        listing_flag_has_parking,
        listing_status,
        ROUND(STDDEV(distinct_listing_status_in_listing_flag_has_park), 2) AS stddev_distinct_listing_status_in_listing_flag_h,
        SUM(listing_floor_sqm) AS total_listing_floor_sqm,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count,
        MIN(storey_no_avg2_tot) AS min_storey_no,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(street_line)) AS street_line_list
    FROM without_matches
    GROUP BY offer_amt_dense_rank, listing_flag_has_parking, listing_status
),
metrics AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        offer_amt_dense_rank,
        listing_flag_has_parking,

        row_count,

        MAX(total_listing_floor_sqm) OVER w_row_count_offer_amt_dense_ra AS row_count_offer_amt_dense_rank_max_total_listing,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY row_count, listing_flag_has_parking ORDER BY min_storey_no DESC) AS min_storey_no_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY row_count, listing_flag_has_parking ORDER BY min_storey_no DESC, offer_amt_dense_rank, listing_flag_has_parking, listing_status) AS min_storey_no_seq
    FROM grouped

    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_offer_amt_dense_rank AS (PARTITION BY offer_amt_dense_rank)
```

```sql
WITH cleaned_care_plans AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        clinics_v_no_peak_std,
        systolic_mm,
        plan_start_day,
        needs_followup,
        CONCAT(fill_state, '#', CAST(systolic_mm AS STRING)) AS fill_state_ref,
        LENGTH(TRIM(ward_code)) AS ward_code_len,
        COALESCE(fill_state, 'UNKNOWN') AS fill_state_or_unknown
    FROM torche_rapids
    WHERE dose_mg < 657.0
),
grouped AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', plan_start_day) AS plan_start_day_month,
        fill_state_or_unknown,
        needs_followup,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
        ROUND(STDDEV(ward_code_len), 2) AS stddev_ward_code_len,
        SUM(systolic_mm) AS total_systolic_mm,
        ROUND(STDDEV(systolic_mm), 2) AS stddev_systolic_mm,
        MIN(systolic_mm) AS min_systolic_mm
    FROM cleaned_care_plans
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', plan_start_day), fill_state_or_unknown, needs_followup
),
labeled AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        plan_start_day_month,
        fill_state_or_unknown,
        needs_followup,
        n_rows,
        total_systolic_mm,
        stddev_systolic_mm,
        min_systolic_mm,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(fill_state_or_unknown), ' ', '_')) AS fill_state_or_unknown_slug,
        COALESCE(min_systolic_mm, 0) AS min_systolic_mm_filled,
        ABS(n_rows - 8) AS n_rows_distance
    FROM grouped
    WHERE stddev_systolic_mm < 152.0
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    plan_start_day_month,
    needs_followup,
    n_rows,
    total_systolic_mm,
    stddev_systolic_mm,
    fill_state_or_unknown_slug,
    min_systolic_mm_filled,
    CASE WHEN min_systolic_mm_filled >= 175 THEN 'A' WHEN min_systolic_mm_filled >= 120 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS min_systolic_mm_filled_tier,
    FLOOR(stddev_systolic_mm / 25) * 25 AS stddev_systolic_mm_bucket
FROM labeled
ORDER BY plan_start_day_month
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned_care_plans = (
    df_torche_rapids
    .filter(F.col("dose_mg") < 657.0)
    .select(
        "id",
        "clinics_v_no_peak_std",
        "systolic_mm",
        "plan_start_day",
        "needs_followup",
        F.concat(F.col("fill_state"), F.lit("#"), F.col("systolic_mm").cast("string")).alias("fill_state_ref"),
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("ward_code"))).alias("ward_code_len"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("fill_state"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("fill_state_or_unknown"),

    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("n_rows"),
        F.round(F.stddev("ward_code_len"), 2).alias("stddev_ward_code_len"),
        F.sum("systolic_mm").alias("total_systolic_mm"),

        "total_systolic_mm",
        "stddev_systolic_mm",
        "min_systolic_mm",
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("fill_state_or_unknown")), " ", "_")).alias("fill_state_or_unknown_slug"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("min_systolic_mm"), F.lit(0)).alias("min_systolic_mm_filled"),
        F.abs(F.col("n_rows") - 8).alias("n_rows_distance"),
    )
)

result = (

    .select(
        "plan_start_day_month",
        "needs_followup",
        "n_rows",
        "total_systolic_mm",
        "stddev_systolic_mm",
        "fill_state_or_unknown_slug",
        "min_systolic_mm_filled",
        F.when(F.col("min_systolic_mm_filled") >= 175, "A").when(F.col("min_systolic_mm_filled") >= 120, "B").otherwise("C").alias("min_systolic_mm_filled_tier"),
        (F.floor(F.col("stddev_systolic_mm") / 25) * 25).alias("stddev_systolic_mm_bucket"),
```

```sql
WITH cleaned_hotels AS (
    -- Scope the hotels rows
    SELECT
        id,
        board_basis,
        hotel_chain,
        task_minutes,
        late_checkout,
        perk_codes,
        ROUND(occupancy_pct * 1.5, 2) AS occupancy_pct_adj
    FROM hotels
    WHERE hotel_chain NOT IN ('Orchid', 'Lotus')
      AND occupancy_pct < 72.1
),
flattened AS (
    -- One row per perk_code
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.board_basis,
        s.hotel_chain,
        s.task_minutes,
        s.late_checkout,
        s.occupancy_pct_adj,
        t.perk_code_pos,
        t.perk_code
    FROM cleaned_hotels s
    LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(s.perk_codes) t AS perk_code_pos, perk_code
),
derived AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT *, SUBSTRING(TRIM(hotel_chain), 1, 3) AS hotel_chain_prefix
    FROM flattened
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        board_basis,
        task_minutes,
        late_checkout,
        perk_code_pos,
        hotel_chain_prefix,
        NTILE(3) OVER w_board_basis_by_occupancy_pct AS occupancy_pct_adj_tercile,
        ROUND(occupancy_pct_adj / NULLIF(SUM(occupancy_pct_adj) OVER (PARTITION BY hotel_chain), 0), 4) AS occupancy_pct_adj_share_of_hotel_chain,
        ROUND(perk_code_pos - AVG(perk_code_pos) OVER (PARTITION BY hotel_chain), 2) AS perk_code_pos_vs_hotel_chain_avg,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_board_basis_by_occupancy_pct_2, 3) AS occupancy_pct_adj_percent_rank,
        SUM(task_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY hotel_chain) AS hotel_chain_sum_task_minutes
    FROM derived
    WINDOW w_board_basis_by_occupancy_pct AS (PARTITION BY board_basis ORDER BY occupancy_pct_adj, id, perk_code_pos), w_board_basis_by_occupancy_pct_2 AS (PARTITION BY board_basis ORDER BY occupancy_pct_adj)
),
exploded_detail AS (
    -- One row per room_type
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.board_basis,
        s.task_minutes,
        s.perk_code_pos,
        s.hotel_chain_prefix,
        s.occupancy_pct_adj_tercile,
        s.occupancy_pct_adj_share_of_hotel_chain,
        s.perk_code_pos_vs_hotel_chain_avg,
        s.occupancy_pct_adj_percent_rank,
        s.hotel_chain_sum_task_minutes,
        r.id AS room_type_id,
        r.charged_at AS room_type_charged_at,
        r.task_mins AS room_type_task_mins,
        r.hotel_chain AS room_type_hotel_chain,
        r.late_checkout AS room_type_late_checkout
    FROM with_trends s
    JOIN room_types r ON r.hotel_id = s.id
),
windowed AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        board_basis,
        task_minutes,
        perk_code_pos,
        hotel_chain_prefix,
        occupancy_pct_adj_share_of_hotel_chain,
        occupancy_pct_adj_percent_rank,
        hotel_chain_sum_task_minutes,
        room_type_id,
        room_type_charged_at,
        room_type_task_mins,
        room_type_hotel_chain,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY hotel_chain_sum_task_minutes ASC NULLS LAST, id, perk_code_pos, room_type_id) AS rn,
        FIRST_VALUE(hotel_chain_sum_task_minutes) OVER (ORDER BY hotel_chain_sum_task_minutes ASC NULLS LAST, id, perk_code_pos, room_type_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_hotel_chain_sum_task_minutes,
        LAG(hotel_chain_sum_task_minutes) OVER (ORDER BY hotel_chain_sum_task_minutes ASC NULLS LAST, id, perk_code_pos, room_type_id) AS prev_hotel_chain_sum_task_minutes,
        ROUND(AVG(task_minutes) OVER (ORDER BY hotel_chain_sum_task_minutes ASC NULLS LAST, id, perk_code_pos, room_type_id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS task_minutes_avg_1_prior
    FROM exploded_detail
),
combined_details_room_type AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.*,
        r.hotel_chain AS room_type_hotel_chain_2,
        r.hotel_id AS room_type_hotel_id
    FROM windowed s
    JOIN room_types r ON r.id = s.room_type_id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rn), 3) AS rn_percent_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rn) AS rn_dense_rank,
        MAX(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY rn) AS rn_max_rn
    FROM combined_details_room_type
),
stats AS (
    -- Summarise per group

        MIN(room_type_task_mins) AS min_room_type_task_mins,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
        COUNT(DISTINCT board_basis) AS distinct_board_basis,
        COUNT(DISTINCT room_type_hotel_id) AS distinct_room_type_hotel_ids
    FROM metrics
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    perk_code_pos,
    room_type_hotel_chain_2,
    n_room_type_hotel_chain_lotus,
    distinct_board_basis,
    COALESCE(perk_code_pos, 0) AS perk_code_pos_filled
FROM stats
ORDER BY perk_code_pos_filled DESC, distinct_board_basis DESC, perk_code_pos, room_type_hotel_chain_2
LIMIT 5
```

```sql
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.listener_id,
        a.played_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_12h,
        SUM(b.ms_played) AS prior_ms_played_12h
    FROM plays a
    LEFT JOIN plays b
      ON b.listener_id = a.listener_id
     AND b.played_at < a.played_at
     AND b.played_at >= a.played_at - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.listener_id, a.played_at
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Rows with no matching plays
    SELECT s.*
    FROM matched s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM plays p
            WHERE p.listener_id = s.listener_id
              AND p.ms_played <= 302279
              AND p.source <> 'radio'
        )
),
derived AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        id,
        played_at,
        prior_rows_12h,
        CASE WHEN prior_ms_played_12h >= 1600000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN prior_ms_played_12h >= 700000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS prior_ms_played_12h_tier,
        YEAR(played_at) AS played_at_year,
        DATE_FORMAT(played_at, 'yyyy-MM') AS played_at_label
    FROM with_activity
),
unique_rows AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        played_at,
        prior_rows_12h,
        prior_ms_played_12h_tier,
        played_at_year,
        played_at_label
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,

    ) ranked
```

```sql
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.agent_id,
        a.opened_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_3d,
        SUM(b.csat) AS prior_csat_3d
    FROM tickets a

      ON b.agent_id = a.agent_id
     AND b.opened_at < a.opened_at
     AND b.opened_at >= a.opened_at - INTERVAL 3 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.agent_id, a.opened_at
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        prior_rows_3d,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_at) AS opened_at_month,
        ROUND(STDDEV(prior_rows_3d), 2) AS stddev_prior_rows_3d,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
    FROM joined_ranges
    GROUP BY prior_rows_3d, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_at)
)
-- Subtotals with CUBE
SELECT
    prior_rows_3d,
    distinct_ids,
    MAX(opened_at_month) AS last_opened_at_month,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM rollup_base
GROUP BY CUBE(prior_rows_3d, distinct_ids)
ORDER BY prior_rows_3d NULLS LAST, distinct_ids NULLS LAST
```

```python
    df_tickets.alias("a")
    .join(

        & (F.col("b.opened_at") < F.col("a.opened_at"))
        & (F.col("b.opened_at") >= F.col("a.opened_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.agent_id", "a.opened_at")
    .agg(
```

```python
w_part = Window.partitionBy("channel", "store_id").orderBy("amount_int", "id")

    .filter(F.col("order_date") > F.lit("2023-07-04").cast("date"))

    metrics
    .withColumn("last3_sum_discount", F.sum("discount").over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("discount", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("last3_max_discount", F.max("discount").over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("discount", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)))
```

```sql
    COALESCE(b.online_count, 0) AS online_count,
    COALESCE(b.online_avg_downtime_min, 0) AS online_avg_downtime_min,
    COALESCE(a.standby_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.online_count, 0) AS net_count
```

```sql
WITH filtered_enrollments AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        student_id,
        course_id,
        term,
        score,
        grade_status,
        enrolled_at,
        CASE WHEN grade_status IN ('INCOMPLETE', 'FAIL') THEN 'group_a' WHEN grade_status = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS grade_status_group,
        enrolled_at + INTERVAL 7 DAYS AS enrolled_at_plus_7d
    FROM enrollments
    WHERE (term NOT IN ('2024T2', '2024T1') OR grade_status <> 'FAIL')
),
student_id_stats AS (
    -- Avg score per student_id
    SELECT student_id, AVG(score) AS avg_score_used
    FROM filtered_enrollments
    GROUP BY student_id
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT s.*, g.avg_score_used, ROUND(s.score - g.avg_score_used, 2) AS score_minus_avg_tot
    FROM filtered_enrollments s
    JOIN student_id_stats g ON g.student_id = s.student_id
    WHERE s.score > g.avg_score_used
),
grade_status_group_stats AS (
    -- Median score_minus_avg_tot per grade_status_group
    SELECT grade_status_group, PERCENTILE_APPROX(score_minus_avg_tot, 0.5) AS median_score_minus_avg
    FROM compared
    GROUP BY grade_status_group
),
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_score_minus_avg,
        ROUND(s.score_minus_avg_tot - g.median_score_minus_avg, 2) AS score_minus_avg_minus_median
    FROM compared s
    JOIN grade_status_group_stats g ON g.grade_status_group = s.grade_status_group
    WHERE s.score_minus_avg_tot >= g.median_score_minus_avg
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT enrolled_at_plus_7d, term, grade_status_group, score_minus_avg_minus_median
    FROM above_average
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(score_minus_avg_minus_median)
    FOR grade_status_group IN ('group_b', 'other', 'group_a')
)
ORDER BY enrolled_at_plus_7d, term
```

```python
    df_enrollments
    .filter((~F.col("term").isin("2024T2", "2024T1")) | (F.col("grade_status") != "FAIL"))
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.orderBy("rating_whole", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

    .filter(F.col("rating") < 3.0)

)

scored = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "rating",
        "rating_whole",
        "city_group",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("rating").desc_nulls_first())).alias("rating_dense_rank"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.partitionBy("city", "country").orderBy(F.col("rating").desc(), "id")).alias("rating_bucket"),
        F.sum("rating").over(Window.partitionBy("city")).alias("city_sum_rating"),
        F.lead("rating_whole", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("rating", "id")).alias("next_rating_whole"),
    )
)

with_last = (

    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")

    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)

        "s.rating",
        "s.rating_whole",
        F.col("c.category").alias("product_category"),
        F.col("c.cost").alias("product_cost"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    with_last
    .select(
        "id",
        "rating_whole",
        "product_cost",
        F.avg("rating").over(Window.partitionBy("product_category").orderBy("product_cost", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("rating_avg_6"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("product_category").orderBy(F.col("rating_whole").asc_nulls_last())).alias("rating_whole_percent_rank"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .select(

        "rating_whole",

        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
```

```sql
        DATE_FORMAT(opened_at, 'yyyy-MM') AS opened_at_label
    FROM covered
```

```sql
WITH covered AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.agent_id,
        a.opened_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_3d,
        SUM(b.csat) AS prior_csat_3d
    FROM tickets a
    LEFT JOIN tickets b
      ON b.agent_id = a.agent_id
     AND b.opened_at < a.opened_at
     AND b.opened_at >= a.opened_at - INTERVAL 3 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.agent_id, a.opened_at
),
agent_id_stats AS (
    -- Avg prior_rows_3d per agent_id
    SELECT agent_id, AVG(prior_rows_3d) AS avg_prior_rows_3d
    FROM covered
    GROUP BY agent_id
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_prior_rows_3d,
        ROUND(s.prior_rows_3d - g.avg_prior_rows_3d, 2) AS prior_rows_3d_minus_avg
    FROM covered s
    JOIN agent_id_stats g ON g.agent_id = s.agent_id
    WHERE s.prior_rows_3d > g.avg_prior_rows_3d
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        agent_id,
        opened_at,
        avg_prior_rows_3d,
        prior_rows_3d_minus_avg,
        prior_rows_3d - LAG(prior_rows_3d) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_3d ORDER BY prior_rows_3d DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS prior_rows_3d_change,
        prior_rows_3d_minus_avg - LAG(prior_rows_3d_minus_avg) OVER w_prior_rows_3d_by_prior_rows AS prior_rows_3d_minus_avg_change,
        SUM(avg_prior_rows_3d) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_3d ORDER BY prior_rows_3d DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS avg_prior_rows_3d_sum_3_prior
    FROM outliers
    WINDOW w_prior_rows_3d_by_prior_rows AS (PARTITION BY prior_rows_3d ORDER BY prior_rows_3d DESC NULLS FIRST, id)
),
totals AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN prior_rows_3d_minus_avg >= 4.0 THEN 'A' WHEN prior_rows_3d_minus_avg >= -3.2 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS prior_rows_3d_minus_avg_tier,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_at) AS opened_at_month,
        ROUND(SUM(prior_rows_3d_minus_avg_change), 2) AS total_prior_rows_3d_minus_avg_change,
        MAX(opened_at) AS last_opened_at,
        MIN(opened_at) AS first_opened_at
    FROM with_windows
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN prior_rows_3d_minus_avg >= 4.0 THEN 'A' WHEN prior_rows_3d_minus_avg >= -3.2 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_at)
    HAVING SUM(prior_rows_3d_change) > -5
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    prior_rows_3d_minus_avg_tier,
    opened_at_month,
    total_prior_rows_3d_minus_avg_change,
    last_opened_at
FROM totals
ORDER BY total_prior_rows_3d_minus_avg_change DESC NULLS FIRST
```

```sql
        track_id,

        source,

    FROM plays

),
```

```sql
above_average AS (

    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_ms_played,
        ROUND(s.ms_played - g.median_ms_played, 2) AS ms_played_minus_median
    FROM recent_plays s
    JOIN source_stats g ON g.source = s.source
    WHERE s.ms_played >= g.median_ms_played
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(source_group, 'ALL') AS source_group,
    COALESCE(source, 'ALL') AS source,
    GROUPING(source_group) AS is_total_source_group,
    SUM(ms_played_minus_median) AS total_ms_played_minus_median,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(device)) AS device_list
FROM above_average
GROUP BY ROLLUP(source_group, source)
ORDER BY source_group NULLS LAST, source NULLS LAST
```

```python
    df_plays
    .filter(F.col("device").isNotNull())
    .select(

        "listener_id",
        "track_id",
        "played_at",
        "ms_played",
        "device",
        "is_skipped",
        "source",
        F.when(F.col("source").isin("search", "radio"), "group_a").when(F.col("source") == "album", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("source_group"),
    )
)

source_stats = (

    .groupBy("source")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("ms_played", 0.5).alias("median_ms_played"))

above_average = (
    recent_plays.alias("s")
    .join(source_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.source") == F.col("s.source"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.ms_played") >= F.col("g.median_ms_played"))
    .select(

        "g.median_ms_played",
        F.round(F.col("s.ms_played") - F.col("g.median_ms_played"), 2).alias("ms_played_minus_median"),

result = (
```

```python
        "move_type",

        "moved_at",
    )

    .select("s.*", "st.first_moved_at")

sku_id_stats = (
    summarized_rows
    .groupBy("sku_id")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("qty", 0.5).alias("median_qty"))
```

```sql
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR paid_at > LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id) + INTERVAL 7 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM valid
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
with_dims AS (

        a.*,

        o.status AS order_status,
        o.channel

        CASE WHEN amount >= 1500 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS amount_tier,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', paid_at) AS activity_month,
        CASE WHEN discount >= 0.41 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS discount_tier,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,

)
```

```sql
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.agent_id,
        a.opened_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_3d,
        SUM(b.csat) AS prior_csat_3d
    FROM tickets a
    LEFT JOIN tickets b
      ON b.agent_id = a.agent_id
     AND b.opened_at < a.opened_at
     AND b.opened_at >= a.opened_at - INTERVAL 3 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.agent_id, a.opened_at
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(prior_csat_3d - AVG(prior_csat_3d) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id, MONTH(opened_at)), 2) AS prior_csat_3d_vs_agent_id_opened_at_month_avg,
        ROUND(AVG(prior_rows_3d) OVER (ORDER BY prior_rows_3d, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS prior_rows_3d_avg_3,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY prior_rows_3d) AS prior_rows_3d_dense_rank,
        LAG(prior_csat_3d, 1, 0) OVER w_all_by_prior_rows_3d AS prev_prior_csat_3d,
        ROUND(prior_rows_3d - AVG(prior_rows_3d) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id, MONTH(opened_at)), 2) AS prior_rows_3d_vs_agent_id_opened_at_month_avg,
        ROUND(prior_rows_3d / NULLIF(SUM(prior_rows_3d) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id, MONTH(opened_at)), 0), 4) AS prior_rows_3d_share_of_agent_id_opened_at_month
    FROM in_window
    WINDOW w_all_by_prior_rows_3d AS (ORDER BY prior_rows_3d, id)
)
SELECT
    id,
    agent_id,
    opened_at,
    prior_csat_3d,
    prior_csat_3d_vs_agent_id_opened_at_month_avg,
    prior_rows_3d_avg_3,
    prior_rows_3d_dense_rank,
    prev_prior_csat_3d,
    prior_rows_3d_vs_agent_id_opened_at_month_avg,
    prior_rows_3d_share_of_agent_id_opened_at_month
FROM with_trends
WHERE prior_rows_3d_vs_agent_id_opened_at_month_avg <= 1.6
ORDER BY prior_csat_3d_vs_agent_id_opened_at_month_avg
```

```python
in_window = (
    df_tickets.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_tickets.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.agent_id") == F.col("a.agent_id"))
        & (F.col("b.opened_at") < F.col("a.opened_at"))
        & (F.col("b.opened_at") >= F.col("a.opened_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.agent_id", "a.opened_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_3d"),
        F.sum("b.csat").alias("prior_csat_3d"),
    )
)

w_all_by_prior_rows_3d = Window.orderBy("prior_rows_3d", "id")
with_trends = (
    in_window
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("prior_csat_3d") - F.avg("prior_csat_3d").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id", F.month("opened_at"))), 2).alias("prior_csat_3d_vs_agent_id_opened_at_month_avg"),
        F.round(F.avg("prior_rows_3d").over(Window.orderBy("prior_rows_3d", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("prior_rows_3d_avg_3"),

        F.round(F.col("prior_rows_3d") / F.nullif(F.sum("prior_rows_3d").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id", F.month("opened_at"))), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("prior_rows_3d_share_of_agent_id_opened_at_month"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_trends
    .filter(F.col("prior_rows_3d_vs_agent_id_opened_at_month_avg") <= 1.6)
    .select(
        "id",
        "agent_id",
        "opened_at",
        "prior_csat_3d",
```

```sql
    SELECT
```

```sql
    FROM base s

            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.txn_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
with_latest AS (

    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.account_type,
        x.merchant,
        x.transaction_amount
    FROM latest_match s

)
```

```sql
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        TRIM(device) AS clean_device,
        CASE WHEN browser = 'Firefox' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_firefox
    FROM sessions
    WHERE started_at >= TO_DATE('2023-04-14')
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR started_at > LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id) + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM filtered
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching web_event per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.device,
        s.browser,
        s.started_at,
        s.country,
        s.is_firefox,
        s.session_id,
        top1.page
    FROM sessionized s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.page
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.event_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY started_at DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS row_num
    FROM with_last
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM ranked s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
              AND c.event_time <= s.started_at

)

    MAX(started_at) AS ended_at,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE page = '/checkout') AS checkout_rows
FROM eligible

ORDER BY is_firefox_p50 DESC NULLS LAST
```

```sql
        agent_id,
```

```sql
        priority,
        csat,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(channel), ' ', '_')) AS channel_slug
    FROM tickets

with_prev AS (

    SELECT *, LAG(opened_at) OVER (PARTITION BY priority ORDER BY opened_at, id) AS prev_opened_at
    FROM valid_tickets

    FROM with_prev

sessionized AS (

    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session_src) OVER (PARTITION BY priority ORDER BY opened_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY session_no ORDER BY requester_id DESC, id) AS requester_id_quintile,
        SUM(is_new_session_src) OVER (PARTITION BY session_no ORDER BY requester_id DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS is_new_session_sum_2
    FROM sessionized

with_details_agent AS (

    SELECT
```

```sql
        a.sku_id,

    FROM matched

),
without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *

    WHERE prior_unit_price_12h < (SELECT MAX(prior_unit_price_12h) FROM metrics)

tagged AS (
```

```sql
with_windows AS (
```

```sql
WITH in_window AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.sku_id,
        a.moved_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_7d,
        SUM(b.qty) AS prior_qty_7d
    FROM stock_moves a

      ON b.sku_id = a.sku_id

     AND b.moved_at >= a.moved_at - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.sku_id, a.moved_at
),
totals AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        prior_rows_7d,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', moved_at) AS moved_at_month,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(prior_qty_7d, 0.5) AS median_prior_qty_7d,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM in_window
    WHERE sku_id >= 16
    GROUP BY prior_rows_7d, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', moved_at)
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
-- Final projection
SELECT prior_rows_7d, median_prior_qty_7d
FROM totals
ORDER BY prior_rows_7d, median_prior_qty_7d
```

```python
in_window = (
    df_stock_moves.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_stock_moves.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.sku_id") == F.col("a.sku_id"))
        & (F.col("b.moved_at") < F.col("a.moved_at"))
        & (F.col("b.moved_at") >= F.col("a.moved_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.sku_id", "a.moved_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_7d"),
        F.sum("b.qty").alias("prior_qty_7d"),

result = (
```

```sql
    from with_gaps
```

```python
    df_app_logs
```
