```python
w_running = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("status_bits", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)

filtered = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("pressure") < 1019)
    .withColumn("humidity_rounded", F.round("humidity", 0))
    .withColumn("pressure_minus_status_bits", (F.col("pressure") - F.col("status_bits")))
)

with_windows = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("humidity_rounded").between(44, 67))
    .withColumn("humidity_avg_3", F.avg("humidity").over(w_running))
    .withColumn("pressure_minus_status_bits_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("week", "reading_ts"), "device_code").orderBy(F.col("pressure_minus_status_bits").asc_nulls_first())))
    .withColumn("status_bits_avg_3", F.avg("status_bits").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("humidity_rounded", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)))
)

filtered_device_readings = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("temp_c") <= 32)
    .withColumn("temp_c_minus_humidity_avg_3", (F.col("temp_c") - F.col("humidity_avg_3")))
)

prev_events = filtered_device_readings.withColumn("prev_reading_ts", F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")))

flagged = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("prev_reading_ts").isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.col("prev_reading_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 20 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_device_readings = (
    flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",
        "humidity_rounded",
        "humidity_avg_3",
        "status_bits_avg_3",
        "temp_c_minus_humidity_avg_3",
        F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("island_id_adj_prev"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    sessions_device_readings
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("status_bits_avg_3") >= 12, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("status_bits_avg_3_tier"),
        "island_id_adj_prev",
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("device_code").alias("distinct_device_codes"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("device_code") == "DV-01", F.col("humidity"))).alias("dv_01_avg_humidity"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("distinct_device_codes") > 1)
    .withColumn("dv_01_avg_humidity_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("status_bits_avg_3_tier").orderBy(F.col("dv_01_avg_humidity").desc())))
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "status_bits_avg_3_tier",
        "island_id_adj_prev",
        "distinct_device_codes",
        "dv_01_avg_humidity_percent_rank",
    )
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_balloons_daily
    .filter((F.col("ticket_id") >= 5) & (F.col("event_type") != "created"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
    )
)

w_ticket_id_event_type_by_even = Window.partitionBy("ticket_id", "event_type").orderBy("event_at", "id")
w_ticket_id_event_at_year_by_e = Window.partitionBy("ticket_id", F.year("event_at")).orderBy(F.col("event_at").desc(), "id")
windowed = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
        F.dense_rank().over(w_ticket_id_event_type_by_even).alias("event_at_dense_rank"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id", "event_type").orderBy("event_at")), 3).alias("event_at_cume_dist"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id", "actor").orderBy("event_at", "id")).alias("event_at_seq_lag"),
        F.nth_value("event_at", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id", "actor").orderBy("event_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_event_at"),
        F.first("event_at", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("actor", "event_type").orderBy("event_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_event_at"),
        F.first("event_at", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id", "actor").orderBy("event_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_event_at_2"),
        F.last("event_at").over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id", "event_type").orderBy("event_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_event_at_init"),
        F.rank().over(w_ticket_id_event_at_year_by_e).alias("event_at_rank"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id", "event_type").orderBy("event_at")), 3).alias("event_at_percent_rank"),
    )
)

first_rows = (
    windowed
    .filter((F.col("event_at_dense_rank") == 1) & (F.col("event_at_seq_lag") <= 9))
    .drop("event_at_dense_rank")
)

w_all_by_last_event_at_ties = Window.orderBy("last_event_at_init")
w_event_at_rank = Window.partitionBy("event_at_rank")
w_actor_first_known_event_at_y = Window.partitionBy("actor", F.year("first_known_event_at"))
metrics = (
    first_rows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(w_all_by_last_event_at_ties), 3).alias("last_event_at_cume_dist"),
        F.lead("event_at_percent_rank").over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("last_event_at_init"), "ticket_id").orderBy("event_at_rank", "id")).alias("next_event_at_percent_rank"),
        F.round(F.col("event_at_percent_rank") - F.avg("event_at_percent_rank").over(w_event_at_rank), 2).alias("event_at_percent_rank_vs_event_at_rank_avg"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_actor_first_known_event_at_y).alias("rows_in_actor_first_known_event_at_year"),
        F.sum("event_at_cume_dist").over(Window.partitionBy("actor", F.year("first_known_event_at"))).alias("actor_first_known_event_at_year_sum_event_at_cum"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    metrics
    .groupBy("ticket_id", F.to_date("second_event_at").alias("second_event_at_day"))
    .agg(
        F.min("event_at_cume_dist").alias("min_event_at_cume_dist"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("event_type") != "replied", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("n_event_type_replied"),
        F.min("first_known_event_at").alias("first_first_known_event_at"),
        F.max("actor_first_known_event_at_year_sum_event_at_cum").alias("max_actor_first_known_event_at_year_sum_event_at"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("max_actor_first_known_event_at_year_sum_event_at") > 1.5)
    .drop("max_actor_first_known_event_at_year_sum_event_at")
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "ticket_id",
        "second_event_at_day",
        "n_event_type_replied",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-06-30").cast("date"), F.col("second_event_at_day")).alias("days_since_second_event_at_day"),
        F.last_day(F.col("second_event_at_day")).alias("second_event_at_day_month_end"),
    )
)
```

```sql
        LAST_VALUE(last_collected_date) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(last_collected_date) ORDER BY total_drift_percent DESC, collected_date_month, assay_kind ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_last_collected_date
    FROM summary
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT (long to wide)

FROM (
    SELECT next_last_collected_date, assay_kind, total_drift_percent
    FROM ranked
) src
PIVOT (
    COUNT(total_drift_percent)
```

```sql
    SELECT
        id,
        venue_surface,
        minutes_played,
        sprint_kmh,
        kickoff_ts_eff_raw,
        flag_is_home
    FROM dim_venues
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous kickoff_ts_eff_raw per venue_surface
    SELECT *, LAG(kickoff_ts_eff_raw) OVER (PARTITION BY venue_surface ORDER BY kickoff_ts_eff_raw, id) AS prev_kickoff_ts
    FROM filtered_venues
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 90 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_kickoff_ts IS NULL OR kickoff_ts_eff_raw > prev_kickoff_ts + INTERVAL 90 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY venue_surface ORDER BY kickoff_ts_eff_raw, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        venue_surface,
        burst_id,
        MIN(kickoff_ts_eff_raw) AS session_start,
        MAX(kickoff_ts_eff_raw) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(kickoff_ts_eff_raw)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(kickoff_ts_eff_raw))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY venue_surface, burst_id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        venue_surface,
        burst_id,
        session_end,
        LAST_VALUE(events) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_start) ORDER BY session_end DESC NULLS FIRST, venue_surface, burst_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_events,
        FIRST_VALUE(session_start) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_start) ORDER BY session_end DESC NULLS FIRST, venue_surface, burst_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_session_start
    FROM per_session
),
summary AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        venue_surface,
        TO_DATE(first_session_start) AS first_session_start_day,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
        ROUND(100 * COUNT(CASE WHEN venue_surface = 'grass' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_venue_surface_grass,
        ROUND(STDDEV(last_known_events), 2) AS stddev_last_known_events,
        MIN(burst_id) AS min_burst_id
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE first_session_start >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-09 09:00:00'
    GROUP BY venue_surface, TO_DATE(first_session_start)
)
SELECT
    venue_surface,
    first_session_start_day,
    n_rows,
    stddev_last_known_events,
    min_burst_id
FROM summary
```

```python
        "id",
        "venue_surface",
        "minutes_played",
        "sprint_kmh",
        "kickoff_ts_eff_raw",
        "flag_is_home",
    )
)

with_prev = filtered_venues.withColumn("prev_kickoff_ts", F.lag("kickoff_ts_eff_raw").over(Window.partitionBy("venue_surface").orderBy("kickoff_ts_eff_raw", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_kickoff_ts").isNull() | (F.col("kickoff_ts_eff_raw") > F.col("prev_kickoff_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
```

```sql
            SELECT c.event_time AS web_event_event_time, c.event_type AS web_event_event_type

            WHERE c.session_id = s.id

)
```

```python
w_segment_joined_on_month = Window.partitionBy("segment", F.month("joined_on"))
```

```sql
    COALESCE(a.fail_count, 0) AS fail_count,
    a.fail_avg_score,
    COALESCE(b.withdrawn_count_init, 0) AS withdrawn_count_init,
    COALESCE(b.withdrawn_total_score, 0) AS withdrawn_total_score,
    COALESCE(a.fail_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.withdrawn_count_init, 0) AS net_count
FROM fail_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN withdrawn_monthly b
  ON a.enrolled_at_month = b.enrolled_at_month
ORDER BY enrolled_at_month
```

```python
fail_monthly = (
    df_urban_conduits
    .filter(F.col("grade_status") == "FAIL")

    .agg(

        F.round(F.avg("score"), 2).alias("fail_avg_score"),

    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "enrolled_at").alias("enrolled_at_month"))

        F.sum("score").alias("withdrawn_total_score"),
    )
)

result = (

    .join(withdrawn_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.enrolled_at_month") == F.col("b.enrolled_at_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.enrolled_at_month"), F.col("b.enrolled_at_month")).alias("enrolled_at_month"),
```

```sql
    SELECT
```

```sql
        (SELECT MIN(p.played_at) FROM plays p WHERE p.listener_id = s.listener_id) AS first_played_at,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plays p WHERE p.listener_id = s.listener_id) AS play_count_2
    FROM in_window s
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    listener_id,
    played_at,
```

```python
    df_plays.alias("a")
    .join(

)
```

```python
with_windows = (
```

```sql
top_rows AS (
```

```sql
    b.est_total_kwh,
    COALESCE(a.ok_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.est_count, 0) AS net_count
```

```sql
        FIRST_VALUE(start_date) OVER (PARTITION BY holder_id, YEAR(end_date) ORDER BY end_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_start_date,
        NTH_VALUE(start_date, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY holder_id, YEAR(end_date) ORDER BY end_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_start_date,
        LAG(end_date) OVER (ORDER BY start_date DESC, id) AS prev_end_date

summary AS (

with_trends AS (

        ROUND(AVG(n_rows) OVER (PARTITION BY status, n_rows), 2) AS status_n_rows_avg_n_rows,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY n_rows, status ORDER BY total_end_date_seq DESC, status) AS total_end_date_seq_quintile,
        MIN(n_rows) OVER (PARTITION BY status, n_rows) AS status_n_rows_min_n_rows
    FROM summary
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    status,

    total_end_date_seq_rank,
    status_n_rows_avg_n_rows,
    status_n_rows_min_n_rows,
```

```sql
    FROM generators
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous outage_started_ts per unit_state
    SELECT *, LAG(outage_started_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY unit_state ORDER BY outage_started_ts, id) AS prev_outage_started_ts
    FROM scoped_generators
),

    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_outage_started_ts IS NULL OR outage_started_ts > prev_outage_started_ts + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY unit_state ORDER BY outage_started_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        unit_state,
        burst_id,
        MIN(outage_started_ts) AS session_start,
        MAX(outage_started_ts) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        SUM(fuel_cost_dollars) AS session_fuel_cost_dollars,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(outage_started_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(outage_started_ts))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY unit_state, burst_id
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM sessions
    WHERE duration_min > (SELECT AVG(duration_min) FROM sessions)
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT unit_state, burst_id, metric, amount
FROM (
    SELECT unit_state, burst_id, session_fuel_cost_dollars, duration_min
    FROM without_matches
) src
UNPIVOT (
    amount FOR metric IN (session_fuel_cost_dollars, duration_min)
) unp
```

```python
    .select(

        "downtime_min",
        "output_kwh",
        "fuel_cost_dollars",
        "outage_started_ts",
        F.concat(F.col("unit_state"), F.lit("#"), F.col("downtime_min").cast("string")).alias("unit_state_ref"),
    )
)

with_prev = scoped_generators.withColumn("prev_outage_started_ts", F.lag("outage_started_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("unit_state").orderBy("outage_started_ts", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_outage_started_ts").isNull() | (F.col("outage_started_ts") > F.col("prev_outage_started_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
```

```sql
    SELECT *, LAG(moved_at) OVER (PARTITION BY move_type ORDER BY moved_at, id) AS prev_moved_at
    FROM recent
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_moved_at IS NULL OR moved_at > prev_moved_at + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY move_type ORDER BY moved_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged

per_session AS (
    -- One row per session

        move_type,
        session_id,
        MIN(moved_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(moved_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        SUM(unit_price) AS session_unit_price,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(moved_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(moved_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY move_type, session_id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(move_type) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, n_events)) AS distinct_move_type_in_session_id_n_events,

    FROM per_session

    -- Group-level totals

        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(move_type)) AS move_type_list,
        MIN(session_id) AS min_session_id
    FROM with_windows
    GROUP BY 1
```

```python
    df_stock_moves
    .select(
        "id",

        "move_type",
        "qty",
        "moved_at",
        "operator",
        "unit_price",
        F.concat(F.col("operator"), F.lit("#"), F.col("sku_id").cast("string")).alias("operator_ref"),
    )
)

with_prev = recent.withColumn("prev_moved_at", F.lag("moved_at").over(Window.partitionBy("move_type").orderBy("moved_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_moved_at").isNull() | (F.col("moved_at") > F.col("prev_moved_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

per_session = (

result = (
```

```sql
    SELECT
```
```sql
        a.id,
        a.sku_id,
```

```sql
      ON b.sku_id = a.sku_id
     AND b.moved_at < a.moved_at
     AND b.moved_at >= a.moved_at - INTERVAL 1 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.sku_id, a.moved_at
),
scored AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        prior_unit_price_1d + prior_rows_1d AS prior_unit_price_1d_plus_prior_rows_1d
    FROM matched
)

    id,
    moved_at,
    prior_unit_price_1d,
```

```python
    df_stock_moves.alias("a")
    .join(

        & (F.col("b.moved_at") < F.col("a.moved_at"))
```

```sql
WITH pass_monthly AS (
    -- PASS rows per enrolled_at_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', enrolled_at) AS enrolled_at_month, COUNT(*) AS pass_count, ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS pass_avg_score
    FROM enrollments
    WHERE grade_status = 'PASS'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', enrolled_at)
),
fail_monthly AS (
    -- FAIL rows per enrolled_at_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', enrolled_at) AS enrolled_at_month, COUNT(*) AS fail_count, ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS fail_avg_score
    FROM enrollments
    WHERE grade_status = 'FAIL'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', enrolled_at)
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.enrolled_at_month, b.enrolled_at_month) AS enrolled_at_month,
    COALESCE(a.pass_count, 0) AS pass_count,
    a.pass_avg_score,
    COALESCE(b.fail_count, 0) AS fail_count,
    COALESCE(b.fail_avg_score, 0) AS fail_avg_score,
    COALESCE(a.pass_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.fail_count, 0) AS pass_count_minus_fail_count
FROM pass_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN fail_monthly b
  ON a.enrolled_at_month = b.enrolled_at_month
ORDER BY enrolled_at_month
```

```python
    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("grade_status") == "PASS")

    .agg(

    )
)

result = (
    pass_monthly.alias("a")
    .join(fail_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.enrolled_at_month") == F.col("b.enrolled_at_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.enrolled_at_month"), F.col("b.enrolled_at_month")).alias("enrolled_at_month"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.pass_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("pass_count"),

        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.pass_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.fail_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("pass_count_minus_fail_count"),
    )
```

```python
        "closed_at",
        "priority",
        "channel",
        "csat",
        "tags",
        F.concat(F.col("channel"), F.lit("#"), F.col("agent_id").cast("string")).alias("channel_ref"),
    )
)

    filtered_tickets.alias("s")
    .join(df_support_agents.alias("su"), F.col("su.id") == F.col("s.agent_id"), "inner")

        "su.agent_name",
        F.col("su.tier").alias("agent_tier"),
        F.col("su.hired_on").alias("agent_hired_on"),
    )
)

w_agent_tier_agent_id_by_close_2 = Window.partitionBy("agent_tier", "agent_id").orderBy(F.col("closed_at").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
w_channel_by_requester_id = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("requester_id", "id")
ranked = (

        F.sum("csat").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_tier", "agent_id").orderBy(F.col("closed_at").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("csat_sum_2_prior"),

        F.last("requester_id").over(Window.orderBy("csat", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_requester_id"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(w_agent_tier_agent_id_by_close_2), 3).alias("closed_at_cume_dist"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(w_channel_by_requester_id), 3).alias("requester_id_cume_dist"),
        F.nth_value("opened_at", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("requester_id", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_opened_at"),
        F.first("requester_id").over(Window.orderBy("csat", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_requester_id"),
        F.round(F.avg("csat").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_tier", "agent_id").orderBy(F.col("closed_at").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(-1, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("csat_avg_2"),
        F.min("csat").over(Window.partitionBy("channel")).alias("channel_min_csat"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("requester_id")), 3).alias("requester_id_percent_rank"),
    )
)

scored = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("requester_id") >= 7)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("csat_avg_2") / F.nullif(F.col("last_requester_id"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("csat_avg_2_per_last_requester_id"),
        F.when(F.col("priority").isin("P4", "P2"), "group_a").when(F.col("priority") == "P1", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("priority_group"),
        F.date_add(F.col("agent_hired_on"), 7).alias("agent_hired_on_plus_7d"),
    )
)

totals = (
    scored
    .groupBy(
        "agent_id",
        F.date_format("second_opened_at", "yyyy-MM").alias("second_opened_at_ym"),
        F.date_trunc("month", "agent_hired_on_plus_7d").alias("agent_hired_on_plus_7d_month"),

        F.round(100 * F.count(F.when(F.upper(F.trim(F.col("agent_name"))).like("G%"), 1)) / F.count("*"), 1).alias("pct_upper_trim_agent_name_like_g"),
        F.count(F.when(F.upper(F.trim(F.col("agent_name"))).like("K%"), 1)).alias("n_upper_trim_agent_name_like_k"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.percentile_approx("csat_vs_agent_hired_on_year_agent_id_avg", 0.5).alias("median_csat_vs_agent_hired_on_year_agent_id_avg"),
        F.round(F.stddev("csat_avg_2"), 2).alias("stddev_csat_avg_2"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("row_count") >= 2)
)

result = (
    totals
    .select(
        "agent_id",
        "second_opened_at_ym",
        "agent_hired_on_plus_7d_month",
        "last_requester_id_priority_not_in_p3_p4",
        "pct_upper_trim_agent_name_like_g",
        "n_upper_trim_agent_name_like_k",
        "row_count",
        "median_csat_vs_agent_hired_on_year_agent_id_avg",
        F.greatest(F.col("stddev_csat_avg_2"), F.col("row_count")).alias("greatest_stddev_csat_avg_2_row_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("stddev_csat_avg_2"), F.lit(0.0)).alias("stddev_csat_avg_2_filled"),

        "agent_id",
        "second_opened_at_ym",
        "agent_hired_on_plus_7d_month",
    )
    .limit(20)
)
```

```python
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("quality"))).alias("quality_len"),
        F.date_format(F.col("read_at"), "yyyy-MM-dd HH:00").alias("read_at_label"),

w_all_by_read_at = Window.orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id")
w_site_id_by_quality_len = Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("quality_len", "id")

    prepared_readings
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("quality_len").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_quality_len"),
        F.sum("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "quality_len").orderBy("kwh", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("kwh_sum_3_prior"),
        F.round(F.col("quality_len") / F.nullif(F.sum("quality_len").over(w_quality_len), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("quality_len_share_of_quality_len"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("read_at") - F.unix_timestamp(F.lag("read_at").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("quality_len", "id")))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_since_prev_read_at"),
        F.lag("read_at", 3).over(w_all_by_read_at).alias("prev3_read_at"),
        (F.col("quality_len") - F.lag("quality_len").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id"))).alias("quality_len_change"),
        F.lag("quality_len").over(Window.partitionBy("quality_len").orderBy("voltage", "id")).alias("prev_quality_len"),
        F.max("voltage").over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "quality_len").orderBy("kwh", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("max_voltage_so_far"),
        F.first("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("quality_len", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_kwh"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("read_at"))).alias("rows_in_read_at_year"),
        F.min("voltage").over(Window.partitionBy("quality_len").orderBy("voltage", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("min_voltage_so_far"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc())), 3).alias("read_at_cume_dist"),
        F.lead("read_at").over(w_site_id_by_quality_len).alias("next_read_at"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("voltage", "id")).alias("voltage_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("read_at", "id")).alias("rn"),
        F.round(F.col("quality_len") - F.avg("quality_len").over(Window.partitionBy("quality_len")), 2).alias("quality_len_vs_quality_len_avg"),
    )
)

derived = (
    windowed
    .select(
        "id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        "quality_len",
        "first_quality_len",
        "kwh_sum_3_prior",
        "minutes_since_prev_read_at",
        "prev3_read_at",

    .groupBy("first_quality_len", "quality")
    .agg(

        F.countDistinct("quality").alias("distinct_qualitys"),
    )

w_distinct_qualitys_by_cnt = Window.partitionBy("distinct_qualitys").orderBy(F.col("cnt").desc(), "first_quality_len", "quality")
w_first_quality_len_cnt = Window.partitionBy("first_quality_len", "cnt")
metrics = (

        F.round(F.col("cnt") - F.avg("cnt").over(w_first_quality_len_cnt), 2).alias("cnt_vs_first_quality_len_cnt_avg"),
    )
```

```sql
    COALESCE(b.paid_count, 0) AS paid_count,
    b.paid_total_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(a.rejected_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.paid_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM rejected_by_adjuster a
FULL OUTER JOIN paid_by_adjuster b
```

```python
    .withColumn("next_store_sale_revenue", F.lead("store_sale_revenue").over(Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("sqft", "id")))
```

```sql
    WHERE s.kwh >= g.median_kwh

    max_voltage,
    LEAST(max_voltage, row_count) AS least_max_voltage_row_count,
```

```python
    df_meter_readings
    .filter((F.col("site_id").isNotNull()) & (F.col("kwh") < 109.0))
    .select(

        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-12-31").cast("date"), F.col("read_at")).alias("days_since_read_at"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("quality"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("quality_or_unknown"),
    )
)

site_id_stats = (
    cleaned_readings
    .groupBy("site_id")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("kwh", 0.5).alias("median_kwh"))
```

```python
    )

w_read_at_year_site_id = Window.partitionBy(F.year("read_at"), "site_id")
w_site_id_read_at_year_by_read_2 = Window.partitionBy("site_id", F.year("read_at")).orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id")
sequenced = (
    cleaned_readings
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "read_at_year",
        F.nth_value("read_at_year", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("read_at_year").orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_read_at_year"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_read_at_year_site_id).alias("rows_in_read_at_year_site_id"),
        F.round(F.avg("voltage").over(w_read_at_year_site_id), 2).alias("read_at_year_site_id_avg_voltage"),
        F.lead("read_at_year").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy(F.col("read_at_year").desc(), "id")).alias("next_read_at_year"),

        F.max("voltage").over(w_read_at_year_site_id).alias("pacific_monolith"),

        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy(F.col("kwh").desc_nulls_first())).alias("kwh_dense_rank"),
```

```sql
latest AS (
```

```sql
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

with_stats AS (
```

```python
base = (
    df_athletes

    .select(
        "id",
        "club_id",
        "venue_surface",
        "attendance",
        "goal_minute",
        "fixture_day",
        "is_home",
        F.last_day(F.col("fixture_day")).alias("fixture_day_month_end"),
    )
)

without_matches = (
    base.alias("s")
    .join(df_athletes.alias("a"), (F.col("a.club_id") == F.col("s.club_id")) & (F.col("a.fixture_day") < F.lit("2025-05-20").cast("date")) & (F.col("a.attendance").between(10778, 43838)), "left_semi")
)

    .filter(F.col("club_id") >= 4)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2026-01-01").cast("date"), F.col("fixture_day_month_end")).alias("days_since_fixture_day_month_end"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("venue_surface"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("venue_surface_or_unknown"),
    )

venue_surface_stats = (
    scored
    .groupBy("venue_surface")
    .agg(F.avg("days_since_fixture_day_month_end").alias("avg_days_since_fixture_day_month_end"))
)

above_average = (
    scored.alias("s")
    .join(venue_surface_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.venue_surface") == F.col("s.venue_surface"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.days_since_fixture_day_month_end") > F.col("g.avg_days_since_fixture_day_month_end"))

summary = (

    .filter(F.col("fixture_day_month_end") < F.lit("2025-07-01").cast("date"))
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("month", "fixture_day_month_end").alias("fixture_day_month_end_month"),
        "venue_surface_or_unknown",
        "club_id",

        F.count(F.when(~F.col("is_home"), 1)).alias("n_is_home_false"),
        F.max("fixture_day").alias("last_fixture_day"),
    )
)

athlete_stats = (
    df_athletes
    .groupBy("club_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("fixture_day").alias("last_athlete_fixture_day"),
        F.count("*").alias("athlete_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("venue_surface").isin("turf", "grass"), 1)).alias("athlete_venue_surface_count"),
    )
)

with_stats = (
    summary.alias("s")
    .join(athlete_stats.alias("a"), F.col("a.club_id") == F.col("s.club_id"), "left")

        "s.*",
        "a.last_athlete_fixture_day",
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.athlete_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("athlete_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.athlete_venue_surface_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("athlete_venue_surface_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_stats
    .select(
        "fixture_day_month_end_month",
        "max_goal_minute",
        "n_is_home_false",
        "last_fixture_day",
        "last_athlete_fixture_day",
        "athlete_count",
        "athlete_venue_surface_count",
```

```python
        "st.student_name",
        F.col("st.enrolled_on").alias("student_enrolled_on"),

    )

        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("enrolled_at") - F.unix_timestamp(F.lag("enrolled_at").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("student_enrolled_on")).orderBy(F.col("bollard_span").desc_nulls_first(), "id")))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_since_prev_enrolled_at"),
    )
)

w_student_gpa_rank_student_enr = Window.partitionBy("student_gpa_rank", F.month("student_enrolled_on"))
sequenced = (

    .select(

        "enrolled_at",
        "student_enrolled_on",
        "student_gpa_quintile",
        "distinct_course_id_in_enrolled_at_month_student_",

        "s.student_gpa_quintile",

        F.col("distinct_course_id_in_enrolled_at_month_student_").asc_nulls_last(),
```

```python
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("log_ts"), "key").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").asc_nulls_first())).alias("latency_ms_dense_rank"),
    )

        F.min("latency_ms").over(Window.partitionBy("service", "key")).alias("service_min_latency_ms"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").asc_nulls_first())).alias("latency_ms_percent_rank"),
    )
)

result = (

    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("service_min_latency_ms") >= 2595, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("service_min_latency_ms_tier"),
```

```python
    .select(

    )
)
```

```python
    base
    .withColumn("kettle_span", F.when(F.col("txn_time") - F.lag("txn_time").over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))

    .select("s.*")

base_transactions = (

    .filter((F.col("txn_time") > F.lit("2023-04-13 22:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("merchant").isNotNull())
```

```sql
    FROM cleaned_training_loads

unique_rows AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        venue_surface,
        jersey_number,
        club_motto,
        jersey_number_rank,
        jersey_number_vs_venue_surface_avg,
        last_known_jersey_number
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY venue_surface ORDER BY jersey_number_vs_venue_surface_avg DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank

    WHERE recency_rank = 1

    venue_surface,
    jersey_number,
    jersey_number_rank,
    jersey_number_vs_venue_surface_avg,
```

```sql
        src.units,
        src.revenue,
        src.sale_date_minus_43d,
        p.sqft
    FROM base src
    LEFT JOIN stores p
        ON src.store_id = p.id
    WHERE p.city = 'Bangkok'

deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter

    FROM with_dims
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM deduped
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE store_id = 2
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        sale_date_minus_43d,
        rn,

),
enriched AS (

    FROM scored

),
report AS (

)
```

```sql
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter enrollments
    SELECT
        id,
        student_id,
        course_id,
        term,
        score,
        grade_status,
        enrolled_at,
        MONTH(enrolled_at) AS enrolled_at_month
    FROM enrollments
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous enrolled_at per term
    SELECT *, LAG(enrolled_at) OVER (PARTITION BY term ORDER BY enrolled_at, id) AS prev_enrolled_at
    FROM cleaned
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 2 hours)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_enrolled_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(enrolled_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_enrolled_at)) / 60 > 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY term ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        term,
        burst_id,
        MIN(enrolled_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(enrolled_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        SUM(enrolled_at_month) AS session_enrolled_at_month,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(enrolled_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(enrolled_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY term, burst_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    term,
    burst_id,
    session_start,
    n_events,
    session_enrolled_at_month,
    duration_min,
    ROUND(duration_min * 1.1, 2) AS duration_min_adj,
    FLOOR(duration_min / 50) * 50 AS duration_min_bucket
FROM session_summary
WHERE n_events < 6
ORDER BY duration_min DESC, duration_min_bucket DESC
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_enrollments
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "score",
        "grade_status",
        "enrolled_at",
        F.month(F.col("enrolled_at")).alias("enrolled_at_month"),
    )
)

with_prev = cleaned.withColumn("prev_enrolled_at", F.lag("enrolled_at").over(Window.partitionBy("term").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_enrolled_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("enrolled_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_enrolled_at")) / 60 > 120), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("term").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

session_summary = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("term", "burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("enrolled_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("enrolled_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_events"),
        F.sum("enrolled_at_month").alias("session_enrolled_at_month"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("enrolled_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("enrolled_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

result = (
    session_summary
    .filter(F.col("n_events") < 6)
    .select(
        "term",
        "burst_id",
        "session_start",
        "n_events",
        "session_enrolled_at_month",
        "duration_min",
        F.round(F.col("duration_min") * 1.1, 2).alias("duration_min_adj"),
        (F.floor(F.col("duration_min") / 50) * 50).alias("duration_min_bucket"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("duration_min").desc(), F.col("duration_min_bucket").desc())
)
```

```sql
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter plays
    SELECT
        id,
        listener_id,
        track_id,
        played_at,
        ms_played,
        device,
        source,
        CONCAT(source, '#', CAST(listener_id AS STRING)) AS source_ref
    FROM plays

with_prev AS (
    -- Previous played_at per source
    SELECT *, LAG(played_at) OVER (PARTITION BY source ORDER BY played_at, id) AS prev_played_at
    FROM cleaned
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_played_at IS NULL OR played_at > prev_played_at + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY source ORDER BY played_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        source,
        session_no,
        MIN(played_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(played_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(played_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(played_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY source, session_no
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    source,
    session_no,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    events,
    duration_min
FROM per_session
ORDER BY session_end
```

```sql
    FROM sessionized
```

```sql
enriched AS (
```

```sql
    FROM sessions
)
```

```python
    .select(
        "*",
        F.size(F.collect_set("operator").over(Window.partitionBy("sku_id"))).alias("distinct_operator_in_sku_id"),

        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_operator_move_type_by_unit_p), 3).alias("unit_price_percent_rank"),
        F.round(F.col("unit_price") - F.avg("unit_price").over(Window.partitionBy("move_type")), 2).alias("unit_price_vs_move_type_avg"),
```

```sql
    -- Scope the tutors rows
    SELECT *
    FROM tutors
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous submitted_ts_orig per house_label
    SELECT *, LAG(submitted_ts_orig) OVER (PARTITION BY house_label ORDER BY submitted_ts_orig, id) AS prev_submitted_ts
    FROM valid
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 2 hours)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_submitted_ts IS NULL OR submitted_ts_orig > prev_submitted_ts + INTERVAL 2 HOURS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ref_new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(ref_new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY house_label ORDER BY submitted_ts_orig, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        house_label,
        session_id,
        MIN(submitted_ts_orig) AS session_start,
        MAX(submitted_ts_orig) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        SUM(seat_count) AS session_seat_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(submitted_ts_orig)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(submitted_ts_orig))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY house_label, session_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    house_label,
    session_id,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    event_count,
    session_seat_count,
    duration_min
FROM sessions
ORDER BY event_count, session_end DESC
```

```sql
    SELECT listing_no, COUNT(*) AS withdrawn_count, SUM(storey_no) AS withdrawn_total_storey_no

    FROM fact_valuations
    WHERE listing_status = 'SOLD'
    GROUP BY listing_no

    a.withdrawn_total_storey_no,
    COALESCE(b.sold_count, 0) AS sold_count,
    b.sold_total_storey_no,
    COALESCE(a.withdrawn_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.sold_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM withdrawn_by_listing_no a
FULL OUTER JOIN sold_by_listing_no b
  ON a.listing_no = b.listing_no
ORDER BY listing_no
```

```sql
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.site_id,
        a.read_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_12h,
        SUM(b.kwh) AS prior_kwh_12h
    FROM meter_readings a
    LEFT JOIN meter_readings b
      ON b.site_id = a.site_id
     AND b.read_at < a.read_at
     AND b.read_at >= a.read_at - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.site_id, a.read_at
),
site_id_stats AS (
    -- Max prior_rows_12h per site_id
    SELECT site_id, MAX(prior_rows_12h) AS max_prior_rows_12h
    FROM covered
    GROUP BY site_id
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_prior_rows_12h,
        ROUND(s.prior_rows_12h - g.max_prior_rows_12h, 2) AS prior_rows_12h_minus_max
    FROM covered s
    JOIN site_id_stats g ON g.site_id = s.site_id
    WHERE s.prior_rows_12h = g.max_prior_rows_12h
),
labeled AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_FORMAT(read_at, 'MMM yyyy') AS read_at_label,
        ROUND(prior_rows_12h / NULLIF(prior_kwh_12h, 0), 3) AS prior_rows_12h_per_prior_kwh_12h
    FROM compared
)
SELECT
    id,
    site_id,
    read_at,
    prior_kwh_12h,
    max_prior_rows_12h,
    prior_rows_12h_minus_max,
    read_at_label,
    COALESCE(prior_kwh_12h, 0.0) AS prior_kwh_12h_filled
FROM labeled
ORDER BY id, site_id DESC
LIMIT 5
```

```sql
    -- Scope the ticket_scans rows
    SELECT
        id,
        exhibition_id,
        loan_status,
        wing_label,
        created_year,
        acquired_date,
        COALESCE(created_year, 0) AS created_year_filled,
        UPPER(TRIM(wing_label)) AS wing_label_clean,
        ABS(created_year - 1897) AS created_year_distance
    FROM ticket_scans
    WHERE created_year BETWEEN 1569 AND 1961
      AND wing_label IN ('east', 'west')
),
enriched AS (
    -- Join exhibitions
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.exhibition_id,
        s.loan_status,
        s.wing_label,
        s.created_year,
        s.acquired_date,
        s.created_year_filled,
        s.wing_label_clean,
        s.created_year_distance,
        e.loan_state AS exhibition_loan_state,
        g.scanned_at AS gallery_scanned_at,
        g.loan_state AS gallery_loan_state
    FROM cleaned_ticket_scans s
    JOIN exhibitions e ON e.id = s.exhibition_id
    LEFT JOIN galleries g ON g.id = e.gallery_id
    WHERE e.loan_state IN ('borrowed', 'on_loan')
),
tagged AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        wing_label,
        acquired_date,
        created_year_filled,
        wing_label_clean,
        created_year_distance,
        exhibition_loan_state,
        TO_DATE(gallery_scanned_at) AS gallery_scanned_at_date
    FROM enriched
),
wing_label_stats AS (
    -- Max created_year_distance per wing_label
    SELECT wing_label, MAX(created_year_distance) AS max_created_year_distance
    FROM tagged
    GROUP BY wing_label
),
vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_created_year_distance,
        ROUND(s.created_year_distance - g.max_created_year_distance, 2) AS created_year_distance_minus_max
    FROM tagged s
    JOIN wing_label_stats g ON g.wing_label = s.wing_label
    WHERE s.created_year_distance = g.max_created_year_distance
),
annotated AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LENGTH(TRIM(exhibition_loan_state)) AS exhibition_loan_state_len,
        CONCAT(wing_label, '#', CAST(created_year_distance AS STRING)) AS wing_label_ref
    FROM vs_group
    WHERE max_created_year_distance <= 1214.4
)
SELECT
    id,
    wing_label,
    acquired_date,
    wing_label_clean,
    created_year_distance,
    exhibition_loan_state,
    gallery_scanned_at_date,
    max_created_year_distance,
    created_year_distance_minus_max,
    exhibition_loan_state_len,
    ROUND(created_year_distance / NULLIF(created_year_filled, 0), 3) AS created_year_distance_per_created_year_filled,
    ROUND(created_year_filled / NULLIF(created_year_distance, 0), 3) AS created_year_filled_per_created_year_distance
FROM annotated
ORDER BY created_year_distance_per_created_year_filled
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned_ticket_scans = (
    df_ticket_scans
    .filter((F.col("created_year").between(1569, 1961)) & (F.col("wing_label").isin("east", "west")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "exhibition_id",
        "loan_status",
        "wing_label",
        "created_year",
        "acquired_date",
        F.coalesce(F.col("created_year"), F.lit(0)).alias("created_year_filled"),
        F.upper(F.trim(F.col("wing_label"))).alias("wing_label_clean"),
        F.abs(F.col("created_year") - 1897).alias("created_year_distance"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    cleaned_ticket_scans.alias("s")
    .join(df_exhibitions.alias("e"), F.col("e.id") == F.col("s.exhibition_id"), "inner")
    .join(df_galleries.alias("g"), F.col("g.id") == F.col("e.gallery_id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("e.loan_state").isin("borrowed", "on_loan"))
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.exhibition_id",
        "s.loan_status",
        "s.wing_label",
        "s.created_year",
        "s.acquired_date",
        "s.created_year_filled",
        "s.wing_label_clean",
        "s.created_year_distance",
        F.col("e.loan_state").alias("exhibition_loan_state"),
        F.col("g.scanned_at").alias("gallery_scanned_at"),
        F.col("g.loan_state").alias("gallery_loan_state"),
    )
)

tagged = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "wing_label",
        "acquired_date",
        "created_year_filled",
        "wing_label_clean",
        "created_year_distance",
        "exhibition_loan_state",
        F.to_date(F.col("gallery_scanned_at")).alias("gallery_scanned_at_date"),
    )
)

wing_label_stats = (
    tagged
    .groupBy("wing_label")
    .agg(F.max("created_year_distance").alias("max_created_year_distance"))
)

vs_group = (
    tagged.alias("s")
    .join(wing_label_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.wing_label") == F.col("s.wing_label"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.created_year_distance") == F.col("g.max_created_year_distance"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.max_created_year_distance",
        F.round(F.col("s.created_year_distance") - F.col("g.max_created_year_distance"), 2).alias("created_year_distance_minus_max"),
    )
)

annotated = (
    vs_group
    .filter(F.col("max_created_year_distance") <= 1214.4)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("exhibition_loan_state"))).alias("exhibition_loan_state_len"),
        F.concat(F.col("wing_label"), F.lit("#"), F.col("created_year_distance").cast("string")).alias("wing_label_ref"),
    )
)

result = (
    annotated
    .select(
        "id",
        "wing_label",
        "acquired_date",
        "wing_label_clean",
        "created_year_distance",
        "exhibition_loan_state",
        "gallery_scanned_at_date",
        "max_created_year_distance",
        "created_year_distance_minus_max",
        "exhibition_loan_state_len",
        F.round(F.col("created_year_distance") / F.nullif(F.col("created_year_filled"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("created_year_distance_per_created_year_filled"),
        F.round(F.col("created_year_filled") / F.nullif(F.col("created_year_distance"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("created_year_filled_per_created_year_distance"),
    )
    .orderBy("created_year_distance_per_created_year_filled")
)
```

```python
filtered = (
    df_fare_taps
    .filter(F.col("route_opened_date") < F.lit("2025-04-15").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "bus_route_id",
        "stop_label",
        "stop_seq",
        "flag_has_shelter",
        F.concat(F.col("stop_label"), F.lit("#"), F.col("stop_seq").cast("string")).alias("stop_label_ref"),
        F.upper(F.trim(F.col("stop_label"))).alias("stop_label_clean"),

)

    .join(df_bus_stops.alias("b"), (F.col("b.bus_route_ref") == F.col("s.bus_route_id")) & (F.year(F.col("b.route_opened_date")) == 2024), "left_anti")
    .filter(~F.col("flag_has_shelter"))
)

screened = (
    qualified.alias("s")
    .join(df_bus_stops.alias("b"), (F.col("b.bus_route_ref") == F.col("s.bus_route_id")) & (F.length(F.trim(F.col("b.kiosk_owner"))) >= 4) & (F.col("b.dwell_secs") < 262), "left_semi")
    .filter(F.col("stop_seq") > 14)
)

w_bus_route_id = Window.partitionBy("bus_route_id")
sequenced = (
    screened
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.avg("stop_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("bus_route_id")), 2).alias("bus_route_id_avg_stop_seq"),
        F.round(F.col("stop_seq") / F.nullif(F.sum("stop_seq").over(w_bus_route_id), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("stop_seq_share_of_bus_route_id"),
        F.round(F.col("stop_seq") - F.avg("stop_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("bus_route_id")), 2).alias("stop_seq_vs_bus_route_id_avg"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("bus_route_id", "flag_has_shelter").orderBy(F.col("stop_seq").desc())), 3).alias("stop_seq_cume_dist"),
    )
)

without_matches = (

    .join(df_bus_routes.alias("b"), (F.col("b.id") == F.col("s.bus_route_id")) & (F.col("b.tapped_ts") < F.lit("2025-03-08 14:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & (F.col("b.headway_minutes") < 32), "left_anti")
)

w_flag_has_shelter_stop_label = Window.partitionBy("flag_has_shelter", "stop_label").orderBy(F.col("stop_seq_share_of_bus_route_id").desc())

    without_matches
    .select(

        F.round(F.avg("bus_route_id_avg_stop_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("stop_label")), 2).alias("stop_label_avg_bus_route_id_avg_stop_seq"),

)
```

```sql
        SUM(b.score_lo_nom) AS prior_score_12h

    -- Running and moving aggregates

        alt_prior_rows_12h - LAG(alt_prior_rows_12h) OVER (ORDER BY enrolled_at, id) AS prior_rows_12h_change,

    FROM in_window

compared AS (

    FROM metrics s
```

```sql
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        build_project_id,
        lost_days,
        budget_thb,
        broke_ground_on,
        CASE WHEN permit_state IN ('expired', 'granted') THEN 'group_a' WHEN permit_state = 'pending' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS permit_state_group
    FROM site_crews
    WHERE build_project_id IS NOT NULL
      AND broke_ground_on >= DATE '2024-06-14'
),
combined_details_build_project AS (
    -- Join build_projects
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.build_project_id,
        s.budget_thb,
        s.broke_ground_on,
        s.permit_state_group,
        b.crew_size AS build_project_crew_size,
        b.material_kind AS build_project_material_kind,
        b.incident_at AS build_project_incident_at_net
    FROM valid s
    LEFT JOIN build_projects b ON b.id = s.build_project_id
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        NTH_VALUE(broke_ground_on, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY permit_state_group ORDER BY build_project_incident_at_net NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_broke_ground_on,
        MAX(budget_thb) OVER (PARTITION BY permit_state_group ORDER BY build_project_incident_at_net NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS budget_thb_max_2_prior,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(build_project_incident_at_net) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(LAG(build_project_incident_at_net) OVER w_permit_state_group_by_build_3)) / 60, 1) AS minutes_since_prev_build_project_incident_at,
        SUM(budget_thb) OVER (PARTITION BY permit_state_group, YEAR(broke_ground_on)) AS permit_state_group_broke_ground_on_year_sum_budg,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_permit_state_group_by_build_4 AS rn,
        MIN(budget_thb) OVER w_permit_state_group_broke_gro AS permit_state_group_broke_ground_on_year_min_budg,
        build_project_crew_size - LAG(build_project_crew_size) OVER w_permit_state_group_by_build_4 AS build_project_crew_size_change,
        FIRST_VALUE(build_project_crew_size) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY permit_state_group ORDER BY build_project_crew_size DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_build_project_crew_size
    FROM combined_details_build_project
    WINDOW w_permit_state_group_by_build_3 AS (PARTITION BY permit_state_group ORDER BY build_project_incident_at_net NULLS LAST, id), w_permit_state_group_by_build_4 AS (PARTITION BY permit_state_group ORDER BY build_project_crew_size DESC, id), w_permit_state_group_broke_gro AS (PARTITION BY permit_state_group, YEAR(broke_ground_on))
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        build_project_id,
        budget_thb,
        broke_ground_on,
        permit_state_group,
        build_project_material_kind,
        build_project_incident_at_net,
        second_broke_ground_on,
        budget_thb_max_2_prior,
        minutes_since_prev_build_project_incident_at,
        permit_state_group_broke_ground_on_year_sum_budg,
        rn,
        first_known_build_project_crew_size,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY build_project_id, permit_state_group ORDER BY broke_ground_on, id) AS rn_2,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY permit_state_group ORDER BY first_known_build_project_crew_size) AS first_known_build_project_crew_size_dense_rank,
        MAX(build_project_crew_size) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', broke_ground_on), DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', build_project_incident_at_net)) AS broke_ground_on_month_build_project_incident_at_,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY second_broke_ground_on ASC NULLS LAST, id) AS second_broke_ground_on_quintile,
        MIN(build_project_crew_size) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', broke_ground_on), DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', build_project_incident_at_net)) AS broke_ground_on_month_build_project_incident_at__2,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY rn DESC, id), 3) AS rn_cume_dist
    FROM sequenced
),
summary AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        permit_state_group,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', broke_ground_on) AS broke_ground_on_month,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count,
        MIN(first_known_build_project_crew_size) AS min_first_known_build_project_crew_size,
        SUM(CASE WHEN build_project_material_kind NOT IN ('glass', 'steel') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_build_project_material_kind,
        SUM(second_broke_ground_on_quintile) AS total_second_broke_ground_on_quintile
    FROM metrics
    WHERE build_project_incident_at_net >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-07 12:00:00'
    GROUP BY permit_state_group, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', broke_ground_on)
    HAVING SUM(permit_state_group_broke_ground_on_year_sum_budg) > 135085000.0
)
SELECT
    permit_state_group,
    broke_ground_on_month,
    n_build_project_material_kind,
    total_second_broke_ground_on_quintile,
    MONTH(broke_ground_on_month) AS broke_ground_on_month_month,
    CASE WHEN permit_state_group IN ('group_b', 'group_a') THEN 'group_a' WHEN permit_state_group = 'other' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS permit_state_group_group
FROM summary
ORDER BY broke_ground_on_month, broke_ground_on_month_month DESC, permit_state_group
LIMIT 5
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("prev_quantity", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("store_id").isin([4, 5, 6]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.date_format("last_restock", "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("last_restock_label"),
    )
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("product_id") == 2)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("quantity").over(w_recent).alias("next_quantity"),
        F.lag("quantity").over(w_recent).alias("prev_quantity"),
        F.row_number().over(w_recent).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

latest = (
    scored
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("last_restock").desc_nulls_first(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

scored_inventory = (
    latest
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "last_restock_label",
        "next_quantity",
        "prev_quantity",
        "rn",
        F.max("quantity").over(w_running).alias("last4_max_quantity"),
        F.sum("quantity").over(w_running).alias("last4_sum_quantity"),
        F.count("quantity").over(w_running).alias("last4_count_quantity"),
    )
)

joined = (
    scored_inventory
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("src.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.product_id",
        "src.next_quantity",
        "src.last4_max_quantity",
        "src.last4_sum_quantity",
        "src.last4_count_quantity",
        F.col("p.product_name"),
        F.col("p.launch_date"),
    )
)

result = (
    joined
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("next_quantity") >= 182, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("next_quantity_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("last4_count_quantity") >= 13, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("last4_count_quantity_tier"),
        "product_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("last4_count_quantity").alias("min_last4_count_quantity"),
        F.min("next_quantity").alias("min_next_quantity"),
        F.percentile_approx("last4_sum_quantity", 0.5).alias("last4_sum_quantity_p50"),
        F.round(F.avg("last4_count_quantity"), 2).alias("avg_last4_count_quantity"),
        F.min("last4_sum_quantity").alias("min_last4_sum_quantity"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("min_last4_sum_quantity").desc_nulls_last())
)
```

```sql
    FROM enriched
),
sessionized AS (

    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id

with_dims AS (

)
```

```python
cleaned = (
    df_incident_pages
    .filter((F.col("cloud_region").isin("eu-west-1", "ap-se-1")) | (F.col("vcpu_cnt") < 42))
    .select(
        "id",
```

```sql
        MAX(ms_played) AS max_play_ms_played
    FROM plays

),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach plays metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        p.avg_play_ms_played,
        p.max_play_ms_played
    FROM with_details s
    LEFT JOIN play_stats p ON p.listener_id = s.listener_id
),
joined AS (
    -- Join tracks
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.listener_id,
        s.track_id,
        s.device,
        s.listener_interests,
        s.track_title,
        s.track_release_date,
        s.avg_play_ms_played,
        s.max_play_ms_played,
        t.artist_id AS track_artist_id,
        t.bpm AS track_bpm
    FROM with_stats s
    JOIN tracks t ON t.id = s.track_id
    WHERE t.artist_id IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        listener_id,
        device,
        listener_interests,
        track_title,
        track_release_date,

        max_play_ms_played,

),
without_matches AS (

)
```

```sql
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w_all_by_enrolled_at, 3) AS enrolled_at_cume_dist,
        ROUND(score / NULLIF(SUM(score) OVER (PARTITION BY term), 0), 4) AS score_share_of_term
    FROM cleaned
    WINDOW w_term_course_id_by_enrolled_a AS (PARTITION BY term, course_id ORDER BY enrolled_at NULLS LAST), w_course_id_by_enrolled_at AS (PARTITION BY course_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id), w_all_by_enrolled_at AS (ORDER BY enrolled_at, id)
```

```python
    df_enrollments
    .filter((F.col("term") != "2025T2") & (F.col("grade_status").isin("FAIL", "PASS", "INCOMPLETE")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "score",
        "enrolled_at",
    )
)

w_term_course_id_by_enrolled_a = Window.partitionBy("term", "course_id").orderBy(F.col("enrolled_at").asc_nulls_last())
w_course_id_by_enrolled_at = Window.partitionBy("course_id").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id")

        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "score",

        F.nth_value("enrolled_at", 2).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("enrolled_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_enrolled_at"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("term").orderBy("enrolled_at")).alias("enrolled_at_rank_2"),
        F.round(F.avg("score").over(Window.partitionBy("term", "course_id").orderBy("score", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)), 2).alias("score_avg_3_prior"),
        F.round(F.col("score") - F.avg("score").over(Window.partitionBy("term")), 2).alias("score_vs_term_avg"),
        (F.col("score") - F.lag("score").over(w_course_id_by_enrolled_at)).alias("score_change"),
```

```sql
derived AS (
```

```sql
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.sku_id,
        a.moved_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_1d,
        SUM(b.unit_price) AS prior_unit_price_1d
    FROM stock_moves a
    LEFT JOIN stock_moves b
      ON b.sku_id = a.sku_id
     AND b.moved_at < a.moved_at
     AND b.moved_at >= a.moved_at - INTERVAL 1 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.sku_id, a.moved_at
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep the earliest row per sku_id
    SELECT
        id,
        sku_id,
        moved_at,
        prior_rows_1d,
        prior_unit_price_1d
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sku_id ORDER BY prior_unit_price_1d, id) AS row_num
        FROM covered
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        sku_id,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(prior_unit_price_1d, 0.5) AS median_prior_unit_price_1d,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        MAX(moved_at) AS last_moved_at,
        MIN(prior_rows_1d) AS min_prior_rows_1d,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        ROUND(STDDEV(prior_rows_1d), 2) AS stddev_prior_rows_1d
    FROM latest
    GROUP BY sku_id
)
SELECT
    sku_id,
    cnt,
    min_prior_rows_1d,
    MAX(last_moved_at) AS last_last_moved_at
FROM rollup_base
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((sku_id, cnt, min_prior_rows_1d), (sku_id), ())
ORDER BY sku_id NULLS LAST, cnt NULLS LAST, min_prior_rows_1d NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

covered = (
    df_stock_moves.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_stock_moves.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.sku_id") == F.col("a.sku_id"))
        & (F.col("b.moved_at") < F.col("a.moved_at"))
        & (F.col("b.moved_at") >= F.col("a.moved_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.sku_id", "a.moved_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_1d"),
        F.sum("b.unit_price").alias("prior_unit_price_1d"),
    )
)

latest = (
    covered
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("sku_id").orderBy("prior_unit_price_1d", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

rollup_base = (
    latest
    .groupBy("sku_id")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("prior_unit_price_1d", 0.5).alias("median_prior_unit_price_1d"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.max("moved_at").alias("last_moved_at"),
        F.min("prior_rows_1d").alias("min_prior_rows_1d"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.round(F.stddev("prior_rows_1d"), 2).alias("stddev_prior_rows_1d"),
    )
)

result = (
    rollup_base
    .groupingSets(
        [["sku_id", "cnt", "min_prior_rows_1d"], ["sku_id"], []],
        "sku_id", "cnt", "min_prior_rows_1d",
    )
    .agg(F.max("last_moved_at").alias("last_last_moved_at"))
    .orderBy(
        F.col("sku_id").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("cnt").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("min_prior_rows_1d").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)
```

```python
        F.round(F.col("teu_capacity") / F.nullif(F.col("reefer_temp"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("teu_capacity_per_reefer_temp"),
    )
)

w_voyage_id_arrived_on_month_b = Window.partitionBy("voyage_id", F.date_trunc("month", "arrived_on")).orderBy(F.col("teu_capacity_per_reefer_temp").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w_arrived_on_month_vessel_flag = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "arrived_on"), "rural_stencil")
windowed = (
    prepared_containers
    .select(
        "id",
        "rural_stencil",
        "arrived_on",
        "lunar_chronicle",
        F.max("teu_capacity_per_reefer_temp").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "arrived_on"), "rural_stencil")).alias("arrived_on_month_vessel_flag_max_teu_capacity_pe"),

        F.min("lunar_chronicle").over(w_arrived_on_month_vessel_flag).alias("arrived_on_month_vessel_flag_min_arrived_on_mont"),
    )
)

w_rn_by_arrived_on_month_vesse = Window.partitionBy("rn").orderBy("arrived_on_month_vessel_flag_min_arrived_on_mont", "id")
sequenced = (
    windowed
    .withColumn("days_since_prev_arrived_on", F.datediff(F.col("arrived_on"), F.lag("arrived_on").over(Window.partitionBy("rn", "lunar_chronicle").orderBy("teu_capacity_vs_arrived_on_month_vessel_flag_avg", "id"))))
```

```sql
    COALESCE(b.transfer_count, 0) AS transfer_count,
    b.transfer_total_qty,
    COALESCE(a.inbound_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.transfer_count, 0) AS inbound_count_minus_transfer_count
```

```sql
line_level_claims AS (
```

```sql
    FROM recent
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY actor_nom ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
)
-- Subtotals with GROUPING SETS
SELECT
    ticket_id_init_orig,
    COALESCE(actor_nom, 'ALL') AS actor_nom,
    session_id,
    MIN(prev_event_at) AS first_prev_event_at
FROM sessionized
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((ticket_id_init_orig, actor_nom, session_id), (ticket_id_init_orig), (actor_nom))
```

```sql
PIVOT (
```

```sql
        closed_at,
```

```sql
        channel,
        csat,
        tags
    FROM tickets
    WHERE requester_id >= 8
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous opened_at per priority
    SELECT *, LAG(opened_at) OVER (PARTITION BY priority ORDER BY opened_at, id) AS prev_opened_at
    FROM recent
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 2 hours)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_opened_at IS NULL OR opened_at > prev_opened_at + INTERVAL 2 HOURS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY priority ORDER BY opened_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        priority,
        session_id,
        MIN(opened_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(opened_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        SUM(csat) AS session_csat,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(opened_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(opened_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY priority, session_id
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM per_session
    WHERE session_id > (SELECT AVG(session_id) FROM per_session)
),
annotated AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(duration_min, 0.0) AS duration_min_filled,
        DATE_TRUNC('DAY', session_start) AS session_start_day
    FROM without_matches
    WHERE session_csat <= 13
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    priority,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    events,
    session_csat,
    duration_min,
    duration_min_filled,
    session_start_day,
    SUBSTRING(TRIM(priority), 1, 4) AS priority_prefix,
    LOWER(TRIM(priority)) AS priority_clean
FROM annotated
ORDER BY session_start_day DESC, session_end
```

```python
)
```

```sql
grade_status_group_stats AS (

    FROM filtered

vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT s.*, g.avg_score, ROUND(s.score - g.avg_score, 2) AS score_minus_avg
```

```python
        F.abs(F.col("score") - 57.3).alias("score_distance"),
```

```sql
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct
    FROM promotions
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY discount_pct, id) = 1
),
matched AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        e.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct
    FROM ranked e
    JOIN promotions pr
        ON COALESCE(e.channel, 'web') = pr.channel
       AND e.ends_on BETWEEN pr.starts_on AND pr.ends_on
),
matched_promotions AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        src.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id_2,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code_2,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct_2
    FROM matched src
    JOIN promotions pr
        ON COALESCE(src.channel, 'store') = pr.channel
       AND src.ends_on BETWEEN pr.starts_on AND pr.ends_on
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, UPPER(promo_code) AS promo_code_upper
    FROM matched_promotions
    WHERE ends_on >= TO_DATE('2023-05-23')
      AND promotion_promo_code = 'BUNDLE'
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        promo_id,
        promotion_discount_pct,
        promo_id_2,
        promo_code_upper
    FROM filtered
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promotion_promo_code_2 ORDER BY promo_id_2 DESC, id, promo_id, promo_id_2) = 1
),
ranked_promotions AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY ends_on DESC, id, promo_id, promo_id_2) AS latest_rank
        FROM latest
    ) t
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        promo_id,
        promotion_discount_pct,
        promo_id_2,
        promo_code_upper,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), ends_on) / 7 AS weeks_since_ends_on
    FROM ranked_promotions
    WHERE channel IS DISTINCT FROM 'web'
      AND channel IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    id,
    promo_code,
    ends_on,
    promo_id,
    promotion_discount_pct,
    promo_id_2,
    promo_code_upper
FROM base
ORDER BY promo_id_2 DESC;
```

```sql
    FROM meter_readings a

      ON b.site_id = a.site_id

     AND b.read_at >= a.read_at - INTERVAL 3 DAYS

    SELECT

        FROM matched
    ) ranked

),
exploded_detail_readings AS (
```

```python
    .select(
```

```python
        "fixture_id",
        "raw_league_div",
        "signed_on",
        "club_motto",
        F.concat_ws(" / ", F.col("raw_league_div"), F.col("club_motto")).alias("league_div_club_motto_label"),
        F.concat_ws(" / ", F.col("club_motto"), F.col("raw_league_div")).alias("club_motto_league_div_label"),
    )
)

combined_details = (
    recent.alias("s")
    .join(df_granaries.alias("f"), F.col("f.id") == F.col("s.fixture_id"), "inner")
    .join(df_bakeries.alias("c"), F.col("c.id") == F.col("f.club_id"), "inner")
    .filter(~F.col("f.is_home"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("f.is_home").alias("fixture_is_home"),
        F.col("c.venue_surface").alias("club_venue_surface"),
    )
)

qualified = (
    combined_details.alias("s")
    .join(df_inland_switches.alias("g"), F.col("g.fixture_id") == F.col("s.fixture_id"), "left_semi")
)

w_all_by_signed_on = Window.orderBy(F.col("signed_on").desc(), "id")
ranked = (
    qualified
    .select(
        "id",
        "signed_on",
        "club_motto",
        "league_div_club_motto_label",
        "club_motto_league_div_label",
        "fixture_is_home",
        "club_venue_surface",
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("signed_on").desc(), "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.lag("signed_on").over(w_all_by_signed_on).alias("prev_signed_on"),
        F.last("signed_on", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("signed_on").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_signed_on"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("signed_on").desc())), 3).alias("signed_on_cume_dist"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("signed_on").desc())), 3).alias("signed_on_percent_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("signed_on").desc())).alias("signed_on_dense_rank"),

    .crossJoin(latest.agg(F.max("signed_on_dense_rank").alias("overall_max_signed_on_dense_rank")))
    .filter(F.col("signed_on_dense_rank") < F.col("overall_max_signed_on_dense_rank"))
    .drop("overall_max_signed_on_dense_rank")
)

result = (
    with_activity
    .select(
        "id",
        "signed_on_cume_dist",
        "signed_on_percent_rank",
        "signed_on_percent_rank_per_signed_on_cume_dist",

        variableColumnName="metric_alt",
```

```sql
    FROM enrollments

    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id_nom_ref ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
with_stats AS (
```

```sql
    FROM (
```

```sql
        FROM cleaned_events
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
with_details AS (

        s.id,
        s.ticket_id,
        s.event_type,
        s.actor,
        s.event_type_group,

        s.event_type_prefix,
        t.tags AS ticket_tags
    FROM latest s

),
exploded_detail AS (
    -- One row per event

        s.event_type_group,

        t.id AS event_id,
```

```sql
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.agent_id,
        a.opened_at,

        SUM(b.csat) AS alpha_glacier
    FROM cedar_mines a
    LEFT JOIN cedar_mines b
      ON b.agent_id = a.agent_id
     AND b.opened_at < a.opened_at
     AND b.opened_at >= a.opened_at - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.agent_id, a.opened_at
),
with_details AS (
    -- Attach agent attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        su.tier AS agent_tier,
        su.agent_name,
        su.team AS agent_team
    FROM matched s
    JOIN canyons su ON su.id = s.agent_id
),
windowed AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(opened_at), prior_rows_12h ORDER BY alpha_glacier DESC) AS prior_csat_12h_rank,
        ROUND(alpha_glacier - AVG(alpha_glacier) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id, agent_tier), 2) AS pacific_reservoir,
        LAG(alpha_glacier) OVER (ORDER BY prior_rows_12h DESC, id) AS prev_prior_csat_12h
    FROM with_details
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach cedar_mines metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MAX(t.closed_at) FROM cedar_mines t WHERE t.agent_id = s.agent_id) AS last_ticket_closed_at,
        (SELECT MAX(t.closed_at) FROM cedar_mines t WHERE t.agent_id = s.agent_id) AS last_ticket_closed_at_2
    FROM windowed s
)
-- Subtotals with GROUPING SETS
SELECT
    agent_team,
    agent_id,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROUND(STDDEV(prior_rows_12h), 2) AS stddev_prior_rows_12h
FROM profiled
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((agent_team, agent_id), (agent_team), (agent_id))
ORDER BY agent_team NULLS LAST, agent_id NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

    df_cedar_mines.alias("a")
    .join(

        (F.col("b.agent_id") == F.col("a.agent_id"))
        & (F.col("b.opened_at") < F.col("a.opened_at"))
        & (F.col("b.opened_at") >= F.col("a.opened_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.agent_id", "a.opened_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_12h"),
        F.sum("b.csat").alias("alpha_glacier"),
    )

    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("su.tier").alias("agent_tier"),
        "su.agent_name",
        F.col("su.team").alias("agent_team"),
    )
)

windowed = (
    with_details
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("opened_at"), "prior_rows_12h").orderBy(F.col("alpha_glacier").desc())).alias("prior_csat_12h_rank"),

)

result = (
```

```sql
    course_id,
```
```sql
    grade_status,
    enrolled_at_adj,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

    df_dim_piers
    .filter(F.col("enrolled_at_adj") < F.lit("2025-02-24 13:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term_final_avg2",
        "grade_status",
        "enrolled_at_adj",
    )
)

with_prev = scoped_enrollments.withColumn("prev_enrolled_at", F.lag("enrolled_at_adj").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status").orderBy("enrolled_at_adj", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_enrolled_at").isNull() | (F.col("enrolled_at_adj") > F.col("prev_enrolled_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status").orderBy("enrolled_at_adj", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

        "g.max_session_id",

    )
)

result = (

    .select(

        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "grade_status",
        "enrolled_at_adj",
        "starts_session",
        "session_id",
        "max_session_id",
```

```sql
    from products

        corr(price, cost) over (partition by year(launch_date), category) as corr_price_cost,
        ntile(3) over (partition by month(launch_date), category order by stock_qty, id) as stock_qty_bucket
    from deduped
    where category <> 'Books'
),
with_last as (
    -- Latest matching inventory per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
        s.id,
        s.stock_qty,
        s.tags,
        s.corr_price_cost,
        x.inventory_last_restock,
        x.inventory_quantity
    from scored s
    left join lateral (
            select c.last_restock as inventory_last_restock, c.quantity as inventory_quantity

            order by c.last_restock desc, c.id desc

        avg(corr_price_cost) over (order by inventory_quantity, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_avg_corr_price_cost,
```
