```sql
    SELECT
        *,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(store_name, ' ', '') AS store_name_slug,
        COALESCE(region, 'NONE') AS region_filled
    FROM stores
    WHERE city = 'New York'
),
with_last AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.city,
        s.region,
        s.opened_date,
        top1.store_sale_sale_date,
        top1.store_sale_units
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.sale_date AS store_sale_sale_date, c.units AS store_sale_units
            FROM store_sales c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.units DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
kept AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_last s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_sales c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
              AND c.sale_date >= s.opened_date
        )
),
with_last_stores AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.region,
        s.store_sale_units,
        x.status,
        x.order_date
    FROM kept s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.status, c.order_date
            FROM orders c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.amount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
)
SELECT
    id,
    region,
    store_sale_units,
    status,
    CASE WHEN region RLIKE '^(South|Central)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' WHEN region RLIKE '^(North|East)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS region_zone
FROM with_last_stores
```

```python
flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("key", "value"),
    )
)

parsed = (
    flattened
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "status_code",
        "key",
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(1) != 0).cast("int").alias("has_fault"),

    .withColumn("status_code_adjusted", F.round((F.col("status_code") * 0.9), 2))
    .withColumn("has_fault_minus_status_code_high", (F.col("has_fault") - F.col("status_code_high")))
)

totals = (

    .withColumn("has_fault_tier", F.when(F.col("has_fault") >= 1, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))

        F.bit_or("status_code").alias("status_code_bit_or"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("service") == "auth", 1)).alias("auth_rows"),
```

```sql
    ) x
    WHERE latest_rank = 1

    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        latest_rank
    FROM latest
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY latest_rank DESC, id) = 1
)
-- Multi-level aggregation

    CASE WHEN monthly_fee >= 216 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS monthly_fee_tier,
    MAX(monthly_fee) AS max_monthly_fee,
    ROUND(SUM(monthly_fee) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS monthly_fee_per_cancelled,

    PERCENTILE_APPROX(monthly_fee, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS monthly_fee_quartiles,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'CANCELLED') AS cancelled_events,
    GROUPING(plan) AS grouping_id
```

```sql
    -- Latest matching order per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
```
```sql
        s.*,
```
```sql
        latest.status,
        latest.order_discount
```

```sql
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.status, c.discount AS order_discount
            FROM orders c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.discount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_latest s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM subscriptions ch
            WHERE ch.customer_id = s.id
              AND ch.end_date < s.signup_date
        )
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY age NULLS LAST, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM not_flagged
    ) x
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT city, segment
    FROM latest
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT city, segment
    FROM customers
    WHERE segment IS NOT NULL
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.city = k.city AND s.segment = k.segment
),
scored AS (

        is_active,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        status,
        order_discount,
        rank_in_group,
        CORR(age, credit_limit) OVER (PARTITION BY city) corr_age_credit_limit
    FROM kept_rows
)
SELECT
    name,

    is_active,
    order_discount,
```

```sql
    FROM with_latest
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT city, region
    FROM stores

reconciled AS (

    FROM with_latest s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.city = k.city AND s.region = k.region

    FROM reconciled
),
not_flagged AS (
```

```sql
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fuel_type, is_renewable ORDER BY voltage_kv, id) AS voltage_kv_dense_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY power_plant_id ORDER BY voltage_kv DESC, id) AS voltage_kv_dense_rank_2,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_is_renewable_fuel_type_by_vo AS voltage_kv_dense_rank_3,
        LEAD(voltage_kv, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY fuel_type ORDER BY voltage_kv ASC, id) AS next2_voltage_kv,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY is_renewable, fuel_type ORDER BY voltage_kv), 3) AS voltage_kv_cume_dist,

    FROM recent_outage_events

),

        voltage_kv_dense_rank_3,

        prev_voltage_kv - voltage_kv_dense_rank_2 AS prev_voltage_kv_minus_voltage_kv_dense_rank_2,
```

```sql
        ROUND(requester_id / NULLIF(SUM(requester_id) OVER w_agent_team, 0), 4) AS requester_id_share_of_agent_team,
        LEAD(closed_at, 3) OVER (ORDER BY requester_id, id) AS next3_closed_at

),
derived AS (

    FROM windowed

summary AS (
```

```sql
    FROM joined_ranges s
)
```
```sql
-- Final projection
```

```python
    df_meter_readings.alias("a")
```

```sql
    FROM joined_ranges s

reading_stats_2 AS (

deduped AS (
```

```python
        F.regexp_replace("applicant_ref", " ", "_").alias("applicant_ref_slug"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "app_state",
        "is_cosigned",
        "applicant_ref_slug",
        F.last("txn_cnt", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("bank_branche_id").orderBy("is_cosigned_flag", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_txn_cnt"),
        F.lead("apr_pct", 2, 0).over(Window.partitionBy("app_state").orderBy("apr_pct", "id")).alias("next_apr_pct"),
        F.avg("txn_cnt").over(Window.partitionBy("app_state", "bank_branche_id").orderBy("is_cosigned_flag", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("txn_cnt_avg_6"),
    )
)

latest_match = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_cash_drawers.alias("c"), (F.col("c.teller_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.loan_amt_req").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)

    )
)

kept_rows = (

    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

eligible = (
    kept_rows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_cash_drawers.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.teller_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.teller_id").isin([2, 23, 24, 26])), "left_anti")
```

```sql
        ROUND(AVG(approved_amount_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY claim_type), 2) AS claim_type_avg_approved_amount_filled,
        LAG(claim_date) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY approved_amount DESC, id) AS prev_claim_date,
        approved_amount - LAG(approved_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date) ORDER BY approved_amount_filled DESC, id) AS approved_amount_change,
        MAX(claimed_amount) OVER (ORDER BY reported_at ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS claimed_amount_max_1_prior,

        NTH_VALUE(approved_amount, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date) ORDER BY approved_amount_filled DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_approved_amount
    FROM recent_claims

    SELECT

        ROUND(reported_at_percent_rank / NULLIF(rows_in_claim_type, 0), 3) AS reported_at_percent_rank_per_rows_in_claim_type,
        FLOOR(rows_in_claim_type / 5) * 5 AS rows_in_claim_type_bucket
    FROM with_windows
),
metrics AS (

    FROM tagged
    WINDOW w_claim_date_month_by_distinct AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(claim_date) ORDER BY distinct_status_in_claim_type DESC, id)
```

```sql
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        incident_class,
        budget_thb,
        floor_cnt,
        broke_ground_on,
        COALESCE(budget_thb, 0) AS budget_thb_filled,
        CASE WHEN budget_thb >= 62082000 THEN 'High' WHEN budget_thb >= 10948000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS budget_thb_band
    FROM subcontractors
    WHERE incident_class IN ('near_miss', 'major', 'minor')
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, ROUND(budget_thb, 0) AS budget_thb_rounded
    FROM base
    WHERE broke_ground_on >= DATE '2023-09-10'
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        incident_class,
        floor_cnt,
        broke_ground_on,
        budget_thb_filled,
        LAG(budget_thb, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY incident_class ORDER BY budget_thb_rounded, id) AS prev_budget_thb,
        SUM(budget_thb_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY incident_class ORDER BY budget_thb_rounded, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_budget_thb_filled,
        FIRST_VALUE(budget_thb) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY incident_class ORDER BY broke_ground_on, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_budget_thb,
        NTILE(5) OVER w_part AS budget_thb_filled_bucket
    FROM valid
    WHERE floor_cnt <= 37
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY incident_class ORDER BY budget_thb_filled DESC, id)
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY incident_class ORDER BY prev_budget_thb DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM with_windows
    ) t
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
with_windows_subcontractors AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        floor_cnt,
        broke_ground_on,
        prev_budget_thb,
        running_budget_thb_filled,
        budget_thb_filled_bucket,
        SUM(budget_thb_filled) OVER w_hist AS running_sum_budget_thb_filled,
        MIN(budget_thb_filled) OVER w_hist AS running_min_budget_thb_filled,
        COUNT(budget_thb_filled) OVER w_hist AS running_count_budget_thb_filled,
        AVG(budget_thb_filled) OVER w_hist AS running_avg_budget_thb_filled,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_recent AS running_budget_thb_filled_percent_rank
    FROM latest
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY incident_class ORDER BY broke_ground_on, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_recent AS (PARTITION BY YEAR(broke_ground_on), incident_class ORDER BY running_budget_thb_filled)
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT
    id,
    measure,
    reading
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        running_min_budget_thb_filled,
        prev_budget_thb,
        running_avg_budget_thb_filled,
        running_budget_thb_filled_percent_rank
    FROM with_windows_subcontractors
) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR measure IN (running_min_budget_thb_filled AS RUNNING_MIN_BUDGET_THB_FILLED_VAL, prev_budget_thb AS PREV_BUDGET_THB, running_avg_budget_thb_filled, running_budget_thb_filled_percent_rank AS RUNNING_BUDGET_THB_FILLED_PERCENT_RANK_VAL)
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("incident_class").orderBy(F.col("budget_thb_filled").desc(), "id")
w_recent = Window.partitionBy(F.year("broke_ground_on"), "incident_class").orderBy("running_budget_thb_filled")

base = (
    df_subcontractors
    .filter(F.col("incident_class").isin(["near_miss", "major", "minor"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "incident_class",
        "budget_thb",
        "floor_cnt",
        "broke_ground_on",
        F.coalesce("budget_thb", F.lit(0)).alias("budget_thb_filled"),
        F.when(F.col("budget_thb") >= 62082000, "High").when(F.col("budget_thb") >= 10948000, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("budget_thb_band"),
    )
)

valid = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("broke_ground_on") >= F.lit("2023-09-10").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("budget_thb_rounded", F.round("budget_thb", 0))
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("floor_cnt") <= 37)
    .select(
        "id",
        "incident_class",
        "floor_cnt",
        "broke_ground_on",
        "budget_thb_filled",
        F.lag("budget_thb", 2, 0).over(Window.partitionBy("incident_class").orderBy("budget_thb_rounded", "id")).alias("prev_budget_thb"),
        F.sum("budget_thb_filled").over(Window.partitionBy("incident_class").orderBy("budget_thb_rounded", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_budget_thb_filled"),
        F.first("budget_thb", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("incident_class").orderBy("broke_ground_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_budget_thb"),
        F.ntile(5).over(w_part).alias("budget_thb_filled_bucket"),
    )
)

latest = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("incident_class").orderBy(F.col("prev_budget_thb").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

with_windows_subcontractors = (
    latest
    .select(
        "id",
        "floor_cnt",
        "broke_ground_on",
        "prev_budget_thb",
        "running_budget_thb_filled",
        "budget_thb_filled_bucket",
        F.sum("budget_thb_filled").over(Window.partitionBy("incident_class").orderBy("broke_ground_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_budget_thb_filled"),
        F.min("budget_thb_filled").over(Window.partitionBy("incident_class").orderBy("broke_ground_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_min_budget_thb_filled"),
        F.count("budget_thb_filled").over(Window.partitionBy("incident_class").orderBy("broke_ground_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_budget_thb_filled"),
        F.avg("budget_thb_filled").over(Window.partitionBy("incident_class").orderBy("broke_ground_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_avg_budget_thb_filled"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w_recent).alias("running_budget_thb_filled_percent_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows_subcontractors
    .select(
        "id",
        F.col("running_min_budget_thb_filled").alias("RUNNING_MIN_BUDGET_THB_FILLED_VAL"),
        F.col("prev_budget_thb").alias("PREV_BUDGET_THB"),
        "running_avg_budget_thb_filled",
        F.col("running_budget_thb_filled_percent_rank").alias("RUNNING_BUDGET_THB_FILLED_PERCENT_RANK_VAL"),
    )
    .unpivot(

        values=["RUNNING_MIN_BUDGET_THB_FILLED_VAL", "PREV_BUDGET_THB", "running_avg_budget_thb_filled", "RUNNING_BUDGET_THB_FILLED_PERCENT_RANK_VAL"],
        variableColumnName="measure",
        valueColumnName="reading",
    )

)
```

```python
    .groupBy("deploy_result")

    filtered_clusters.alias("s")
    .join(deploy_result_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.deploy_result") == F.col("s.deploy_result"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.cpu_util_pct_distance") > F.col("g.avg_cpu_util_pct_distance"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.avg_cpu_util_pct_distance",

    .join(vm_family_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.vm_family") == F.col("s.vm_family"), "inner")

)

    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("deploy_result", "vm_family").orderBy(F.col("cpu_util_pct_distance_minus_avg").desc(), F.col("id").desc())))
```

```python
filtered_readings = (
    df_maple_pagodas
    .filter(F.col("kwh") > 37.0)
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.when(F.col("kwh") >= 101.2, "A").when(F.col("kwh") >= 45.0, "B").otherwise("C").alias("kwh_tier"),
    )
)

with_parent_site = (
    filtered_readings.alias("s")
    .join(df_core_clippers.alias("si"), F.col("si.id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("si.site_name").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.site_id",
        "s.read_at",
        "s.kwh",
        "s.voltage",
        F.col("si.installed_kw").alias("site_installed_kw"),
        F.col("si.zone").alias("emerald_radar"),
        "si.site_name",
    )
)

w_site_id_read_at_month = Window.partitionBy("site_id", F.date_trunc("month", "read_at"))
w_site_zone = Window.partitionBy("emerald_radar")
w_all_by_kwh = Window.orderBy("kwh", "id")
sequenced = (
    with_parent_site
    .select(
        "*",
        F.last("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("kwh", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_kwh"),
        F.round(F.col("kwh") - F.avg("kwh").over(w_site_id_read_at_month), 2).alias("kwh_vs_site_id_read_at_month_avg"),
        F.sum("kwh").over(w_site_zone).alias("site_zone_sum_kwh"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", F.year("read_at")).orderBy("kwh")).alias("kwh_rank"),
        F.row_number().over(w_all_by_kwh).alias("kwh_seq"),
        F.lag("read_at", 2).over(w_all_by_kwh).alias("prev2_read_at"),
        F.round(F.col("voltage") - F.avg("voltage").over(w_site_id_read_at_month), 2).alias("voltage_vs_site_id_read_at_month_avg"),
        F.first("site_installed_kw").over(Window.orderBy("kwh", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_site_installed_kw"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", F.year("read_at")).orderBy("kwh")).alias("kwh_dense_rank"),
        F.last("site_installed_kw").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", F.year("read_at")).orderBy("kwh", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("arbiter_code"),
        F.nth_value("read_at", 2).over(Window.orderBy("kwh", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_read_at"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_site_zone).alias("rows_in_site_zone"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("site_id").over(Window.partitionBy("emerald_radar"))).alias("distinct_site_id_in_site_zone"),
        F.round(F.col("site_installed_kw") / F.nullif(F.sum("site_installed_kw").over(Window.partitionBy("emerald_radar")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("site_installed_kw_share_of_site_zone"),
    )
)

first_rows = (
    sequenced
    .filter(F.col("kwh_rank") <= 2)
    .drop("kwh_rank")
)

per_group = (
    first_rows
    .groupBy(
        F.date_format("prev2_read_at", "yyyy-MM").alias("prev2_read_at_ym"),
        F.date_format("read_at", "yyyy-MM").alias("read_at_ym"),
        "emerald_radar",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.lower(F.col("site_name")).like("% a%"), F.col("site_installed_kw_share_of_site_zone")).otherwise(0)).alias("site_installed_kw_share_of_site_zone_lower_site_"),
        F.max("prev2_read_at").alias("last_prev2_read_at"),
        F.max("second_read_at").alias("valley_trolley"),
    )
)

w_all_by_site_installed_kw_sha = Window.orderBy("site_installed_kw_share_of_site_zone_lower_site_", "prev2_read_at_ym", "read_at_ym", "emerald_radar")
metrics = (
    per_group
    .select(
        "prev2_read_at_ym",
        "read_at_ym",
        "emerald_radar",
        "site_installed_kw_share_of_site_zone_lower_site_",
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("site_installed_kw_share_of_site_zone_lower_site_", "prev2_read_at_ym", "read_at_ym", "emerald_radar")).alias("site_installed_kw_share_of_site_zone_lower_site__2"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(w_all_by_site_installed_kw_sha), 3).alias("site_installed_kw_share_of_site_zone_lower_site__3"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "prev2_read_at_ym",
        "emerald_radar",
        "site_installed_kw_share_of_site_zone_lower_site_",
        "site_installed_kw_share_of_site_zone_lower_site__2",
        "site_installed_kw_share_of_site_zone_lower_site__3",
        F.when(F.col("emerald_radar").isin("Z3", "Z4"), "group_a").when(F.col("emerald_radar") == "Z2", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("site_zone_group"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("prev2_read_at_ym").desc(),
        F.col("site_zone_group").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_employees
    .filter((F.col("hire_date") > F.lit("2023-08-06").cast("date")) & F.col("manager_id").isNotNull())
```

```sql
    GROUP BY a.id, a.sku_id, a.moved_at

enriched AS (

        s.id,
        s.sku_id,
        s.moved_at,
        s.prior_qty_7d,
        sk.unit_cost AS sku_unit_cost
    FROM joined_ranges s
    JOIN skus sk ON sk.id = s.sku_id
),
profiled AS (

        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_moves st WHERE st.sku_id = s.sku_id) AS move_count
    FROM enriched s
)

ORDER BY id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
```

```python
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.col("voltage") <= 232.0)

        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
    )

w_read_at_month = Window.partitionBy(F.month("read_at"))
with_trends = (

        "site_id",
```

```sql
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        brand,
        price,
        cost,
        launch_date,
        tags,
        supplier_id,
        UPPER(product_name) AS product_name_upper
    FROM products
    WHERE supplier_id IS NOT NULL
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY cost DESC NULLS FIRST, id ASC) AS rn
    FROM valid
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach suppliers attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        b.rating,
        b.country
    FROM deduped src
    LEFT JOIN suppliers b
        ON src.supplier_id = b.id
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM joined
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY rn DESC, id ASC) = 1
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY price ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cost_avg_6,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY price DESC, id ASC) AS price_bucket,
        LEAD(rating, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY brand, country ORDER BY price ASC, id ASC) AS next_rating,
        ROUND(price / SUM(price) OVER (PARTITION BY brand, supplier_id), 4) AS price_share,
        AVG(price) OVER (ORDER BY price ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS price_avg_2_prior
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching order_item per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, latest.quantity
    FROM scored s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.quantity
            FROM order_items c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.unit_price DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM with_latest
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, brand ORDER BY price_avg_2_prior DESC, id ASC) = 1
)

    id,
    category,
    brand,
    price,
    cost,
    launch_date,
    tags,
```

```sql
    a.fail_avg_score_nom_ext,
    COALESCE(b.withdrawn_count, 0) AS withdrawn_count,
    COALESCE(b.withdrawn_total_score_tot_lag, 0) AS withdrawn_total_score_tot_lag,
    COALESCE(a.fail_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.withdrawn_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM fail_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN withdrawn_monthly b
  ON a.enrolled_at_month = b.enrolled_at_month
ORDER BY enrolled_at_month
```

```sql
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY zone_code_std ORDER BY outage_started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ext_burst_id
    FROM flagged

per_session AS (

sequenced AS (
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY term ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged

sessions AS (
    -- One row per session

        term,
        session_no,
        MIN(enrolled_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(enrolled_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        SUM(score) AS session_score,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(enrolled_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(enrolled_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY term, session_no
),
summary AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        session_no,
        n_events,
        ROUND(AVG(duration_min), 2) AS avg_duration_min,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(n_events, 0.5) AS median_n_events,
        SUM(n_events) FILTER (WHERE term IS NOT NULL) AS n_events_term_is_not_null,
        MIN(n_events) AS min_n_events,
        ROUND(SUM(session_no) / NULLIF(SUM(n_events), 0), 3) AS session_no_to_n_events_ratio
    FROM sessions
    GROUP BY session_no, n_events
)
SELECT
    session_no,
    n_events_term_is_not_null,
```

```python
    df_enrollments
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",

        "term",
        "score",
        "grade_status",
        "enrolled_at",

    )
)

with_prev = cleaned.withColumn("prev_enrolled_at", F.lag("enrolled_at").over(Window.partitionBy("term").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id")))

flagged = (

)

    )
)

result = (

    .select(

        "n_events_term_is_not_null",
        "min_n_events",
        "session_no_to_n_events_ratio",
```

```python
w_part = Window.partitionBy("dock_side").orderBy("last4_sum_lift_hrs", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)

    .alias("s")
    .join(df_pick_tasks.alias("c"), (F.col("c.warehouses_v_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.slot_start_ts") <= F.col("s.received_date")), "left_anti")
)

with_windows = (
    kept
    .withColumn("last4_count_lift_hrs", F.count("lift_hrs").over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("last4_sum_lift_hrs", F.sum("lift_hrs").over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("last4_min_lift_hrs", F.min("lift_hrs").over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("last4_max_lift_hrs", F.max("lift_hrs").over(w_ordered))
)
```

```sql
    FROM accounts

    SELECT s.*

        s.status,
        s.prev_balance,

    FROM not_flagged s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.txn_time AS transaction_txn_time
            FROM transactions c

            ORDER BY c.amount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1

    FROM not_flagged_accounts s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("account_type", "status").orderBy("transaction_txn_time", "id")
w_hist = Window.orderBy("prev_prev_balance", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w_grp = Window.orderBy("prev_balance", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

with_windows = (
    df_accounts
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("balance").over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("balance", "id")).alias("prev_balance"),
        F.lead("balance").over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("balance", "id")).alias("next_balance"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("balance", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

not_flagged = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.account_id").isin([5, 17, 19, 34])), "left_anti")
)

with_last = (
    not_flagged
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.account_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.amount").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.customer_id",
        "s.account_type",
        "s.balance",
        "s.opened_date",
        "s.status",
        "s.prev_balance",
        F.col("c.txn_time").alias("transaction_txn_time"),
    )
)

with_windows_accounts = (
    with_last
    .select(
        "id",
        "prev_balance",
        F.lag("balance").over(w_ordered).alias("prev_balance_2"),
        F.lag("prev_balance").over(w_ordered).alias("prev_prev_balance"),
        F.lead("prev_balance").over(w_ordered).alias("next_prev_balance"),
        F.row_number().over(w_ordered).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

not_flagged_accounts = (
    with_windows_accounts
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.is_flagged")), "left_anti")
)

eligible = (
    not_flagged_accounts
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.merchant") == "Shell"), "left_anti")
)

enriched = (
    eligible
    .filter(F.col("row_seq") <= 4)
    .withColumn("row_seq_avg_2_prior", F.avg("row_seq").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("next_row_seq", F.lead("row_seq", 1).over(Window.orderBy("prev_balance_2", "id")))
    .withColumn("first_known_prev_balance_2", F.first("prev_balance_2", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("prev_prev_balance", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("cumulative_prev_balance", F.sum("prev_balance").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("next_prev_balance_2", F.lead("prev_balance_2", 1, 0).over(Window.orderBy("prev_prev_balance", "id")))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .rollup(
        F.when(F.col("prev_balance") >= 69000, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("prev_balance_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("cumulative_prev_balance") >= 317260, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("cumulative_prev_balance_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.sum("next_row_seq").alias("total_next_row_seq"),
        F.round(F.avg("next_prev_balance"), 2).alias("avg_next_prev_balance"),
    )
)
```

```sql
    FROM stores

ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        region_filled
    FROM base
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city, region ORDER BY sqft, id) = 1
),
base_stores AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows

        *,
        CASE WHEN sqft >= 13064 THEN 'High' WHEN sqft >= 8039 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS sqft_tier,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), opened_date) AS days_since_opened_date
    FROM ranked
    WHERE opened_date >= DATE '2023-06-02'
      AND sqft < 15638
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching store_sale per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.region_filled,
        x.revenue
    FROM base_stores s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.revenue
            FROM store_sales c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.units DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(revenue, 2) OVER (ORDER BY revenue, id) AS prev_revenue,
        SUM(revenue) OVER w_grp AS cumulative_revenue,
        NTILE(5) OVER w_grp_2 AS revenue_bucket,
        LAST_VALUE(revenue, TRUE) OVER w_grp AS last_known_revenue
    FROM with_last
    WHERE revenue IS NOT NULL

),
kept AS (

),
summary AS (

        CASE WHEN prev_revenue >= 3600 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS prev_revenue_tier,
```

```python
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)

    .withColumn("prev_revenue", F.lag("revenue", 2).over(Window.orderBy("revenue", "id")))
    .withColumn("cumulative_revenue", F.sum("revenue").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("revenue_bucket", F.ntile(5).over(w_grp_2))
    .withColumn("last_known_revenue", F.last("revenue", ignorenulls=True).over(w_grp))

        F.percentile_approx("revenue", 0.9).alias("revenue_p90"),

        F.grouping("prev_revenue_tier").alias("grouping_level"),
    )
)

result = (

    .select(
```

```sql
deduped as (

    ) t

)
select

    status,
    kpi,
    metric_value
from (

) src
unpivot (
```

```python
)

w_all_by_score_ties = Window.orderBy(F.col("score_obs_pri").desc())
w_course_id_grade_status = Window.partitionBy("course_id", "grade_status")
ranked = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(w_all_by_score_ties), 3).alias("score_cume_dist"),
        F.lead("score_obs_pri").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("score_obs_pri").desc(), "id")).alias("next_score"),
        F.round(F.col("score_obs_pri") / F.nullif(F.sum("score_obs_pri").over(Window.partitionBy("student_id")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("score_share_of_student_id"),
        F.round(F.avg("score_obs_pri").over(Window.partitionBy("course_id", F.year("enrolled_at")).orderBy("enrolled_at", "id").rowsBetween(-1, -1)), 2).alias("score_avg_1_prior"),

        F.round(F.avg("score_obs_pri").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "enrolled_at"), "term").orderBy("score_obs_pri", "id").rowsBetween(-1, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("score_avg_2"),
        F.last("score_obs_pri").over(Window.partitionBy("course_id", F.year("enrolled_at")).orderBy("enrolled_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_score"),
    )
)

w_term = Window.partitionBy("term")
windowed = (

    .select(

        F.rank().over(w_term_by_course_id_grade_stat).alias("course_id_grade_status_sum_score_rank"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("term").orderBy("enrolled_at_hour")), 3).alias("enrolled_at_hour_cume_dist"),
        F.min("score_share_of_student_id").over(w_term).alias("term_min_score_share_of_student_id"),
    )

result = (

        "course_id_grade_status_sum_score",
```

```sql
    COALESCE(b.officer_count, 0) AS officer_count,
    COALESCE(b.officer_total_reefer_temp, 0) AS officer_total_reefer_temp,
    COALESCE(a.rating_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.officer_count, 0) AS net_count
```
